summary.zh: 李世民圍王世充於東都，竇建德率兵十餘萬來援。建德自滎陽西上，築壘板渚；世民屯武牢，相持二十餘日，終大破之，生擒建德於陣。押建德至東都城下，世充率官屬詣軍門請降，山東悉平。
summary.en: Li Shimin was besieging Wang Shichong in the Eastern Capital when Dou Jiande came to his relief with over a hundred thousand men. Jiande came west from Xingyang and camped at Banzhu; Shimin held Wulao, and after over twenty days of facing each other he routed Jiande and captured him on the field. Brought to the walls of the Eastern Capital, Jiande's capture made Shichong come out with his officials and surrender; all the land east of the mountains was pacified.

passages.sourceEn: Old Book of Tang (Liu Xu et al., 945)
passages.locator: 卷二 太宗本紀上
passages.textZh: 會竇建德以兵十餘萬來援世充，至於酸棗。
passages.textEn: Then Dou Jiande came with over a hundred thousand men to relieve Shichong, reaching Suanzao.

passages.sourceEn: Old Book of Tang (Liu Xu et al., 945)
passages.locator: 卷二 太宗本紀上
passages.textZh: 建德自滎陽西上，築壘於板渚，太宗屯武牢，相持二十餘日。
passages.textEn: Jiande came west from Xingyang and built a camp at Banzhu; Taizong held Wulao, and they faced each other for over twenty days.

passages.sourceEn: Old Book of Tang (Liu Xu et al., 945)
passages.locator: 卷二 太宗本紀上
passages.textZh: 追奔三十里，斬首三千餘級，虜其眾五萬，生擒建德於陣。
passages.textEn: He pursued them thirty li, beheaded over three thousand, took fifty thousand prisoners and captured Jiande alive on the field.

passages.sourceEn: Old Book of Tang (Liu Xu et al., 945)
passages.locator: 卷二 太宗本紀上
passages.textZh: 乃將建德至東都城下。世充懼，率其官屬二千餘人詣軍門請降，山東悉平。
passages.textEn: He brought Jiande to the walls of the Eastern Capital. Shichong took fright and came to the camp gate with over two thousand of his officials to surrender; all the land east of the mountains was pacified.

label.zh: 建德自滎陽西上，壘板渚

names.name: Later Tang takes Bian (the end of Liang)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 後唐莊宗進至曹州，郡將出降；李嗣源率前軍至汴城，攻封丘門，梁開封尹王瓚以城降，莊宗率大軍繼至，自大梁門入。時梁末帝朱鍠已為其將皇甫麟所殺。
summary.en: Emperor Zhuangzong of Later Tang reached Caozhou, whose commander surrendered; Li Siyuan led the vanguard to Bian and attacked the Fengqiu gate, and Liang's prefect Wang Zan surrendered the city; the emperor followed with the main army through the Daliang gate. The last emperor of Liang, Zhu Huang, had already been killed by his officer Huangfu Lin.

passages.sourceEn: Old History of the Five Dynasties (Xue Juzheng et al., 974)
passages.locator: 卷三十 唐書 莊宗紀四
passages.textZh: 丁丑，次曹州，郡將出降。
passages.textEn: On dingchou he halted at Caozhou, whose commander came out and surrendered.

passages.sourceEn: Old History of the Five Dynasties (Xue Juzheng et al., 974)
passages.locator: 卷三十 唐書 莊宗紀四
passages.textZh: 己卯遲明，前軍至汴城，嗣源令左右捉生攻封丘門，梁開封尹王瓚請以城降。俄而帝與大軍繼至，王瓚迎帝自大梁門入。
passages.textEn: At dawn on jimao the vanguard reached Bian. Siyuan had his men attack the Fengqiu gate, and Wang Zan, Liang's prefect of Kaifeng, offered to surrender the city. Soon the emperor arrived with the main army, and Wang Zan received him in through the Daliang gate.

passages.sourceEn: Old History of the Five Dynasties (Xue Juzheng et al., 974)
passages.locator: 卷三十 唐書 莊宗紀四
passages.textZh: 時梁末帝朱鍠已為其將皇甫麟所殺，獲其首，函之以獻。
passages.textEn: By then the last emperor of Liang, Zhu Huang, had been killed by his officer Huangfu Lin; his head was found, boxed and presented.

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 忽必烈分三道進兵，過大渡河，行山谷二千餘里至金沙江，乘革囊及筏渡江。十二月軍薄大理城；大理主段氏微弱，國事決於高祥、高和兄弟，高祥當夜遁走，後被擒，斬於姚州。
summary.en: Khubilai advanced in three columns, crossed the Dadu River, marched over two thousand li through the mountains to the Jinsha River and crossed it on skins and rafts. In the twelfth month the army closed on Dali; its Duan rulers were weak and power lay with the brothers Gao Xiang and Gao He. Gao Xiang fled that night, was later caught, and was beheaded at Yaozhou.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷四 世祖本紀一 歲癸丑
passages.textZh: 九月壬寅，師次忒剌，分三道以進。
passages.textEn: On renyin of the ninth month the army halted at Tela and advanced in three columns.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷四 世祖本紀一 歲癸丑
passages.textZh: 冬十月丙午，過大渡河，又經行山谷二千餘里，至金沙江，乘革囊及栰以渡。
passages.textEn: On bingwu of the tenth month, in winter, it crossed the Dadu River, marched over two thousand li through mountain valleys to the Jinsha River, and crossed it on inflated skins and rafts.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷四 世祖本紀一 歲癸丑
passages.textZh: 十二月丙辰，軍薄大理城。初，大理主段氏微弱，國事皆決於高祥、高和兄弟。是夜，祥率眾遁去，命大將也古及拔突兒追之。
passages.textEn: On bingchen of the twelfth month the army closed on the city of Dali. The Duan rulers of Dali had long been weak, and affairs of state were decided by the brothers Gao Xiang and Gao He. That night Xiang fled with his followers, and the generals Yegu and Batur were sent after him.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷四 世祖本紀一 歲癸丑
passages.textZh: 癸亥，獲高祥，斬于姚州。
passages.textEn: On guihai Gao Xiang was caught and beheaded at Yaozhou.

label.en: In three columns across the Dadu River

label.zh: 經行山谷二千餘里，至金沙江

names.name: The Xiongnu raid through the Xiao Pass

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 漢文帝十四年，匈奴單于以十四萬騎入朝那、蕭關，殺北地都尉，大掠人畜，至彭陽；遣奇兵燒回中宮，候騎至雍、甘泉。單于留塞內月餘乃去，漢軍逐出塞即還。
summary.en: In the fourteenth year of Emperor Wen, the Xiongnu Shanyu came through Chaona and the Xiao Pass with a hundred and forty thousand horse, killed the commandant of Beidi, carried off people and herds and reached Pengyang; a raiding force burned the Huizhong palace and his scouts reached Yong and Ganquan. He stayed over a month inside the frontier before leaving; Han chased him out and turned back.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十 匈奴列傳
passages.textZh: 漢孝文皇帝十四年，匈奴單于十四萬騎入朝那、蕭關，殺北地都尉卬，虜人民畜產甚多，遂至彭陽。使奇兵入燒回中宮，候騎至雍甘泉。
passages.textEn: In the fourteenth year of Emperor Wen of Han the Shanyu entered Chaona and the Xiao Pass with a hundred and forty thousand horse, killed Ang, commandant of Beidi, carried off great numbers of people and herds, and reached Pengyang. He sent a raiding force to burn the Huizhong palace, and his scouts reached Yong and Ganquan.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十 匈奴列傳
passages.textZh: 單于留塞內月餘乃去，漢逐出塞即還，不能有所殺。
passages.textEn: The Shanyu stayed inside the frontier for over a month before leaving; Han chased him beyond the frontier and turned back, without killing any.

label.en: 140,000 horse through Chaona and the Xiao Pass

label.zh: 燒回中宮，候騎至雍、甘泉
label.en: Raiders burn Huizhong; scouts reach Ganquan

confidenceNote.zh: 龍城所在不可確考，圖上只示大致方向。
confidenceNote.en: Where Longcheng lay is unknown; the map shows only the direction.

summary.zh: 匈奴入上谷殺掠，漢遣衛青出上谷，公孫敖出代，公孫賀出雲中，李廣出雁門；衛青至龍城，獲首虜七百級（《史記》作數百）；李廣、公孫敖失師而還。
summary.en: After the Xiongnu raided Shanggu, Han sent Wei Qing out from Shanggu, Gongsun Ao from Dai, Gongsun He from Yunzhong and Li Guang from Yanmen; Wei Qing reached Longcheng and took seven hundred heads and prisoners (several hundred, says the Shiji); Li Guang and Gongsun Ao lost their armies.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Han (Ban Gu, c. 111)
passages.locator: 卷六 武帝紀 元光六年
passages.textZh: 匈奴入上谷，殺略吏民。遣車騎將軍衛青出上谷，騎將軍公孫敖出代，輕車將軍公孫賀出雲中，驍騎將軍 李廣出雁門。青至龍城，獲首虜七百級。廣、敖失師而還。
passages.textEn: The Xiongnu entered Shanggu, killing and carrying off officials and people. The General of Chariots and Cavalry Wei Qing was sent out from Shanggu, Gongsun Ao from Dai, Gongsun He from Yunzhong and Li Guang from Yanmen. Wei Qing reached Longcheng and took seven hundred heads and prisoners. Li Guang and Gongsun Ao lost their armies and came back.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十一 衛將軍驃騎列傳
passages.textZh: 青至蘢城，斬首虜數百。
passages.textEn: Wei Qing reached Longcheng and took several hundred heads and prisoners.

label.en: Wei Qing out from Shanggu to Longcheng

claim.en: The Shiji gives Yuanguang 5 (130 BCE).

accounts.quoteZh: 元光五年，青為車騎將軍

summary.zh: 金帥兀朮破和州，入建康，犯臨安，守臣或降或走；金人又陷明州，破定海，以舟師追襲高宗御舟，為張公裕所退。兀朮北還，與韓世忠戰於江中，縱火敗之，渡江屯六合。
summary.en: The Jin commander Wuzhu took Hezhou, entered Jiankang and attacked Lin'an, whose governors surrendered or fled; the Jin went on to take Mingzhou and Dinghai and sent ships after Emperor Gaozong's own vessel, until Zhang Gongyu beat them off. Turning north, Wuzhu fought Han Shizhong on the river, beat him with fire, and crossed back to camp at Liuhe.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷二十五 高宗紀二 建炎三年
passages.textZh: 戊申，金帥兀朮犯和州，守臣李儔以城降，通判唐璟死之。
passages.textEn: On wushen the Jin commander Wuzhu attacked Hezhou; its governor Li Chou surrendered the city and the vice-prefect Tang Jing died.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷二十五 高宗紀二 建炎三年
passages.textZh: 辛未，兀朮入建康府，守臣陳邦光、戶部尚書李棁迎拜，通判楊邦乂拒之。
passages.textEn: On xinwei Wuzhu entered Jiankang; its governor Chen Bangguang and the Minister of Revenue Li Zhuo welcomed him with bows, but the vice-prefect Yang Bangyi refused.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷二十五 高宗紀二 建炎三年
passages.textZh: 乙酉，兀朮犯臨安府，守臣康允之棄城走，錢塘縣令朱蹕死之。
passages.textEn: On yiyou Wuzhu attacked Lin'an; its governor Kang Yunzhi abandoned the city and Zhu Bi, magistrate of Qiantang, died.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷二十六 高宗紀三 建炎四年
passages.textZh: 己未，金人陷明州夜，大雨震電，乘勝破定海，以舟師來襲禦舟，張公裕以大舶擊退之。
passages.textEn: On jiwei the Jin took Mingzhou; that night, in a great storm of rain and lightning, they pressed on, broke Dinghai and came with ships against the emperor's own vessel, but Zhang Gongyu beat them off with large ships.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷二十六 高宗紀三 建炎四年
passages.textZh: 韓世忠及兀朮再戰江中，金人乘風縱火，世忠敗績。兀朮渡江，屯六合縣。
passages.textEn: Han Shizhong fought Wuzhu again on the river; the Jin set fires with the wind behind them and Han Shizhong was defeated. Wuzhu crossed back over the river and camped at Liuhe.

label.en: Dinghai, and ships after the emperor

label.zh: 北還，江中破韓世忠，渡江屯六合
label.en: North again, past Han Shizhong, back over the river

summary.zh: 新末起事之軍。更始二年冬分兩道入關，次年正月至弘農，連敗更始諸將；立劉盆子為天子，九月入長安，更始出降，後為其所殺。在關中焚西京宮室、發掘園陵。終在宜陽為光武所迫，君臣面縛而降。
summary.en: A rebel army of the last years of Xin. In the winter of the second Gengshi year it came in through the passes by two roads, reached Hongnong in the first month of the next year and beat the Gengshi generals again and again; it made Liu Penzi emperor, entered Chang'an in the ninth month, took the surrender of the Gengshi emperor and later had him killed. Within the passes it burned the palaces of the Western Capital and dug up the imperial tombs. In the end Guangwu cornered it at Yiyang, and its ruler and ministers came with their hands bound to surrender.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十一 劉玄劉盆子列傳
passages.textZh: 更始二年冬，崇、安自武關，宣等從陸渾關，兩道俱入。三年正月，俱至弘農，與更始諸將連戰剋勝，衆遂大集。
passages.textEn: In winter of the second Gengshi year Chong and An came in by the Wu Pass and Xuan and others by the Luhun Pass, two roads at once. In the first month of the third year both reached Hongnong, beat the Gengshi generals in battle after battle, and their numbers swelled.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 是月，赤眉立劉盆子為天子。
passages.textEn: That month the Red Eyebrows made Liu Penzi emperor.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 九月，赤眉入長安，更始奔高陵。
passages.textEn: In the ninth month the Red Eyebrows entered Chang'an and the Gengshi emperor fled to Gaoling.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十一 劉玄劉盆子列傳
passages.textZh: 於是祿使從兵與更始共牧馬於郊下，因令縊殺之。
passages.textEn: So Lu had soldiers go out with the Gengshi emperor to graze horses outside the city, and had them strangle him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 是月，赤眉焚西京宮室，發掘園陵，寇掠關中。大司徒鄧禹入長安，遣府掾奉十一帝神主，納於高廟。
passages.textEn: That month the Red Eyebrows burned the palaces of the Western Capital, dug up the imperial tombs and plundered the land within the passes. The Grand Minister over the Masses Deng Yu entered Chang'an and sent his officers to carry the spirit tablets of the eleven emperors into the temple of Gaozu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 馮異與赤眉戰於崤底，大破之，餘衆南向冝陽，帝自將征之。己亥，幸冝陽。甲辰，親勒六軍，大陳戎馬，大司馬吳漢精卒當前，中軍次之，驍騎、武衞分陳左右。赤眉望見震怖，遣使乞降。丙午，赤眉君臣面縛，奉高皇帝璽綬，詔以屬城門校尉。
passages.textEn: Feng Yi fought the Red Eyebrows at Xiaodi and crushed them; the rest of them headed south towards Yiyang, and the emperor led the campaign against them himself. On jihai he reached Yiyang. On jiachen he drew up the six armies in person, with a great display of horse: Grand Marshal Wu Han's picked troops in front, the central army behind them, the swift cavalry and the guards on either side. The Red Eyebrows were terrified at the sight and sent to beg for surrender. On bingwu the Red Eyebrow ruler and ministers came with their hands bound and handed over the seal of Emperor Gao, which he had placed in the keeping of the Colonel of the City Gates.

names.name: Tongma and the other bandit hosts

summary.zh: 新末各有別號的諸賊——銅馬、大肜、高湖、重連、鐵脛、大搶、尤來、上江、青犢、五校等，各領部曲，合數百萬人，所在寇掠。光武大破銅馬，盡收其降眾分配諸將，關西因號光武為「銅馬帝」。
summary.en: The bandit hosts of the last years of Xin, each under a name of its own — Tongma, Dachen, Gaohu, Chonglian, Tiejing, Daqiang, Youlai, Shangjiang, Qingdu, Wuxiao and others — each with its own bands, several million in all, plundering wherever they were. Guangwu crushed the Tongma and shared out all who surrendered among his generals, so that west of the passes he was called "the Tongma emperor".

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 又別號諸賊銅馬、大肜、高湖、重連、鐵脛、大搶、尤來、上江、青犢、五校、檀郷、五幡、五樓、富平、獲索等，各領部曲，衆合數百萬人，所在寇掠。
passages.textEn: There were also bandit hosts under names of their own — Tongma, Dachen, Gaohu, Chonglian, Tiejing, Daqiang, Youlai, Shangjiang, Qingdu, Wuxiao, Tanxiang, Wufan, Wulou, Fuping, Huosuo and others — each leading its own bands, several million in all, plundering wherever they were.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 悉將降人分配諸將，衆遂數十萬，故關西號光武為「銅馬帝」。
passages.textEn: He shared out all the surrendered men among his generals, so that his host grew to several hundred thousand; hence west of the passes Guangwu was called "the Tongma emperor".

summary.zh: 字聖公，立為天子，年號更始。王莽死後移都，二年二月自洛陽西行。赤眉入長安，更始奔高陵，十月肉袒詣長樂宮，上璽綬於劉盆子；其後謝祿使兵將他縊殺。
summary.en: Courtesy name Shenggong; he was made emperor with the reign title Gengshi. After Wang Mang's death he moved his court, setting out west from Luoyang in the second month of his second year. When the Red Eyebrows entered Chang'an he fled to Gaoling; in the tenth month he went stripped to the waist to the Changle Palace and handed his seals to Liu Penzi, and afterwards Xie Lu had soldiers strangle him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 二月辛巳，立劉聖公為天子，以伯升為大司徒，光武為太常偏將軍。
passages.textEn: On xinsi of the second month Liu Shenggong was made emperor, with Bosheng as Grand Minister over the Masses and Guangwu as Lieutenant General.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十一 劉玄劉盆子列傳
passages.textZh: 二年二月，更始自洛陽而西。
passages.textEn: In the second month of the second year the Gengshi emperor set out west from Luoyang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 九月，赤眉入長安，更始奔高陵。
passages.textEn: In the ninth month the Red Eyebrows entered Chang'an and the Gengshi emperor fled to Gaoling.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十一 劉玄劉盆子列傳
passages.textZh: 十月更始遂隨祿肉袒詣長樂宮，上璽綬於盆子。
passages.textEn: In the tenth month the Gengshi emperor went with Xie Lu, stripped to the waist, to the Changle Palace and handed his seals to Penzi.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十一 劉玄劉盆子列傳
passages.textZh: 於是祿使從兵與更始共牧馬於郊下，因令縊殺之。
passages.textEn: So Lu had soldiers go out with the Gengshi emperor to graze horses outside the city, and had them strangle him.

summary.zh: 卜者，林詐稱其為成帝子子輿，立為天子，都邯鄲，趙國以北、遼東以西皆從風而靡。光武圍邯鄲，五月甲辰拔其城，誅王郎。
summary.en: A diviner whom Lin passed off as Ziyu, son of Emperor Cheng, and made emperor at Handan; everything north of Zhao and west of Liaodong bowed to him. Guangwu besieged Handan, took it on jiachen of the fifth month and executed him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 林於是乃詐以卜者王郎為成帝子子輿，十二月，立郎為天子，都邯鄲，遂遣使者降下郡國。
passages.textEn: Lin then passed off the diviner Wang Lang as Ziyu, a son of Emperor Cheng; in the twelfth month he made Lang emperor with his capital at Handan, and sent envoys to bring the commanderies and kingdoms over.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 於是趙國以北，遼東以西，皆從風而靡。
passages.textEn: Then everything north of Zhao and west of Liaodong bowed to him like grass before the wind.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 王郎守將王饒堅守，月餘不下。郎遣將倪宏、劉奉率數萬人救鉅鹿，光武逆戰於南䜌，斬首數千級。四月，進圍邯鄲，連戰破之。五月甲辰，拔其城，誅王郎。
passages.textEn: Wang Lang's commander Wang Rao held out, and Julu did not fall for over a month. Lang sent his generals Ni Hong and Liu Feng with several tens of thousands to relieve it; Guangwu met them at Nanluan and took several thousand heads. In the fourth month he advanced and besieged Handan, beating its troops in battle after battle; on jiachen of the fifth month he took the city and executed Wang Lang.

summary.zh: 梁王，擅命睢陽；招沛人周建等為將帥，攻下濟陰、山陽、沛、楚、淮陽、汝南，凡二十八城。拜董憲、張步為大將軍，與共連兵，專據東方；更始敗後自稱天子。睢陽被圍，城中食盡，永走酇，為其將慶吾所斬（本紀作蓋延「獲劉永」）。
summary.en: King of Liang, ruling on his own authority at Suiyang. With Zhou Jian of Pei and others as his generals he took Jiyin, Shanyang, Pei, Chu, Huaiyang and Runan, twenty-eight cities in all. He made Dong Xian and Zhang Bu grand generals and joined forces with them, holding the east to themselves, and when the Gengshi emperor fell he proclaimed himself emperor. Besieged at Suiyang until the food ran out, he fled to Zan and was beheaded by his officer Qing Wu (the Annals say Gai Yan "captured Liu Yong").

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 是時長安政亂，四方背叛。梁王劉永擅命睢陽，公孫述稱王巴蜀，李憲自立為淮南王，秦豐自號楚黎王，張步起琅邪，董憲起東海，延岑起漢中，田戎起夷陵，並置將帥，侵略郡縣。
passages.textEn: At this time the government at Chang'an was in disorder and the four quarters rose against it. Liu Yong, King of Liang, ruled on his own authority at Suiyang; Gongsun Shu called himself king in Ba and Shu; Li Xian made himself King of Huainan; Qin Feng styled himself King of Chuli; Zhang Bu rose in Langye, Dong Xian in Donghai, Yan Cen in Hanzhong and Tian Rong at Yiling. Each appointed generals and overran commanderies and counties.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 遂招諸豪傑沛人周建等，並署爲將帥，攻下濟陰、山陽、沛、楚、淮陽、汝南，凡得二十八城。
passages.textEn: He gathered strong men such as Zhou Jian of Pei, made them all generals, and took Jiyin, Shanyang, Pei, Chu, Huaiyang and Runan — twenty-eight cities in all.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 是時東海人董憲起兵據其郡，而張步亦定齊地。永遣使拜憲翼漢大將軍，步輔漢大將軍，與共連兵，遂專據東方。及更始敗，永自稱天子。
passages.textEn: At this time Dong Xian of Donghai raised troops and held his commandery, and Zhang Bu also brought the land of Qi under him. Yong sent envoys making Xian Grand General Who Supports Han and Bu Grand General Who Aids Han, and joined forces with them, so that they held the east to themselves. When the Gengshi emperor fell, Yong proclaimed himself emperor.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 吳漢與蓋延等合軍圍之，城中食盡，永與茂、建走酇。諸將追急，永將慶吾斬永首降，封吾爲列侯。
passages.textEn: Wu Han and Gai Yan joined their armies and besieged the city; when the food inside ran out, Yong fled to Zan with Mao and Jian. With the generals in hot pursuit, Yong's officer Qing Wu cut off his head and surrendered, and was made a marquis.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 蓋延拔睢陽，獲劉永，而蘇茂、周建立永子紆為梁王。
passages.textEn: Gai Yan took Suiyang and captured Liu Yong, but Su Mao and Zhou Jian made Yong's son Yu King of Liang.

summary.zh: 起兵琅邪，平定齊地，受劉永輔漢大將軍之號，後為齊王；殺光祿大夫伏隆而反。專集齊地，據郡十二。耿弇破之於臨淄，步奔平壽，肉袒負斧锧詣軍門降。
summary.en: He rose in Langye and brought the land of Qi under him, took from Liu Yong the title of Grand General Who Aids Han and later King of Qi, and killed the envoy Fu Long. He gathered all Qi under him, holding twelve commanderies. Geng Yan routed him at Linzi; he fled to Pingshou and came to Yan's camp gate stripped to the waist with an axe and block on his back to surrender.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 是時長安政亂，四方背叛。梁王劉永擅命睢陽，公孫述稱王巴蜀，李憲自立為淮南王，秦豐自號楚黎王，張步起琅邪，董憲起東海，延岑起漢中，田戎起夷陵，並置將帥，侵略郡縣。
passages.textEn: At this time the government at Chang'an was in disorder and the four quarters rose against it. Liu Yong, King of Liang, ruled on his own authority at Suiyang; Gongsun Shu called himself king in Ba and Shu; Li Xian made himself King of Huainan; Qin Feng styled himself King of Chuli; Zhang Bu rose in Langye, Dong Xian in Donghai, Yan Cen in Hanzhong and Tian Rong at Yiling. Each appointed generals and overran commanderies and counties.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 是時東海人董憲起兵據其郡，而張步亦定齊地。永遣使拜憲翼漢大將軍，步輔漢大將軍，與共連兵，遂專據東方。及更始敗，永自稱天子。
passages.textEn: At this time Dong Xian of Donghai raised troops and held his commandery, and Zhang Bu also brought the land of Qi under him. Yong sent envoys making Xian Grand General Who Supports Han and Bu Grand General Who Aids Han, and joined forces with them, so that they held the east to themselves. When the Gengshi emperor fell, Yong proclaimed himself emperor.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 劉永立董憲為海西王，張步為齊王。步殺光祿大夫伏隆而反。
passages.textEn: Liu Yong made Dong Xian King of Haixi and Zhang Bu King of Qi. Bu killed the Imperial Household Grandee Fu Long and rebelled.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 是時帝方北憂漁陽，南事梁、楚，故步得專集齊地，據郡十二。
passages.textEn: At this time the emperor was worried about Yuyang in the north and busy with Liang and Chu in the south, so Bu was free to gather the land of Qi under him, holding twelve commanderies.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 弇因復追步，步奔平壽，乃肉袒負斧锧於軍門。
passages.textEn: Yan pursued Bu again; Bu fled to Pingshou, and then came to the gate of Yan's camp stripped to the waist with an axe and block on his back.

summary.zh: 東海人，起兵據其郡；劉永拜為翼漢大將軍，後立為海西王。光武攻之於昌慮，大破之；走保朐，吳漢圍之。本紀記吳漢拔朐「獲董憲」，〈劉永傳〉記吳漢校尉韓湛追斬憲於方與。
summary.en: A man of Donghai who raised troops and held his commandery; Liu Yong made him Grand General Who Supports Han and later King of Haixi. Guangwu crushed him at Changlü; he fell back to hold Qu, where Wu Han besieged him. The Annals say Wu Han took Qu and "captured Dong Xian"; the biography of Liu Yong says Wu Han's colonel Han Zhan pursued and beheaded him at Fangyu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 是時東海人董憲起兵據其郡，而張步亦定齊地。永遣使拜憲翼漢大將軍，步輔漢大將軍，與共連兵，遂專據東方。及更始敗，永自稱天子。
passages.textEn: At this time Dong Xian of Donghai raised troops and held his commandery, and Zhang Bu also brought the land of Qi under him. Yong sent envoys making Xian Grand General Who Supports Han and Bu Grand General Who Aids Han, and joined forces with them, so that they held the east to themselves. When the Gengshi emperor fell, Yong proclaimed himself emperor.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 劉永立董憲為海西王，張步為齊王。步殺光祿大夫伏隆而反。
passages.textEn: Liu Yong made Dong Xian King of Haixi and Zhang Bu King of Qi. Bu killed the Imperial Household Grandee Fu Long and rebelled.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 進幸湖陵，征董憲。又幸蕃，遂攻董憲於昌慮，大破之。
passages.textEn: He went on to Huling to campaign against Dong Xian, then to Fan, and attacked Dong Xian at Changlü, crushing him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 二月，大司馬吳漢拔朐，獲董憲、龐萌，山東悉平。
passages.textEn: In the second month Grand Marshal Wu Han took Qu and captured Dong Xian and Pang Meng; everything east of the mountains was pacified.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 而吳漢校尉韓湛追斬憲於方與，方與人黔陵亦斬萌，皆傳首洛陽。
passages.textEn: Wu Han's colonel Han Zhan pursued Xian and beheaded him at Fangyu, and Qian Ling of Fangyu beheaded Meng; both heads were sent to Luoyang.

summary.zh: 王莽任為偏將軍、廬江連率；莽敗後據郡自守，更始元年自稱淮南王，建武三年自立為天子，擁九城，眾十餘萬。馬成圍之於舒，六年正月拔之；本紀記「獲李憲」，〈李憲傳〉記憲亡走，為其軍士帛意追斬。
summary.en: Wang Mang made him a lieutenant general and governor of Lujiang; when Mang fell he held the commandery for himself, called himself King of Huainan in the first Gengshi year and emperor in the third year of Jianwu, with nine cities and over a hundred thousand men. Ma Cheng besieged him at Shu and took it in the first month of the sixth year; the Annals say Li Xian was captured, his biography that he fled and was beheaded by one of his own soldiers, Bo Yi.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 莽以憲爲偏將軍、廬江連率，擊破州公。莽敗，憲據郡自守。更始元年，自稱淮南王。建武三年，遂自立爲天子，置公卿百官，擁九城，衆十餘萬。
passages.textEn: Wang Mang made Xian a lieutenant general and governor of Lujiang, and he beat Wang Zhougong. When Mang fell, Xian held the commandery for himself. In the first Gengshi year he called himself King of Huainan, and in the third year of Jianwu made himself emperor, with ministers and officials, nine cities and over a hundred thousand men.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 四年秋，光武幸壽春，遣楊武將軍馬成等擊憲，圍舒。至六年正月，拔之。憲亡走，其軍士帛意追斬憲而降
passages.textEn: In autumn of the fourth year Guangwu went to Shouchun and sent Ma Cheng and others against Xian; they besieged Shu and took it in the first month of the sixth year. Xian fled, and one of his own soldiers, Bo Yi, went after him, beheaded him and surrendered

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 揚武將軍馬成等拔舒，獲李憲。
passages.textEn: Ma Cheng and the others took Shu and captured Li Xian.

summary.zh: 南郡人，據黎丘，自稱楚黎王，略取十二縣。岑彭、朱祐相繼圍之於黎丘，朱祐拔黎丘，獲秦豐。
summary.en: A man of Nan commandery who held Liqiu, called himself King of Chuli and seized twelve counties. Cen Peng and then Zhu You besieged him at Liqiu; Zhu You took the town and captured him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 南郡人秦豐據黎丘，自稱楚黎王，略十有二縣
passages.textEn: Qin Feng of Nan commandery held Liqiu, called himself King of Chuli and seized twelve counties

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 秋七月，征南大將軍岑彭率三將軍伐秦豐，戰於黎丘，大破之，獲其將蔡宏。
passages.textEn: In autumn, in the seventh month, Cen Peng, Grand General Who Conquers the South, led three generals against Qin Feng, fought him at Liqiu, crushed him and captured his general Cai Hong.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 六月，建義大將軍朱祐拔黎丘，獲秦豐
passages.textEn: In the sixth month Zhu You took Liqiu and captured Qin Feng

summary.zh: 起兵夷陵，擁眾據守。岑彭擊破之，拔夷陵，追至秭歸，戎亡入蜀。後為公孫述將，與任滿據荊門；荊門破後亡保江州，馮駿拔江州，獲田戎。
summary.en: He rose at Yiling and held it with his followers. Cen Peng routed him, took Yiling and chased him to Zigui, and he fled into Shu. Later, as a general of Gongsun Shu, he held Jingmen with Ren Man; when Jingmen fell he fled to hold Jiangzhou, and Feng Jun took Jiangzhou and captured him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 時田戎擁眾夷陵，聞秦豐被圍，懼大兵方至，欲降。
passages.textEn: Tian Rong was then holding Yiling with his followers; hearing that Qin Feng was under siege, and fearing the great army would come on to him, he thought of surrendering.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 使彭與傅俊南擊田戎，大破之，遂拔夷陵，追至秭歸。戎與數十騎亡入蜀，盡獲其妻子士眾數萬人。
passages.textEn: He sent Peng and Fu Jun south against Tian Rong; they crushed him, took Yiling and pursued him to Zigui. Rong fled into Shu with a few dozen horsemen, and they captured his wife and children and tens of thousands of his men.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 公孫述遣將田戎、任滿據荊門。
passages.textEn: Gongsun Shu sent his generals Tian Rong and Ren Man to hold Jingmen.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 時天風狂急，奇船逆流而上，直沖浮橋，而欑柱鉤不得去，奇等乘勢殊死戰，因飛炬焚之，風怒火盛，橋樓崩燒。彭復悉軍順風並進，所向無前。蜀兵大亂，溺死者數千人。斬任滿，生獲程汎，而田戎亡保江州。
passages.textEn: A fierce wind was blowing. Lu Qi's boat went upstream and rammed straight into the floating bridge, where the stakes caught it and it could not get free; Qi and his men fought to the death where they were and threw torches, and with the wind roaring and the fire blazing the bridge and its towers burned and collapsed. Peng then sent his whole army forward with the wind behind it, and nothing could stand before it. The Shu troops fell into confusion and several thousand drowned. Ren Man was beheaded and Cheng Fan taken alive, while Tian Rong fled to hold Jiangzhou.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 秋七月，威虜將軍馮駿拔江州，獲田戎。
passages.textEn: In autumn, in the seventh month, Feng Jun took Jiangzhou and captured Tian Rong.

summary.zh: 漁陽太守，曾遣吳漢等率突騎助光武擊王郎。後反，攻幽州牧朱浮於薊，陷薊城，自立為燕王，並以美女繒綵結好匈奴，單于遣騎助之。終為其蒼頭所殺，漁陽平。
summary.en: Governor of Yuyang, who sent Wu Han and others with shock cavalry to help Guangwu against Wang Lang. Later he rebelled, attacked Zhu Fu, Governor of You Province, at Ji, took the city and made himself King of Yan, courting the Xiongnu with women and silks so that the chanyu sent horsemen to help him. In the end he was killed by his own slaves, and Yuyang was pacified.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 會上谷太守耿況、漁陽太守彭寵各遣其將吳漢、寇恂等將突騎來助擊王郎，更始亦遣尚書僕射謝躬討郎，光武因大饗士卒，遂東圍鉅鹿。
passages.textEn: Just then Geng Kuang, governor of Shanggu, and Peng Chong, governor of Yuyang, each sent their officers, Wu Han, Kou Xun and others, with shock cavalry to help attack Wang Lang, and the Gengshi emperor also sent his Deputy Director of the Secretariat Xie Gong against Lang. Guangwu feasted his troops and went east to besiege Julu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 漁陽太守彭寵反，攻幽州牧朱浮於薊。
passages.textEn: Peng Chong, governor of Yuyang, rebelled and attacked Zhu Fu, Governor of You Province, at Ji.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 彭寵陷薊城，寵自立為燕王。
passages.textEn: Peng Chong took the city of Ji and made himself King of Yan.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 明年春，寵遂拔右北平、上谷數縣。遣使以美女繒綵賂遺匈奴，要結和親。單于使左南將軍七八千騎，往來爲游兵以助寵。
passages.textEn: The next spring Chong took several counties of Youbeiping and Shanggu. He sent envoys with beautiful women and silks to the Xiongnu to seek an alliance by marriage, and the chanyu sent his General of the Left South with seven or eight thousand horsemen to range about as a flying column in Chong's support.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 彭寵為其蒼頭所殺，漁陽平。
passages.textEn: Peng Chong was killed by his own slaves, and Yuyang was pacified.

summary.zh: 新末起兵，分遣諸將徇隴西、武都、金城、武威、張掖、酒泉、敦煌，皆下之。更始二年應徵入長安，後為更始所圍，潰圍亡歸天水，據故地，自稱西州上將軍。其後受光武西州大將軍之號，建武六年反；七年公孫述立為朔寧王。八年光武親征，隴右潰，囂奔西城，旋復得四郡。九年春病餓，恚憤而死。
summary.en: He rose at the end of Xin and sent his generals to Longxi, Wudu, Jincheng, Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan and Dunhuang, all of which submitted. In the second Gengshi year he answered the emperor's summons to Chang'an; later, surrounded there on the emperor's orders, he broke out and fled home to Tianshui, held his old lands and called himself Supreme General of the Western Province. He then took from Guangwu the title Grand General of the Western Province, rebelled in the sixth year of Jianwu, and in the seventh was made King of Shuoning by Gongsun Shu. In the eighth year Guangwu marched against him; Longyou collapsed and he fled to Xicheng, but soon had four commanderies back. In spring of the ninth year, ill and starving, he died in a fit of rage.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十三 隗囂公孫述列傳
passages.textZh: 囂遂分遣諸將徇隴西、武都、金城、武威、張掖、酒泉、敦煌，皆下之。
passages.textEn: Xiao then sent his generals out separately to Longxi, Wudu, Jincheng, Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan and Dunhuang, and all of them submitted.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十三 隗囂公孫述列傳
passages.textZh: 更始二年，遣使征囂及崔、義等。囂將行，方望以為更始未可知，固止之，囂不聽。
passages.textEn: In the second Gengshi year the emperor sent envoys summoning Xiao, Cui, Yi and the others. As Xiao was about to go, Fang Wang, who thought the Gengshi emperor's prospects uncertain, urged him strongly not to, but Xiao would not listen.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十三 隗囂公孫述列傳
passages.textZh: 更始使執金吾鄧曄將兵圍囂，囂閉門拒守；至昏時，遂潰圍，與數十騎夜斬平城門關，亡歸天水。復招聚其眾，據故地，自稱西州上將軍。
passages.textEn: The Gengshi emperor had Deng Ye, Bearer of the Golden Mace, surround Xiao with troops; Xiao barred his gates and held out, and at dusk broke through, cut his way out through the Pingcheng gate by night with a few dozen horsemen and fled home to Tianshui. There he gathered his followers again, held his old lands, and called himself Supreme General of the Western Province.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 是歲，李憲自稱天子。西州大將軍隗嚻奉奏。
passages.textEn: This year Li Xian proclaimed himself emperor. Wei Xiao, Grand General of the Western Province, sent up a memorial.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 隗嚻反，蓋延等因與嚻戰於隴阺，諸將敗績。
passages.textEn: Wei Xiao rebelled; Gai Yan and the others fought him on the Long slope, and the generals were routed.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 公孫述立隗嚻爲朔寧王。
passages.textEn: Gongsun Shu made Wei Xiao King of Shuoning.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十三 隗囂公孫述列傳
passages.textZh: 元等決圍，殊死戰，遂得入城，迎囂歸冀。會吳漢等食盡退去，於是安定、北地、天水、隴西復反為囂。
passages.textEn: Wang Yuan and the others broke through the siege lines, fought desperately, got into the city and took Xiao back to Ji. Just then Wu Han and the others ran out of food and withdrew, and Anding, Beidi, Tianshui and Longxi went back over to Xiao.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十三 隗囂公孫述列傳
passages.textZh: 九年春，囂病且餓，出城餐糗糒，恚憤而死。王元、周宗立囂少子純為王。明年，來歙、耿弇、蓋延等攻破落門，周宗、行巡、苛宇、趙恢等將純降。
passages.textEn: In spring of the ninth year Xiao, ill and starving, came out of the city to eat parched grain and died in a fit of rage. Wang Yuan and Zhou Zong made his youngest son Chun king. The next year Lai Xi, Geng Yan, Gai Yan and the others broke through at Luomen, and Zhou Zong, Xing Xun, Ke Yu, Zhao Hui and the others brought Chun in to surrender.

summary.zh: 河西諸郡推其行河西五郡大將軍事，以梁統等為武威、張掖、酒泉、敦煌、金城太守。建武五年始遣使貢獻；八年率五郡太守與光武會於高平，共伐隗囂。隴、蜀平後，與五郡太守奏事京師。
summary.en: The commanderies of Hexi put him forward as acting Grand General of their five commanderies, with Liang Tong and others as governors of Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan, Dunhuang and Jincheng. In the fifth year of Jianwu he first sent tribute; in the eighth he brought the five governors to meet Guangwu at Gaoping against Wei Xiao. When Long and Shu were pacified he and the five governors came to report at the capital.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷二十三 竇融列傳
passages.textZh: 議既定，而各謙讓，咸以融世任河西為吏，人所敬向，乃推融行河西五郡大將軍事。
passages.textEn: When the plan was agreed, each declined in favour of the others; since Rong's family had served in Hexi for generations and he was respected by the people, they all put him forward as acting Grand General of the five commanderies of Hexi.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷二十三 竇融列傳
passages.textZh: 於是以梁統為武威太守，史苞為張掖太守，竺曾為酒泉太守，辛肜為敦煌太守，厙鈞為金城太守。
passages.textEn: So Liang Tong was made governor of Wuwei, Shi Bao of Zhangye, Zhu Zeng of Jiuquan, Xin Rong of Dunhuang and She Jun of Jincheng.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 河西大將軍竇融始遣使貢獻。
passages.textEn: Dou Rong, Grand General of Hexi, first sent envoys with tribute.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 隗嚻攻來歙，不能下。閏月，帝自征嚻，河西太守竇融率五郡太守與車駕會高平。隴右潰，隗嚻奔西城，遣大司馬吳漢、征南大將軍岑彭圍之；進幸上邽，不降，命虎牙大將軍蓋延、建威大將軍耿弇攻之。
passages.textEn: Wei Xiao attacked Lai Xi but could not take the city. In the intercalary month the emperor led the campaign against Xiao himself; Dou Rong brought the governors of the five commanderies of Hexi to meet him at Gaoping. Longyou collapsed and Wei Xiao fled to Xicheng; the emperor sent Grand Marshal Wu Han and Cen Peng to besiege him there, went on to Shanggui, which would not surrender, and ordered Gai Yan and Geng Yan to attack it.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷二十三 竇融列傳
passages.textZh: 及隴、蜀平，詔融與五郡太守奏事京師，官屬賓客相隨，駕乘千餘兩，馬、牛、羊被野。
passages.textEn: When Long and Shu had been pacified, Rong and the governors of the five commanderies were summoned to report at the capital; officers and guests followed them, over a thousand carriages, with horses, oxen and sheep covering the fields.

summary.zh: 起兵安定。建武五年，李興、閔堪至單于庭迎芳入塞，都九原，掠有五原、朔方、雲中、定襄、鴈門五郡，與胡通兵，侵苦北邊；十二月自稱天子。其所置朔方、雲中太守後舉郡降漢。終自五原亡入匈奴（本紀繫於十三年，〈盧芳傳〉繫於十二年）。
summary.en: He rose at Anding. In the fifth year of Jianwu Li Xing and Min Kan brought him back from the chanyu's court to Jiuyuan, from where he seized and held Wuyuan, Shuofang, Yunzhong, Dingxiang and Yanmen, making common cause with the Hu and harrying the northern frontier; in the twelfth month he proclaimed himself emperor. His governors of Shuofang and Yunzhong later surrendered their commanderies to Han. In the end he fled from Wuyuan into the Xiongnu (the Annals put this in the thirteenth year, his biography in the twelfth).

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 赤眉殺更始，而隗嚻據隴右，盧芳起安定。
passages.textEn: The Red Eyebrows killed the Gengshi emperor; Wei Xiao held Longyou, and Lu Fang rose at Anding.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 五年，李興、閔堪引兵至單于庭迎芳，與俱入塞，都九原縣。掠有五原、朔方、雲中、定襄、鴈門五郡，並置守令，與胡通兵，侵苦北邊。
passages.textEn: In the fifth year Li Xing and Min Kan led troops to the chanyu's court to fetch Fang, came back inside the frontier with him and made Jiuyuan his capital. He seized and held five commanderies — Wuyuan, Shuofang, Yunzhong, Dingxiang and Yanmen — appointing governors and magistrates in all of them, made common cause with the Hu, and harried the northern frontier.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 十二月，盧芳自稱天子於九原。
passages.textEn: In the twelfth month Lu Fang proclaimed himself emperor at Jiuyuan.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 冬，盧芳所置朔方太守田颯、雲中太守喬扈各舉郡降。
passages.textEn: In winter Tian Sa and Qiao Hu, whom Lu Fang had made governors of Shuofang and Yunzhong, each surrendered their commanderies.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 盧芳自五原亡入匈奴。
passages.textEn: Lu Fang fled from Wuyuan into the Xiongnu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 十二年，芳與賈覽共攻雲中，乆不下，其將隨昱留守九原，欲脅芳降。芳知羽翼外附，心膂內離，遂棄輜重，與十餘騎亡入匈奴，其衆盡歸隨昱。
passages.textEn: In the twelfth year Fang and Jia Lan attacked Yunzhong together but could not take it for a long time; his general Sui Yu, left holding Jiuyuan, meant to force him to surrender. Knowing that his supporters outside were going over and his trusted men within were turning away, Fang abandoned his baggage and fled with a dozen horsemen into the Xiongnu, and all his men went over to Sui Yu.

question.en: In which year did Lu Fang flee to the Xiongnu?

claim.zh: 建武十三年二月，自五原亡入匈奴。
claim.en: In the second month of the thirteenth year of Jianwu, from Wuyuan.

accounts.quoteZh: 盧芳自五原亡入匈奴。

claim.zh: 建武十二年，攻雲中不下，部將隨昱欲脅其降，芳遂亡入匈奴。
claim.en: In the twelfth year, after failing to take Yunzhong, when his officer Sui Yu meant to force him to surrender.

accounts.quoteZh: 芳知羽翼外附，心膂內離，遂棄輜重，與十餘騎亡入匈奴

summary.zh: 建武元年四月自立為天子，號成家。越巂任貴亦據郡來降；述使侯丹開白水關、北守南鄭，任滿從閬中下江州、東據扞關，〈公孫述傳〉稱其「盡有益州之地」（然益州郡太守文齊、牂柯謝暹皆未從）。後立隗囂為朔寧王。建武十二年十一月，吳漢、臧宮戰於成都，大破之，述被創夜死。
summary.en: In the fourth month of the first Jianwu year he made himself emperor of a state he called Chengjia. Ren Gui of Yuexi came over with his commandery; Shu had Hou Dan open the Baishui Pass and hold Nanzheng to the north, and Ren Man go down from Langzhong to Jiangzhou and hold the Han Pass to the east, so that his biography says he "held all the land of Yi" (though Wen Qi, governor of Yizhou, and Xie Xian in Zangke never joined him). He later made Wei Xiao King of Shuoning. In the eleventh month of the twelfth year Wu Han and Zang Gong crushed him at Chengdu; he was wounded and died that night.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十三 隗囂公孫述列傳
passages.textZh: 建武元年四月，遂自立為天子，號成家。
passages.textEn: In the fourth month of the first Jianwu year he made himself emperor, calling his state Chengjia.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十三 隗囂公孫述列傳
passages.textZh: 越巂任貴亦殺王莽大尹而據郡降。述遂使將軍侯丹開白水關，北守南鄭；將軍任滿從閬中下江州，東據扞關。於是盡有益州之地。
passages.textEn: Ren Gui of Yuexi also killed Wang Mang's governor and surrendered with his commandery. Shu then had his general Hou Dan open the Baishui Pass and hold Nanzheng to the north, and his general Ren Man go down from Langzhong to Jiangzhou and hold the Han Pass to the east. With that he held all the land of Yi Province.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷八十六 南蠻西南夷列傳
passages.textZh: 及公孫述據益土，齊固守拒險，述拘其妻子，許以封侯，齊遂不降。聞光武即位，乃間道遣使自聞。
passages.textEn: When Gongsun Shu held Yi, Wen Qi held firm behind the passes; Shu seized his wife and children and offered him a marquisate, but Qi would not surrender. Hearing that Guangwu had taken the throne, he sent envoys by back roads to report himself.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷八十六 南蠻西南夷列傳
passages.textZh: 公孫述時，大姓龍、傅、尹、董氏，與郡功曹謝暹保境爲漢，乃遣使從番禺江奉貢。
passages.textEn: In Gongsun Shu's time the great families Long, Fu, Yin and Dong, with the commandery's Officer of Merit Xie Xian, held their borders for Han and sent envoys with tribute by the Panyu River.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 公孫述立隗嚻爲朔寧王。
passages.textEn: Gongsun Shu made Wei Xiao King of Shuoning.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 冬十一月戊寅，吳漢、臧宮與公孫述戰於成都，大破之。述被創，夜死。辛巳，吳漢屠成都，夷述宗族及延岑等。
passages.textEn: On wuyin of the eleventh month, in winter, Wu Han and Zang Gong fought Gongsun Shu at Chengdu and crushed him. Shu was wounded and died that night. On xinsi Wu Han put Chengdu to the sword and wiped out Shu's clan, Yan Cen and others.

question.en: Did Gongsun Shu hold all of Yi Province?

claim.zh: 越巂來降，北守南鄭，東據扞關，「於是盡有益州之地」。
claim.en: Yuexi came over and he held Nanzheng and the Han Pass: "he held all the land of Yi".

accounts.quoteZh: 於是盡有益州之地。

claim.zh: 益州郡太守文齊固守拒險，不降於述，遣使自通光武。
claim.en: Wen Qi, governor of Yizhou commandery, held out against Shu and sent envoys to Guangwu.

accounts.quoteZh: 齊固守拒險，述拘其妻子，許以封侯，齊遂不降。

claim.zh: 牂柯大姓與功曹謝暹保境為漢，遣使從番禺江奉貢。
claim.en: In Zangke the great families and Xie Xian held their borders for Han and sent tribute by the Panyu River.

accounts.quoteZh: 與郡功曹謝暹保境爲漢

summary.zh: 光武之破虜將軍，據淯陽反。岑彭率八將軍討之於堵鄉；光武自將征之，大破鄧奉於小長安，斬之。
summary.en: Guangwu's General Who Smashes the Caitiffs; he seized Yuyang and rebelled. Cen Peng led eight generals against him at Duxiang, and Guangwu, leading the campaign himself, crushed him at Xiao Chang'an and beheaded him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 破虜將軍鄧奉據淯陽反。
passages.textEn: Deng Feng, General Who Smashes the Caitiffs, seized Yuyang and rebelled.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 冬十一月，以廷尉岑彭為征南大將軍，率八將軍討鄧奉於堵郷。
passages.textEn: In winter, in the eleventh month, the Commandant of Justice Cen Peng was made Grand General Who Conquers the South and led eight generals against Deng Feng at Duxiang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 帝自將征鄧奉，幸堵陽。夏四月，大破鄧奉於小長安，斬之。
passages.textEn: The emperor led the campaign against Deng Feng himself and went to Duyang. In summer, in the fourth month, he crushed Deng Feng at Xiao Chang'an and beheaded him.

summary.zh: 起兵漢中，自稱武安王。曾大破赤眉於杜陵；後先後為馮異破於上林、耿弇大破於穰、朱祐敗於東陽。後為公孫述將，為臧宮大破於沈水；成都破後，與述宗族同被誅滅。
summary.en: He rose in Hanzhong and called himself King of Wu'an. He crushed the Red Eyebrows at Duling, but was then beaten by Feng Yi at Shanglin, crushed by Geng Yan at Rang and defeated by Zhu You at Dongyang. Later, as a general of Gongsun Shu, he was crushed by Zang Gong on the Chen River, and when Chengdu fell he was put to death with Shu's clan.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 是時長安政亂，四方背叛。梁王劉永擅命睢陽，公孫述稱王巴蜀，李憲自立為淮南王，秦豐自號楚黎王，張步起琅邪，董憲起東海，延岑起漢中，田戎起夷陵，並置將帥，侵略郡縣。
passages.textEn: At this time the government at Chang'an was in disorder and the four quarters rose against it. Liu Yong, King of Liang, ruled on his own authority at Suiyang; Gongsun Shu called himself king in Ba and Shu; Li Xian made himself King of Huainan; Qin Feng styled himself King of Chuli; Zhang Bu rose in Langye, Dong Xian in Donghai, Yan Cen in Hanzhong and Tian Rong at Yiling. Each appointed generals and overran commanderies and counties.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 延岑自稱武安王於漢中。
passages.textEn: Yan Cen called himself King of Wu'an in Hanzhong.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 延岑大破赤眉於杜陵。
passages.textEn: Yan Cen crushed the Red Eyebrows at Duling.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 馮異與延岑戰於上林，破之。
passages.textEn: Feng Yi fought Yan Cen at Shanglin and beat him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 耿弇與延岑戰於穰，大破之。
passages.textEn: Geng Yan fought Yan Cen at Rang and crushed him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 建義大將軍朱祐率祭遵與延岑戰於東陽，斬其將張成。
passages.textEn: Zhu You, Grand General Who Establishes Righteousness, with Ji Zun fought Yan Cen at Dongyang and beheaded his general Zhang Cheng.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 八月，岑彭破公孫述將侯丹於黃石。輔威將軍臧宮與公孫述將延岑戰於沈水，大破之。王元降。
passages.textEn: In the eighth month Cen Peng beat Gongsun Shu's general Hou Dan at Huangshi. Zang Gong, General Who Supports Might, fought Gongsun Shu's general Yan Cen at the Chen River and crushed him. Wang Yuan surrendered.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 冬十一月戊寅，吳漢、臧宮與公孫述戰於成都，大破之。述被創，夜死。辛巳，吳漢屠成都，夷述宗族及延岑等。
passages.textEn: On wuyin of the eleventh month, in winter, Wu Han and Zang Gong fought Gongsun Shu at Chengdu and crushed him. Shu was wounded and died that night. On xinsi Wu Han put Chengdu to the sword and wiped out Shu's clan, Yan Cen and others.

summary.zh: 光武之平狄將軍，反叛，殺楚郡太守孫萌，襲破蓋延，東附董憲，自號東平王。光武大破之於桃城；後與董憲同保朐，吳漢拔朐（本紀作「獲」，〈劉永傳〉作為方與人黔陵所斬）。
summary.en: Guangwu's General Who Pacifies the Di; he rebelled, killed Sun Meng, governor of Chu, beat Gai Yan and went east to join Dong Xian, styling himself King of Dongping. Guangwu crushed him at Taocheng; later he held Qu with Dong Xian until Wu Han took it (the Annals say he was captured, the biography of Liu Yong that Qian Ling of Fangyu beheaded him).

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 平狄將軍龐萌反，殺楚郡太守孫萌而東附董憲。
passages.textEn: Pang Meng, General Who Pacifies the Di, rebelled, killed Sun Meng, governor of Chu commandery, and went east to join Dong Xian.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 時平狄將軍龐萌反叛，遂襲破蓋延，引兵與董憲連和，自號東平王，屯桃鄉之北。
passages.textEn: At this time Pang Meng, General Who Pacifies the Di, rebelled, fell on Gai Yan and beat him, led his troops to join Dong Xian, styled himself King of Dongping and camped north of Taoxiang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 而龐萌、蘇茂圍桃城。帝時幸蒙，因自將征之。先理兵任城，乃進救桃城，大破萌等。
passages.textEn: Meanwhile Pang Meng and Su Mao were besieging Taocheng. The emperor, then at Meng, led the campaign himself: he first gathered his troops at Rencheng, then advanced to relieve Taocheng and crushed Meng and the others.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 二月，大司馬吳漢拔朐，獲董憲、龐萌，山東悉平。
passages.textEn: In the second month Grand Marshal Wu Han took Qu and captured Dong Xian and Pang Meng; everything east of the mountains was pacified.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 而吳漢校尉韓湛追斬憲於方與，方與人黔陵亦斬萌，皆傳首洛陽。
passages.textEn: Wu Han's colonel Han Zhan pursued Xian and beheaded him at Fangyu, and Qian Ling of Fangyu beheaded Meng; both heads were sent to Luoyang.

summary.zh: 初為漁陽將，率突騎助光武擊王郎；北發十郡兵，斬不從命的幽州牧苗曾。光武即位後拜大司馬，圍朱鮪於洛陽，於朐俘董憲、龐萌，又於成都大破公孫述。
summary.en: First an officer of Yuyang who brought shock cavalry to help Guangwu against Wang Lang, he raised the troops of ten commanderies in the north, beheading Miao Zeng, Governor of You Province, who would not comply. After Guangwu took the throne he became Grand Marshal, besieged Zhu Wei at Luoyang, captured Dong Xian and Pang Meng at Qu, and crushed Gongsun Shu at Chengdu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 會上谷太守耿況、漁陽太守彭寵各遣其將吳漢、寇恂等將突騎來助擊王郎，更始亦遣尚書僕射謝躬討郎，光武因大饗士卒，遂東圍鉅鹿。
passages.textEn: Just then Geng Kuang, governor of Shanggu, and Peng Chong, governor of Yuyang, each sent their officers, Wu Han, Kou Xun and others, with shock cavalry to help attack Wang Lang, and the Gengshi emperor also sent his Deputy Director of the Secretariat Xie Gong against Lang. Guangwu feasted his troops and went east to besiege Julu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 先遣吳漢北發十郡兵。幽州牧苗曾不從，漢遂斬曾而發其衆。
passages.textEn: He first sent Wu Han north to raise the troops of ten commanderies. Miao Zeng, Governor of You Province, would not comply; Han beheaded him and raised his men.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 壬午，以大將軍吳漢為大司馬
passages.textEn: On renwu Grand General Wu Han was made Grand Marshal

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 己亥，幸懷。遣耿弇率彊弩將軍陳俊軍五社津，備滎陽以東。使吳漢率朱祐及廷尉岑彭、執金吾賈復、揚化將軍堅鐔等十一將軍圍朱鮪於洛陽。
passages.textEn: On jihai he went to Huai. He sent Geng Yan with Chen Jun, General of Strong Crossbows, to camp at the Wushe ford and guard against anything east of Xingyang, and had Wu Han lead Zhu You, the Commandant of Justice Cen Peng, the Bearer of the Golden Mace Jia Fu, Jian Tan and eleven generals in all to besiege Zhu Wei in Luoyang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 二月，大司馬吳漢拔朐，獲董憲、龐萌，山東悉平。
passages.textEn: In the second month Grand Marshal Wu Han took Qu and captured Dong Xian and Pang Meng; everything east of the mountains was pacified.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 冬十一月戊寅，吳漢、臧宮與公孫述戰於成都，大破之。述被創，夜死。辛巳，吳漢屠成都，夷述宗族及延岑等。
passages.textEn: On wuyin of the eleventh month, in winter, Wu Han and Zang Gong fought Gongsun Shu at Chengdu and crushed him. Shu was wounded and died that night. On xinsi Wu Han put Chengdu to the sword and wiped out Shu's clan, Yan Cen and others.

summary.zh: 光武遣其率六裨將西進，乘更始、赤眉之亂。自箕關入河東，於安邑大破更始定國公王匡；拜大司徒，入長安，奉十一帝神主納於高廟。
summary.en: Guangwu sent him west with six lieutenants to profit from the turmoil between the Gengshi emperor and the Red Eyebrows. He broke into Hedong by the Ji Pass and routed the Gengshi Duke of Dingguo, Wang Kuang, at Anyi; made Grand Minister over the Masses, he entered Chang'an and placed the spirit tablets of the eleven emperors in the temple of Gaozu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 青犢、赤眉賊入函谷關，攻更始。光武乃遣鄧禹率六裨將引兵而西，以乘更始、赤眉之亂。時更始使大司馬朱鮪、舞陰王李軼等屯洛陽，光武亦令馮異守孟津以拒之。
passages.textEn: The Qingdu and Red Eyebrow bandits came through the Hangu Pass and attacked the Gengshi emperor. Guangwu then sent Deng Yu with six lieutenants west, to take advantage of the turmoil between the Gengshi emperor and the Red Eyebrows. The Gengshi emperor had his Grand Marshal Zhu Wei, Li Yi the King of Wuyin and others holding Luoyang, and Guangwu had Feng Yi guard Mengjin against them.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十六 鄧寇列傳
passages.textZh: 建武元年正月，禹自箕關將入河東，河東都尉守關不開，禹攻十日，破之，獲輜重千餘乘。進圍安邑，數月未能下。
passages.textEn: In the first month of the first Jianwu year Yu was about to enter Hedong by the Ji Pass; the Commandant of Hedong held the pass shut, and Yu attacked it for ten days, broke through and took over a thousand wagons of supplies. He advanced and besieged Anyi, but could not take it for several months.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 甲子，前將軍鄧禹擊更始定國公王匡於安邑，大破之，斬其將劉均。
passages.textEn: On jiazi the General of the Van Deng Yu attacked the Gengshi emperor's Duke of Dingguo, Wang Kuang, at Anyi, routed him and beheaded his officer Liu Jun.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 是月，赤眉焚西京宮室，發掘園陵，寇掠關中。大司徒鄧禹入長安，遣府掾奉十一帝神主，納於高廟。
passages.textEn: That month the Red Eyebrows burned the palaces of the Western Capital, dug up the imperial tombs and plundered the land within the passes. The Grand Minister over the Masses Deng Yu entered Chang'an and sent his officers to carry the spirit tablets of the eleven emperors into the temple of Gaozu.

summary.zh: 光武令其守孟津以拒洛陽的更始軍，與寇恂大破蘇茂於溫。後代鄧禹伐赤眉，大破之於崤底；又破延岑於上林，拒破隗囂之兵。
summary.en: Guangwu had him guard Mengjin against the Gengshi army in Luoyang; with Kou Xun he routed Su Mao at Wen. He then replaced Deng Yu against the Red Eyebrows and crushed them at Xiaodi, beat Yan Cen at Shanglin and held off Wei Xiao's raids.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 青犢、赤眉賊入函谷關，攻更始。光武乃遣鄧禹率六裨將引兵而西，以乘更始、赤眉之亂。時更始使大司馬朱鮪、舞陰王李軼等屯洛陽，光武亦令馮異守孟津以拒之。
passages.textEn: The Qingdu and Red Eyebrow bandits came through the Hangu Pass and attacked the Gengshi emperor. Guangwu then sent Deng Yu with six lieutenants west, to take advantage of the turmoil between the Gengshi emperor and the Red Eyebrows. The Gengshi emperor had his Grand Marshal Zhu Wei, Li Yi the King of Wuyin and others holding Luoyang, and Guangwu had Feng Yi guard Mengjin against them.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 朱鮪遣討難將軍蘇茂攻溫，馮異、寇恂與戰，大破之，斬其將賈彊。
passages.textEn: Zhu Wei sent Su Mao, General Who Punishes Trouble, to attack Wen; Feng Yi and Kou Xun fought him and routed him, beheading his officer Jia Qiang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 遣偏將軍馮異代鄧禹伐赤眉。
passages.textEn: He sent Lieutenant General Feng Yi to replace Deng Yu against the Red Eyebrows.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 馮異與赤眉戰於崤底，大破之，餘衆南向冝陽，帝自將征之。己亥，幸冝陽。甲辰，親勒六軍，大陳戎馬，大司馬吳漢精卒當前，中軍次之，驍騎、武衞分陳左右。赤眉望見震怖，遣使乞降。丙午，赤眉君臣面縛，奉高皇帝璽綬，詔以屬城門校尉。
passages.textEn: Feng Yi fought the Red Eyebrows at Xiaodi and crushed them; the rest of them headed south towards Yiyang, and the emperor led the campaign against them himself. On jihai he reached Yiyang. On jiachen he drew up the six armies in person, with a great display of horse: Grand Marshal Wu Han's picked troops in front, the central army behind them, the swift cavalry and the guards on either side. The Red Eyebrows were terrified at the sight and sent to beg for surrender. On bingwu the Red Eyebrow ruler and ministers came with their hands bound and handed over the seal of Emperor Gao, which he had placed in the keeping of the Colonel of the City Gates.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 馮異與延岑戰於上林，破之。
passages.textEn: Feng Yi fought Yan Cen at Shanglin and beat him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 隗嚻遣將行巡寇扶風，征西大將軍馮異拒破之。
passages.textEn: Wei Xiao sent his general Xing Xun to raid Fufeng; Feng Yi, Grand General Who Conquers the West, held him off and beat him.

summary.zh: 征南大將軍。討鄧奉於堵鄉，破秦豐於黎丘，擊田戎，拔夷陵。建武十一年閏月大破公孫述將於荊門，平巴郡，長驅至武陽；後為蜀刺客所刺殺。
summary.en: Grand General Who Conquers the South. He campaigned against Deng Feng at Duxiang, beat Qin Feng at Liqiu, and routed Tian Rong and took Yiling. In the intercalary month of the eleventh year of Jianwu he crushed Gongsun Shu's generals at Jingmen, pacified Ba and drove on to Wuyang, where an assassin from Shu stabbed him to death.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 冬十一月，以廷尉岑彭為征南大將軍，率八將軍討鄧奉於堵郷。
passages.textEn: In winter, in the eleventh month, the Commandant of Justice Cen Peng was made Grand General Who Conquers the South and led eight generals against Deng Feng at Duxiang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 秋七月，征南大將軍岑彭率三將軍伐秦豐，戰於黎丘，大破之，獲其將蔡宏。
passages.textEn: In autumn, in the seventh month, Cen Peng, Grand General Who Conquers the South, led three generals against Qin Feng, fought him at Liqiu, crushed him and captured his general Cai Hong.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 使彭與傅俊南擊田戎，大破之，遂拔夷陵，追至秭歸。戎與數十騎亡入蜀，盡獲其妻子士眾數萬人。
passages.textEn: He sent Peng and Fu Jun south against Tian Rong; they crushed him, took Yiling and pursued him to Zigui. Rong fled into Shu with a few dozen horsemen, and they captured his wife and children and tens of thousands of his men.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 閏月，征南大將軍岑彭率三將軍與公孫述將田戎、任滿戰於荊門，大破之，獲任滿。威虜將軍馮駿圍田戎於江州，岑彭遂率舟師伐公孫述，平巴郡。
passages.textEn: In the intercalary month Cen Peng with three generals fought Gongsun Shu's generals Tian Rong and Ren Man at Jingmen, crushed them and captured Ren Man. Feng Jun, General Who Awes the Caitiffs, besieged Tian Rong at Jiangzhou, and Cen Peng went on with his fleet against Gongsun Shu and pacified Ba commandery.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 自分兵浮江下還江州，溯都江而上，襲擊侯丹，大破之。因晨夜倍道兼行二千餘里，徑拔武陽。
passages.textEn: He himself took part of the army down the river back to Jiangzhou and up the Du River, fell on Hou Dan and crushed him; then, marching day and night at double pace for over two thousand li, he went straight on and took Wuyang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 會日暮，蜀刺客詐為亡奴降，夜刺殺彭。
passages.textEn: Night was falling; an assassin from Shu, pretending to be a runaway slave come to surrender, stabbed Peng to death in the night.

summary.zh: 順水之敗時射退追兵，護光武脫險。拜建威大將軍，大破延岑於穰；奉命討張步，拔祝阿、定濟南、取臨淄，大破張步，步肉袒來降。後西拒隗囂，從上隴。
summary.en: At the defeat by the Shun River he shot back the pursuers and got Guangwu away. As Grand General Who Establishes Might he crushed Yan Cen at Rang, and sent against Zhang Bu he took Zhu'a, secured Jinan, seized Linzi and routed Bu, who came to surrender stripped to the waist. Later he held off Wei Xiao in the west and went up into Long.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 光武自投高岸，遇突騎王豐，下馬授光武，光武撫其肩而上，顧笑謂耿弇曰：「幾為虜嗤。」弇頻射却賊，得免。士卒死者數千人，散兵歸保范陽。
passages.textEn: Guangwu threw himself down a high bank and met the cavalryman Wang Feng, who got down and gave him his horse; Guangwu mounted with a hand on his shoulder and, looking back, said to Geng Yan with a laugh, "The barbarians nearly had a laugh at me." Yan kept shooting and drove the bandits back, and he got away. Several thousand soldiers died, and the scattered troops fell back to hold Fanyang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 耿弇與延岑戰於穰，大破之。
passages.textEn: Geng Yan fought Yan Cen at Rang and crushed him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 大司馬吳漢率建威大將軍耿弇擊富平、獲索賊於平原，大破降之。復遣耿弇率二將軍討張步。
passages.textEn: Grand Marshal Wu Han, with Geng Yan, Grand General Who Establishes Might, attacked the Fuping and Huosuo bandits in Pingyuan, crushed them and took their surrender. Geng Yan was then sent with two generals against Zhang Bu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 騎都尉劉歆、太山太守陳俊引兵而東，從朝陽橋濟河以度。張歩聞之，乃使其大將軍費邑軍歷下，又分兵屯祝阿，別於太山鍾城列營數十以待弇。弇度河先擊祝阿，自旦攻城，日未中而拔之，故開圍一角，令其眾得奔歸鍾城。
passages.textEn: …with Liu Xin, Commandant of Cavalry, and Chen Jun, governor of Taishan, he led the troops east and crossed the Yellow River by the Chaoyang bridge. Hearing of it, Zhang Bu sent his grand general Fei Yi to hold Lixia, posted troops at Zhu'a, and set up dozens of camps at Zhongcheng in Taishan to await Yan. Yan crossed the river and attacked Zhu'a first; he assaulted it at dawn and took it before noon, deliberately leaving one corner of the ring open so that its men could flee back to Zhongcheng.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 遂攻臨淄，半日拔之，入據其城。張藍聞之大懼，遂將其眾亡歸劇。
passages.textEn: So he attacked Linzi, took it in half a day and occupied it. Zhang Lan was terrified when he heard and fled back to Ju with his men.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 弇因復追步，步奔平壽，乃肉袒負斧锧於軍門。
passages.textEn: Yan pursued Bu again; Bu fled to Pingshou, and then came to the gate of Yan's camp stripped to the waist with an axe and block on his back.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 六年，西拒隗囂，屯兵於漆。八年，從上隴。
passages.textEn: In the sixth year he held off Wei Xiao in the west, camping his troops at Qi. In the eighth year he went up into Long with the emperor.

summary.zh: 虎牙大將軍。率四將軍伐劉永，圍睢陽，拔之，永奔譙；再圍睢陽，拔之。後從隴道伐公孫述，於隴阺為隗囂所敗。
summary.en: Tiger's Fang General. He led four generals against Liu Yong, besieged and took Suiyang, and Yong fled to Qiao; he besieged and took Suiyang a second time. Later, marching against Gongsun Shu by the Long road, he was beaten by Wei Xiao on the Long slope.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 遣虎牙大將軍蓋延率四將軍伐劉永。夏四月，圍永於睢陽。更始將蘇茂殺淮陽太守潘蹇而附劉永。
passages.textEn: He sent Gai Yan, Tiger's Fang General, with four generals against Liu Yong; in summer, in the fourth month, they besieged Yong at Suiyang. The Gengshi general Su Mao killed Pan Jian, governor of Huaiyang, and went over to Liu Yong.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 蓋延拔睢陽，劉永奔譙。
passages.textEn: Gai Yan took Suiyang; Liu Yong fled to Qiao.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 蓋延拔睢陽，獲劉永，而蘇茂、周建立永子紆為梁王。
passages.textEn: Gai Yan took Suiyang and captured Liu Yong, but Su Mao and Zhou Jian made Yong's son Yu King of Liang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 隗嚻反，蓋延等因與嚻戰於隴阺，諸將敗績。
passages.textEn: Wei Xiao rebelled; Gai Yan and the others fought him on the Long slope, and the generals were routed.

summary.zh: 中郎將。率二千餘人伐山開道，從番須、回中直取略陽，斬隗囂守將。後監馮異等五將軍討隗純，大破之於落門，隴右平；又破公孫述將王元、環安於下辯，為環安所遣刺客刺殺。
summary.en: General of the Household. With some two thousand men he cut a road through the mountains by Fanxu and Huizhong and took Lüeyang, beheading Wei Xiao's commander. Later he oversaw Feng Yi and four other generals against Wei Chun and crushed him at Luomen, pacifying Longyou; he then beat Gongsun Shu's generals Wang Yuan and Huan An at Xiabian, and was stabbed to death by an assassin Huan An sent.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十五 李王鄧來列傳
passages.textZh: 八年春，歙與征虜將軍祭遵襲略陽，遵道病還，分遣精兵隨歙，合二千餘人，伐山開道，從番須、回中徑至略陽，斬囂守將金梁，因保其城。
passages.textEn: In spring of the eighth year Xi and Ji Zun set out to surprise Lüeyang; Zun fell ill on the way and turned back, sending picked troops on with Xi, over two thousand men in all. They cut a road through the mountains, went straight by Fanxu and Huizhong to Lüeyang, beheaded Xiao's commander Jin Liang and held the city.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 秋八月，遣中郎將來歙監征西大將軍馮異等五將軍討隗純於天水。
passages.textEn: In autumn, in the eighth month, he sent Lai Xi to oversee Feng Yi and five generals in all against Wei Chun in Tianshui.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 冬十月，中郎將來歙等大破隗純於落門，其將王元奔蜀，純與周宗降，隴右平。
passages.textEn: In winter, in the tenth month, Lai Xi and the others crushed Wei Chun at Luomen; his general Wang Yuan fled to Shu, Chun and Zhou Zong surrendered, and Longyou was pacified.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 六月，中郎將來歙率揚武將軍馬成破公孫述將王元、環安於下辯。安遣間人刺殺中郎將來歙。
passages.textEn: In the sixth month Lai Xi with Ma Cheng beat Gongsun Shu's generals Wang Yuan and Huan An at Xiabian. Huan An sent an assassin who stabbed Lai Xi to death.

names.name: Battle of Handan (Guangwu destroys Wang Lang)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 林詐稱卜者王郎為成帝子子輿，於十二月立為天子，都邯鄲，趙國以北、遼東以西皆望風歸附。次年光武在薊得郎檄文，南走信都，發兵攻柏人不下；上谷太守耿況、漁陽太守彭寵遣吳漢、寇恂等率突騎來助，更始亦遣謝躬討郎。光武東圍鉅鹿，月餘不下，於南䜌擊破郎的援軍；四月進圍邯鄲，連戰破之，五月甲辰拔城，誅王郎。
summary.en: Lin passed off the diviner Wang Lang as Ziyu, son of Emperor Cheng, and in the twelfth month made him emperor at Handan; everything north of Zhao and west of Liaodong went over to him. Early the next year Guangwu, at Ji, received Lang's proclamation, fled south to Xindu, raised troops and attacked Bairen without taking it. The governors of Shanggu and Yuyang, Geng Kuang and Peng Chong, sent Wu Han, Kou Xun and others with shock cavalry to help, and the Gengshi emperor sent Xie Gong against Lang. Guangwu besieged Julu for over a month without taking it and beat Lang's relief army at Nanluan; in the fourth month he closed on Handan, beating its troops in battle after battle, and on jiachen of the fifth month took the city and executed Wang Lang.

label.en: Han (Liu Xiu, then serving the Gengshi emperor) (victor)
Gengshi emperor; sent Xie Gong against Lang
governor of Yuyang, sent officers to help

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 林於是乃詐以卜者王郎為成帝子子輿，十二月，立郎為天子，都邯鄲，遂遣使者降下郡國。
passages.textEn: Lin then passed off the diviner Wang Lang as Ziyu, a son of Emperor Cheng; in the twelfth month he made Lang emperor with his capital at Handan, and sent envoys to bring the commanderies and kingdoms over.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 於是趙國以北，遼東以西，皆從風而靡。
passages.textEn: Then everything north of Zhao and west of Liaodong bowed to him like grass before the wind.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 明年，光武自薊得郎檄，南走信都，發兵徇旁縣，遂攻栢人，不下。
passages.textEn: The next year Guangwu, at Ji, received Lang's proclamation, fled south to Xindu, raised troops to win over the nearby counties, and attacked Bairen without taking it.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 會上谷太守耿況、漁陽太守彭寵各遣其將吳漢、寇恂等將突騎來助擊王郎，更始亦遣尚書僕射謝躬討郎，光武因大饗士卒，遂東圍鉅鹿。
passages.textEn: Just then Geng Kuang, governor of Shanggu, and Peng Chong, governor of Yuyang, each sent their officers, Wu Han, Kou Xun and others, with shock cavalry to help attack Wang Lang, and the Gengshi emperor also sent his Deputy Director of the Secretariat Xie Gong against Lang. Guangwu feasted his troops and went east to besiege Julu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 王郎守將王饒堅守，月餘不下。郎遣將倪宏、劉奉率數萬人救鉅鹿，光武逆戰於南䜌，斬首數千級。四月，進圍邯鄲，連戰破之。五月甲辰，拔其城，誅王郎。
passages.textEn: Wang Lang's commander Wang Rao held out, and Julu did not fall for over a month. Lang sent his generals Ni Hong and Liu Feng with several tens of thousands to relieve it; Guangwu met them at Nanluan and took several thousand heads. In the fourth month he advanced and besieged Handan, beating its troops in battle after battle; on jiachen of the fifth month he took the city and executed Wang Lang.

label.zh: 光武自薊得郎檄，南走信都
label.en: Guangwu flees south from Ji to Xindu
He raises troops and attacks Bairen

names.name: 鄡、館陶、蒲陽之戰（光武破銅馬）
Guangwu breaks the Tongma (Qiao, Guantao, Puyang)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 光武將擊銅馬，先遣吳漢北發十郡兵；幽州牧苗曾不從，吳漢斬之而發其眾。秋，光武擊銅馬於鄡，吳漢率突騎來會清陽。光武堅營自守，擊取出掠之賊，斷其糧道；月餘賊食盡夜遁，追至館陶大破之。高湖、重連自東南來與銅馬餘眾合，又大戰於蒲陽，悉破降之，封其渠帥為列侯。光武將降眾分配諸將，眾至數十萬，關西因號之為「銅馬帝」。
summary.en: Before attacking the Tongma, Guangwu sent Wu Han north to raise the troops of ten commanderies; when Miao Zeng, Governor of You Province, would not comply, Wu Han beheaded him and raised his men. In autumn Guangwu attacked the Tongma at Qiao and Wu Han joined him with the shock cavalry at Qingyang. Guangwu kept to his camp, picked off raiders and cut the bandits' supply route; after more than a month they ran out of food and slipped away by night, and he caught and routed them at Guantao. The Gaohu and Chonglian came up from the south-east to join the remnant, and he crushed them all in a great battle at Puyang, taking their surrender and making their chiefs marquises. He shared the surrendered men among his generals until his host numbered several hundred thousand, and west of the passes he was called "the Tongma emperor".

label.zh: 發十郡兵，率突騎來會（勝）
label.en: raised ten commanderies, brought the cavalry (victor)

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 先遣吳漢北發十郡兵。幽州牧苗曾不從，漢遂斬曾而發其衆。
passages.textEn: He first sent Wu Han north to raise the troops of ten commanderies. Miao Zeng, Governor of You Province, would not comply; Han beheaded him and raised his men.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 秋，光武擊銅馬於鄡，吳漢將突騎來會清陽。賊數挑戰，光武堅營自守；有出鹵掠者，輒擊取之，絕其粮道。積月餘日，賊食盡，夜遁去，追至館陶，大破之。
passages.textEn: In autumn Guangwu attacked the Tongma at Qiao, and Wu Han brought the shock cavalry to join him at Qingyang. The bandits repeatedly offered battle; Guangwu kept to his fortified camp, picked off any who came out to plunder and cut their supply route. After more than a month their food ran out and they slipped away by night; he pursued them to Guantao and routed them.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 受降未盡，而高湖、重連從東南來，與銅馬餘衆合，光武復與大戰於蒲陽，悉破降之，封其渠帥為列侯。
passages.textEn: Before all had surrendered, the Gaohu and Chonglian came up from the south-east and joined what was left of the Tongma; Guangwu fought them again in a great battle at Puyang, routed them all and took their surrender, making their chiefs marquises.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 悉將降人分配諸將，衆遂數十萬，故關西號光武為「銅馬帝」。
passages.textEn: He shared out all the surrendered men among his generals, so that his host grew to several hundred thousand; hence west of the passes Guangwu was called "the Tongma emperor".

names.name: Shequan, and the surprise at Ye
Shèquǎn zhī zhàn yǔ xí Yè

summary.zh: 赤眉別帥與大肜、青犢十餘萬眾屯於射犬，光武進擊，大破之，眾皆散走。光武又使吳漢、岑彭襲殺更始所遣的尚書僕射謝躬於鄴。
summary.en: A detached Red Eyebrow commander with the Dachen and Qingdu, over a hundred thousand in all, was at Shequan; Guangwu advanced and routed them, and they scattered. He then had Wu Han and Cen Peng fall on Xie Gong, the Deputy Director of the Secretariat whom the Gengshi emperor had sent, at Ye, and kill him.

label.en: a Red Eyebrow detachment at Shequan (defeated)
Gengshi: Xie Gong, killed at Ye (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 會上谷太守耿況、漁陽太守彭寵各遣其將吳漢、寇恂等將突騎來助擊王郎，更始亦遣尚書僕射謝躬討郎，光武因大饗士卒，遂東圍鉅鹿。
passages.textEn: Just then Geng Kuang, governor of Shanggu, and Peng Chong, governor of Yuyang, each sent their officers, Wu Han, Kou Xun and others, with shock cavalry to help attack Wang Lang, and the Gengshi emperor also sent his Deputy Director of the Secretariat Xie Gong against Lang. Guangwu feasted his troops and went east to besiege Julu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)

passages.textEn: A detached commander of the Red Eyebrows, with the Dachen and Qingdu, over a hundred thousand in all, was at Shequan; Guangwu advanced and routed them, and they scattered. He had Wu Han and Cen Peng fall on Xie Gong at Ye and kill him.

names.name: 順水之戰（光武北擊尤來）
Battle of the Shun River (Guangwu against the Youlai)

summary.zh: 光武北擊尤來、大搶、五幡於元氏，追至右北平，連破之；又戰於順水北，乘勝輕進，反為所敗。光武自投高岸，得突騎王豐讓馬，耿弇頻射退敵，始得脫身；士卒死者數千人，散兵歸保范陽。賊夜引去，大軍復進至安次，破之，斬首三千餘級；賊入漁陽，吳漢率耿弇等十二將軍追戰於潞東及平谷，大破滅之。
summary.en: Guangwu went north against the Youlai, Daqiang and Wufan at Yuanshi, chased them to Youbeiping and beat them repeatedly; fighting again north of the Shun River, he pressed on too lightly and was beaten. He threw himself down a high bank, the cavalryman Wang Feng gave him his horse, and Geng Yan shot back the pursuers so that he got away; several thousand soldiers died and the scattered troops fell back to Fanyang. The bandits left by night; the main army advanced again to Anci, beat them and took over three thousand heads, and when they went into Yuyang Wu Han with Geng Yan and twelve generals in all chased them east of Lu and to Pinggu and destroyed them.

label.en: commander: beaten at the Shun, won in the end

label.zh: 率十二將軍追戰潞東、平谷（勝）
label.en: led the pursuit to Lu and Pinggu (victor)

passages.textEn: Guangwu went north and attacked the Youlai, Daqiang and Wufan at Yuanshi, pursued them to Youbeiping and beat them repeatedly. He fought them again north of the Shun River, pressed on too lightly after his success, and was beaten instead.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 光武自投高岸，遇突騎王豐，下馬授光武，光武撫其肩而上，顧笑謂耿弇曰：「幾為虜嗤。」弇頻射却賊，得免。士卒死者數千人，散兵歸保范陽。
passages.textEn: Guangwu threw himself down a high bank and met the cavalryman Wang Feng, who got down and gave him his horse; Guangwu mounted with a hand on his shoulder and, looking back, said to Geng Yan with a laugh, "The barbarians nearly had a laugh at me." Yan kept shooting and drove the bandits back, and he got away. Several thousand soldiers died, and the scattered troops fell back to hold Fanyang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 大軍復進至安次，與戰，破之，斬首三千餘級。賊入漁陽，乃遣吳漢率耿弇、陳俊、馬武等十二將軍追戰于潞東，及平谷，大破滅之。
passages.textEn: The main army advanced again to Anci, fought the bandits and beat them, taking over three thousand heads. They went into Yuyang; he sent Wu Han with Geng Yan, Chen Jun, Ma Wu and twelve generals in all after them, and they fought east of Lu and at Pinggu, crushing and destroying them.

label.zh: 北擊尤來等於元氏，追至右北平
label.en: From Yuanshi in pursuit to Youbeiping

label.zh: 順水北戰敗，散兵歸保范陽
label.en: Beaten at the Shun, back to Fanyang

label.en: Wu Han's pursuit east of Lu

summary.zh: 更始使大司馬朱鮪等屯洛陽，光武令馮異守孟津以拒之。朱鮪遣討難將軍蘇茂渡河攻溫，馮異、寇恂與戰，大破之，斬其將賈彊。
summary.en: The Gengshi emperor had his Grand Marshal Zhu Wei and others holding Luoyang, and Guangwu had Feng Yi guard Mengjin against them. Zhu Wei sent Su Mao, General Who Punishes Trouble, against Wen; Feng Yi and Kou Xun fought him and routed him, beheading his officer Jia Qiang.

passages.textEn: The Qingdu and Red Eyebrow bandits came through the Hangu Pass and attacked the Gengshi emperor. Guangwu then sent Deng Yu with six lieutenants west, to take advantage of the turmoil between the Gengshi emperor and the Red Eyebrows. The Gengshi emperor had his Grand Marshal Zhu Wei, Li Yi the King of Wuyin and others holding Luoyang, and Guangwu had Feng Yi guard Mengjin against them.

passages.textEn: Zhu Wei sent Su Mao, General Who Punishes Trouble, to attack Wen; Feng Yi and Kou Xun fought him and routed him, beheading his officer Jia Qiang.

names.name: Deng Yu's march west (Ji Pass, Anyi)
