summary.zh: 青犢、赤眉入函谷關攻更始，光武遣鄧禹率六裨將西進，以乘其亂。建武元年正月，鄧禹自箕關入河東，河東都尉閉關拒守，禹攻十日破之，獲輜重千餘乘，進圍安邑，數月未下；甲子，大破更始定國公王匡於安邑，斬其將劉均。後赤眉焚西京宮室、寇掠關中，鄧禹入長安，奉十一帝神主納於高廟。
summary.en: When the Qingdu and Red Eyebrows came through the Hangu Pass against the Gengshi emperor, Guangwu sent Deng Yu west with six lieutenants to profit from the turmoil. In the first month of the first Jianwu year Deng Yu forced the Ji Pass into Hedong after ten days' fighting, taking over a thousand wagons, and besieged Anyi for months; on jiazi he routed the Gengshi Duke of Dingguo, Wang Kuang, at Anyi and beheaded his officer Liu Jun. Later, while the Red Eyebrows were burning the palaces and plundering the land within the passes, Deng Yu entered Chang'an and placed the spirit tablets of the eleven emperors in the temple of Gaozu.

label.en: Gengshi: Wang Kuang, Duke of Dingguo (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)

passages.textEn: The Qingdu and Red Eyebrow bandits came through the Hangu Pass and attacked the Gengshi emperor. Guangwu then sent Deng Yu with six lieutenants west, to take advantage of the turmoil between the Gengshi emperor and the Red Eyebrows. The Gengshi emperor had his Grand Marshal Zhu Wei, Li Yi the King of Wuyin and others holding Luoyang, and Guangwu had Feng Yi guard Mengjin against them.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十六 鄧寇列傳
passages.textZh: 建武元年正月，禹自箕關將入河東，河東都尉守關不開，禹攻十日，破之，獲輜重千餘乘。進圍安邑，數月未能下。
passages.textEn: In the first month of the first Jianwu year Yu was about to enter Hedong by the Ji Pass; the Commandant of Hedong held the pass shut, and Yu attacked it for ten days, broke through and took over a thousand wagons of supplies. He advanced and besieged Anyi, but could not take it for several months.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 甲子，前將軍鄧禹擊更始定國公王匡於安邑，大破之，斬其將劉均。
passages.textEn: On jiazi the General of the Van Deng Yu attacked the Gengshi emperor's Duke of Dingguo, Wang Kuang, at Anyi, routed him and beheaded his officer Liu Jun.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 是月，赤眉焚西京宮室，發掘園陵，寇掠關中。大司徒鄧禹入長安，遣府掾奉十一帝神主，納於高廟。
passages.textEn: That month the Red Eyebrows burned the palaces of the Western Capital, dug up the imperial tombs and plundered the land within the passes. The Grand Minister over the Masses Deng Yu entered Chang'an and sent his officers to carry the spirit tablets of the eleven emperors into the temple of Gaozu.

label.zh: 禹自箕關入河東，進圍安邑
label.en: Through the Ji Pass to Anyi

summary.zh: 更始使大司馬朱鮪、舞陰王李軼等屯洛陽，光武令馮異守孟津以拒之。己亥，光武幸懷，遣耿弇率陳俊屯五社津，以備滎陽以東；使吳漢率朱祐、岑彭、賈復、堅鐔等十一將軍圍朱鮪於洛陽。光武進幸河陽。辛卯，朱鮪舉城降；十月癸丑，光武車駕入洛陽，幸南宮卻非殿，遂定都於此。
summary.en: The Gengshi emperor had Zhu Wei, his Grand Marshal, and Li Yi, King of Wuyin, holding Luoyang, and Guangwu had Feng Yi guard Mengjin against them. On jihai Guangwu went to Huai; he sent Geng Yan with Chen Jun to camp at the Wushe ford against anything from east of Xingyang, and had Wu Han lead Zhu You, Cen Peng, Jia Fu, Jian Tan and eleven generals in all to besiege Zhu Wei in Luoyang. Guangwu moved on to Heyang. On xinmao Zhu Wei surrendered the city, and on guichou of the tenth month Guangwu entered Luoyang, went to the Queifei Hall of the Southern Palace and made it his capital.

label.en: led eleven generals in the siege (victor)

label.zh: 更始：大司馬朱鮪，舉城降（敗）

The Gengshi emperor had his Grand Marshal Zhu Wei, Li Yi the King of Wuyin and others holding Luoyang, and Guangwu had Feng Yi guard Mengjin against them.

passages.textEn: On jihai he went to Huai. He sent Geng Yan with Chen Jun, General of Strong Crossbows, to camp at the Wushe ford and guard against anything east of Xingyang, and had Wu Han lead Zhu You, the Commandant of Justice Cen Peng, the Bearer of the Golden Mace Jia Fu, Jian Tan and eleven generals in all to besiege Zhu Wei in Luoyang.

passages.textEn: On guichou he sacrificed to Gaozu, Taizong and Shizong in the palace at Huai, and went on to Heyang.

names.name: The Red Eyebrows take Chang'an (the end of the Gengshi emperor)

summary.zh: 更始二年冬，赤眉崇、安自武關，宣等從陸渾關，兩道入關；三年正月俱至弘農，與更始諸將連戰皆勝，眾遂大集，分為三十營，進至華陰。赤眉立劉盆子為天子。軍至高陵，與更始叛將張卬等連和，攻東都門入長安；〈光武紀〉記赤眉入長安，更始奔高陵。十月，更始肉袒詣長樂宮，上璽綬於劉盆子；其後謝祿使兵將他縊殺。
summary.en: In the winter of the second Gengshi year the Red Eyebrows came in by two roads, Chong and An through the Wu Pass and Xuan and others through the Luhun Pass; in the first month of the third year both reached Hongnong, beat the Gengshi generals again and again, and swelled into thirty camps of ten thousand, advancing to Huayin. They made Liu Penzi emperor. At Gaoling they joined forces with Zhang Ang and other generals who had turned against the Gengshi emperor, attacked the Eastern Capital Gate and entered Chang'an; the Annals say the Gengshi emperor fled to Gaoling. In the tenth month he went stripped to the waist to the Changle Palace and handed his seals to Liu Penzi; afterwards Xie Lu had soldiers strangle him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十一 劉玄劉盆子列傳

passages.textEn: In winter of the second Gengshi year Chong and An came in by the Wu Pass and Xuan and others by the Luhun Pass, two roads at once. In the first month of the third year both reached Hongnong, beat the Gengshi generals in battle after battle, and their numbers swelled.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)

passages.textZh: 乃分萬人爲一營，凡三十營，營置三老、從事各一人。進至華陰。
passages.textEn: They then divided into camps of ten thousand men, thirty camps in all, each with a "Thrice Venerable" and an aide, and advanced to Huayin.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 是月，赤眉立劉盆子為天子。
passages.textEn: That month the Red Eyebrows made Liu Penzi emperor.

passages.textEn: When the army reached Gaoling it joined forces with Zhang Ang and other generals who had turned against the Gengshi emperor, attacked the Eastern Capital Gate and entered Chang'an, and the Gengshi emperor came to surrender.

summary.zh: 光武遣虎牙大將軍蓋延率四將軍伐劉永，夏四月圍永於睢陽。更始將蘇茂殺淮陽太守潘蹇，附於劉永。蓋延拔睢陽，劉永奔譙。
summary.en: Guangwu sent Gai Yan, Tiger's Fang General, with four generals against Liu Yong, and in the fourth month they besieged him at Suiyang. The Gengshi general Su Mao killed Pan Jian, governor of Huaiyang, and went over to Liu Yong. Gai Yan took Suiyang, and Liu Yong fled to Qiao.

summary.zh: 漁陽太守彭寵反，自將二萬餘人攻幽州牧朱浮於薊，分兵徇廣陽、上谷、右北平。光武遣游擊將軍鄧隆救朱浮，與寵戰於潞，隆軍敗績。次年春，寵拔右北平、上谷數縣，陷薊城，自立為燕王；又以美女繒綵賂遺匈奴，單于遣左南將軍七八千騎往來為游兵以助寵。其後寵為其蒼頭所殺，漁陽平。
summary.en: Peng Chong, governor of Yuyang, rebelled, led over twenty thousand men against Zhu Fu, Governor of You Province, at Ji, and sent detachments into Guangyang, Shanggu and Youbeiping. Guangwu sent Deng Long, the Roving General, to relieve Zhu Fu; he fought Chong at Lu and was routed. The next spring Chong took several counties of Youbeiping and Shanggu, took the city of Ji and made himself King of Yan; he courted the Xiongnu with women and silks, and the chanyu sent seven or eight thousand horsemen to range about in his support. In the end Chong was killed by his own slaves, and Yuyang was pacified.

summary.zh: 破虜將軍鄧奉據淯陽反。十一月，光武以岑彭為征南大將軍，率八將軍討鄧奉於堵鄉。光武又自將征奉，幸堵陽；夏四月大破鄧奉於小長安，斬之。
summary.en: Deng Feng, General Who Smashes the Caitiffs, seized Yuyang and rebelled. In the eleventh month Guangwu made Cen Peng Grand General Who Conquers the South and sent him with eight generals against Deng Feng at Duxiang. Then Guangwu led the campaign himself, went to Duyang, and in the fourth month crushed Deng Feng at Xiao Chang'an and beheaded him.

names.name: 崤底、宜陽之戰（赤眉之降）
Xiaodi and Yiyang (the surrender of the Red Eyebrows)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 光武遣偏將軍馮異代鄧禹伐赤眉。馮異與赤眉戰於崤底，大破之，餘眾南向宜陽，光武自將征之。甲辰，光武親勒六軍，大司馬吳漢精卒當前，中軍次之，驍騎、武衛分陳左右；赤眉望見震怖，遣使乞降。丙午，赤眉君臣面縛，奉上高皇帝璽綬。所棄兵甲積於宜陽城西，與熊耳山齊。
summary.en: Guangwu sent Lieutenant General Feng Yi to replace Deng Yu against the Red Eyebrows. Feng Yi crushed them at Xiaodi, and the rest headed south towards Yiyang, where Guangwu went against them himself. On jiachen he drew up the six armies in person, Grand Marshal Wu Han's picked troops in front, the central army behind and the cavalry and guards on either side; the Red Eyebrows were terrified at the sight and begged to surrender. On bingwu their ruler and ministers came with hands bound and handed over the seal of Emperor Gao. The arms they gave up were piled west of the walls of Yiyang as high as Mount Xiong'er.

label.en: led the picked troops in front (victor)

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)

passages.textZh: 馮異與赤眉戰於崤底，大破之，餘衆南向冝陽，帝自將征之。己亥，幸冝陽。甲辰，親勒六軍，大陳戎馬，大司馬吳漢精卒當前，中軍次之，驍騎、武衞分陳左右。赤眉望見震怖，遣使乞降。丙午，赤眉君臣面縛，奉高皇帝璽綬，詔以屬城門校尉。
passages.textEn: Feng Yi fought the Red Eyebrows at Xiaodi and crushed them; the rest of them headed south towards Yiyang, and the emperor led the campaign against them himself. On jihai he reached Yiyang. On jiachen he drew up the six armies in person, with a great display of horse: Grand Marshal Wu Han's picked troops in front, the central army behind them, the swift cavalry and the guards on either side. The Red Eyebrows were terrified at the sight and sent to beg for surrender. On bingwu the Red Eyebrow ruler and ministers came with their hands bound and handed over the seal of Emperor Gao, which he had placed in the keeping of the Colonel of the City Gates.

summary.zh: 延岑起兵漢中，自稱武安王。馮異與延岑戰於上林，破之；耿弇與延岑戰於穰，大破之；建義大將軍朱祐率祭遵與延岑戰於東陽，斬其將張成。
summary.en: Yan Cen, who had risen in Hanzhong and called himself King of Wu'an, was beaten by Feng Yi at Shanglin, crushed by Geng Yan at Rang, and defeated by Zhu You and Ji Zun at Dongyang, where his general Zhang Cheng was beheaded.

names.name: 廣樂、睢陽之戰（劉永之死）
Guangle and Suiyang (the death of Liu Yong)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 劉永立張步為齊王、董憲為海西王。光武遣大司馬吳漢等圍蘇茂於廣樂，周建率眾救茂，茂、建戰敗，棄城還湖陵；而睢陽人反城迎劉永。吳漢與蓋延合軍圍睢陽，城中食盡，永與茂、建走酇。本紀記蓋延「拔睢陽，獲劉永」；〈劉永傳〉記諸將追急，永將慶吾斬永首而降。蘇茂、周建立永子紆為梁王。
summary.en: Liu Yong made Zhang Bu King of Qi and Dong Xian King of Haixi. Guangwu sent Grand Marshal Wu Han and others to besiege Su Mao at Guangle; Zhou Jian came to his relief, but both were beaten and went back to Huling, while the people of Suiyang turned their city over to Liu Yong again. Wu Han and Gai Yan joined forces to besiege Suiyang; when the food ran out Yong fled to Zan with Mao and Jian. The Annals say Gai Yan "took Suiyang and captured Liu Yong"; the biography of Liu Yong says that with the generals in hot pursuit, Yong's officer Qing Wu cut off his head and surrendered. Su Mao and Zhou Jian made Yong's son Yu King of Liang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 三年春，永遣使立張步爲齊王，董憲爲海西王。於是遣大司馬吳漢等圍蘇茂於廣樂，周建率衆救茂，茂、建戰敗，弃城復還湖陵，而睢陽人反城迎永。
passages.textEn: In spring of the third year Yong sent envoys making Zhang Bu King of Qi and Dong Xian King of Haixi. Grand Marshal Wu Han and others were then sent to besiege Su Mao at Guangle; Zhou Jian came with his men to relieve him, but Mao and Jian were beaten, abandoned the town and went back to Huling, while the people of Suiyang turned their city over and welcomed Yong back.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 吳漢率七將軍與劉永將蘇茂戰於廣樂，大破之。虎牙大將軍蓋延圍劉永於睢陽。
passages.textEn: Wu Han with seven generals fought Liu Yong's general Su Mao at Guangle and crushed him. Gai Yan, Tiger's Fang General, besieged Liu Yong at Suiyang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 吳漢與蓋延等合軍圍之，城中食盡，永與茂、建走酇。諸將追急，永將慶吾斬永首降，封吾爲列侯。
passages.textEn: Wu Han and Gai Yan joined their armies and besieged the city; when the food inside ran out, Yong fled to Zan with Mao and Jian. With the generals in hot pursuit, Yong's officer Qing Wu cut off his head and surrendered, and was made a marquis.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 蓋延拔睢陽，獲劉永，而蘇茂、周建立永子紆為梁王。
passages.textEn: Gai Yan took Suiyang and captured Liu Yong, but Su Mao and Zhou Jian made Yong's son Yu King of Liang.

label.zh: 茂、建戰敗，弃城復還湖陵
label.en: Su Mao and Zhou Jian fall back to Huling

question.zh: 劉永是被擒，還是被部將所殺？
question.en: Was Liu Yong captured, or killed by his own officer?

claim.zh: 蓋延拔睢陽，擒獲劉永。
claim.en: Gai Yan took Suiyang and captured him.

claim.zh: 永走酇，諸將追急，其將慶吾斬永首而降。
claim.en: He fled to Zan; with the generals close behind, his officer Qing Wu beheaded him and surrendered.

accounts.quoteZh: 永將慶吾斬永首降

names.name: Battle of Liqiu (the end of Qin Feng)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 南郡人秦豐據黎丘，自稱楚黎王，略取十二縣。光武令岑彭率傅俊、臧宮、劉宏等三萬餘人南擊秦豐，拔黃郵；豐與大將蔡宏拒彭於鄧，數月不得進。彭潛兵渡沔水，於阿頭山大破豐將張楊，伐木開道，直襲黎丘，擊破諸屯兵。秋七月，岑彭大破秦豐於黎丘（蔡宏被擒或被斬，二書不同）。豐相趙京舉宜城降，與彭共圍黎丘。其後朱祐率二將軍續圍，六月拔黎丘，獲秦豐。
summary.en: Qin Feng of Nan commandery held Liqiu, called himself King of Chuli and seized twelve counties. Guangwu sent Cen Peng south against him with Fu Jun, Zang Gong, Liu Hong and over thirty thousand men; they took Huangyou, but Feng and his general Cai Hong held them at Deng for months. Peng slipped across the Mian, crushed Feng's general Zhang Yang at Mount Atou, cut a road through the valleys and fell on Liqiu, breaking its garrisons. In the seventh month he crushed Qin Feng at Liqiu (the two accounts differ on whether Cai Hong was captured or beheaded). Feng's chancellor Zhao Jing surrendered Yicheng and joined the siege. Zhu You then took over the siege with two generals, and in the sixth month took Liqiu and captured Qin Feng.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 南郡人秦豐據黎丘，自稱楚黎王，略十有二縣
passages.textEn: Qin Feng of Nan commandery held Liqiu, called himself King of Chuli and seized twelve counties

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 令彭率傅俊、臧宮、劉宏等三萬餘人南擊秦豐，拔黃郵，豐與其大將蔡宏拒彭等於鄧，數月不得進。
passages.textEn: He ordered Peng to lead Fu Jun, Zang Gong, Liu Hong and others, over thirty thousand men, south against Qin Feng. They took Huangyou; Feng and his general Cai Hong held them off at Deng, and for several months they could not advance.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 彭乃潛兵度沔水，擊其將張楊於阿頭山，大破之。從川谷間伐木開道，直襲黎丘，擊破諸屯兵。
passages.textEn: Peng then slipped his troops across the Mian River, attacked Feng's general Zhang Yang at Mount Atou and crushed him; cutting a road through the valleys, he struck straight at Liqiu and broke the garrisons there.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 秋七月，征南大將軍岑彭率三將軍伐秦豐，戰於黎丘，大破之，獲其將蔡宏。
passages.textEn: In autumn, in the seventh month, Cen Peng, Grand General Who Conquers the South, led three generals against Qin Feng, fought him at Liqiu, crushed him and captured his general Cai Hong.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 秦豐相趙京舉宜城降，拜為成漢將軍，與彭共圍豐於黎丘。
passages.textEn: Qin Feng's chancellor Zhao Jing surrendered Yicheng, was made General Who Completes Han, and joined Peng in besieging Feng at Liqiu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 十一月丙申，幸宛。遣建義大將軍朱祐率二將軍圍秦豐於黎丘。
passages.textEn: On bingshen of the eleventh month he went to Wan, and sent Zhu You with two generals to besiege Qin Feng at Liqiu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 六月，建義大將軍朱祐拔黎丘，獲秦豐
passages.textEn: In the sixth month Zhu You took Liqiu and captured Qin Feng

label.zh: 岑彭南擊秦豐，豐拒彭等於鄧

names.name: 津鄉、夷陵之戰（田戎之敗）
Jinxiang and Yiling (the defeat of Tian Rong)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 田戎擁眾據夷陵，聞秦豐被圍，懼而欲降。建武四年春，戎留辛臣守夷陵，自將兵沿江溯沔至黎丘，約期欲降；辛臣盜其珍寶，從間道先降岑彭，並以書招戎，戎疑被出賣，遂不敢降。光武使岑彭與傅俊南擊田戎，大破之，遂拔夷陵，追至秭歸，戎與數十騎亡入蜀，其妻子士眾數萬人盡被俘獲。本紀記岑彭率二將軍伐田戎於津鄉，大破之。
summary.en: Tian Rong held Yiling with his followers; hearing that Qin Feng was under siege, he thought of surrendering. In spring of the fourth year of Jianwu he left Xin Chen to hold Yiling and took his troops down the Yangzi and up the Mian to Liqiu, setting a day to surrender; but Xin Chen stole his treasure, surrendered to Cen Peng first and wrote urging Rong to come over, and Rong, suspecting he was being sold, did not dare. Guangwu sent Cen Peng and Fu Jun south against him; they crushed him, took Yiling and chased him to Zigui, and he fled into Shu with a few dozen horsemen, leaving his wife, children and tens of thousands of men in their hands. The Annals record that Cen Peng with two generals attacked Tian Rong at Jinxiang and crushed him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 時田戎擁眾夷陵，聞秦豐被圍，懼大兵方至，欲降。
passages.textEn: Tian Rong was then holding Yiling with his followers; hearing that Qin Feng was under siege, and fearing the great army would come on to him, he thought of surrendering.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 四年春，戎乃留辛臣守夷陵，自將兵沿江溯沔止黎丘，刻期日當降，而辛臣於後盜戎珍寶，從間道先降於彭，而以書招戎。戎疑必賣己，遂不敢降
passages.textEn: In spring of the fourth year Rong left Xin Chen to hold Yiling and himself took his troops down the Yangzi and up the Mian to Liqiu, setting a day to surrender; but behind him Xin Chen stole Rong's treasure, went by back roads to surrender to Peng first, and wrote to Rong urging him to come over. Rong suspected he was being sold, and did not dare surrender

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 使彭與傅俊南擊田戎，大破之，遂拔夷陵，追至秭歸。戎與數十騎亡入蜀，盡獲其妻子士眾數萬人。
passages.textEn: He sent Peng and Fu Jun south against Tian Rong; they crushed him, took Yiling and pursued him to Zigui. Rong fled into Shu with a few dozen horsemen, and they captured his wife and children and tens of thousands of his men.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 遣征南大將軍岑彭率二將軍伐田戎於津郷，大破之。
passages.textEn: He sent Cen Peng with two generals against Tian Rong at Jinxiang, and they crushed him.

label.zh: 戎留辛臣守夷陵，沿江溯沔止黎丘
岑彭南擊田戎，遂拔夷陵

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 平狄將軍龐萌反，殺楚郡太守孫萌，襲破蓋延，東附董憲，自號東平王。龐萌、蘇茂圍桃城，光武時在蒙，親自征討：先於任城整兵，進救桃城，大破萌等。進幸湖陵征董憲，又幸蕃，於昌慮大破董憲。八月進幸郯，留吳漢攻劉紆、董憲，自往彭城、下邳。吳漢拔郯；本紀記「獲劉紆」，〈劉永傳〉記軍士高扈斬紆首而降，梁地悉平。吳漢遂進圍董憲、龐萌於朐。
summary.en: Pang Meng, General Who Pacifies the Di, rebelled, killed Sun Meng, governor of Chu, beat Gai Yan, went east to join Dong Xian and styled himself King of Dongping. When Pang Meng and Su Mao besieged Taocheng, Guangwu, then at Meng, took the field himself: he gathered his troops at Rencheng, relieved Taocheng and crushed them. He went on to Huling against Dong Xian, then to Fan, and crushed Dong Xian at Changlü. In the eighth month he went to Tan, left Wu Han to deal with Liu Yu and Dong Xian, and turned to Pengcheng and Xiapi himself. Wu Han took Tan; the Annals say he "captured Liu Yu", the biography of Liu Yong that a soldier, Gao Hu, beheaded Yu and surrendered, and the land of Liang was wholly pacified. Wu Han went on to besiege Dong Xian and Pang Meng at Qu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 平狄將軍龐萌反，殺楚郡太守孫萌而東附董憲。
passages.textEn: Pang Meng, General Who Pacifies the Di, rebelled, killed Sun Meng, governor of Chu commandery, and went east to join Dong Xian.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 時平狄將軍龐萌反叛，遂襲破蓋延，引兵與董憲連和，自號東平王，屯桃鄉之北。
passages.textEn: At this time Pang Meng, General Who Pacifies the Di, rebelled, fell on Gai Yan and beat him, led his troops to join Dong Xian, styled himself King of Dongping and camped north of Taoxiang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 而龐萌、蘇茂圍桃城。帝時幸蒙，因自將征之。先理兵任城，乃進救桃城，大破萌等。
passages.textEn: Meanwhile Pang Meng and Su Mao were besieging Taocheng. The emperor, then at Meng, led the campaign himself: he first gathered his troops at Rencheng, then advanced to relieve Taocheng and crushed Meng and the others.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 進幸湖陵，征董憲。又幸蕃，遂攻董憲於昌慮，大破之。
passages.textEn: He went on to Huling to campaign against Dong Xian, then to Fan, and attacked Dong Xian at Changlü, crushing him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 八月己酉，進幸郯，留吳漢攻劉紆、董憲等，車駕轉徇彭城、下邳。吳漢拔郯，獲劉紆，漢進圍董憲、龐萌於朐。
passages.textEn: On jiyou of the eighth month he went on to Tan, left Wu Han to attack Liu Yu, Dong Xian and the others, and himself turned to bring Pengcheng and Xiapi to submission. Wu Han took Tan and captured Liu Yu, then went on to besiege Dong Xian and Pang Meng at Qu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 劉紆不知所歸，軍士高扈斬其首降，梁地悉平。
passages.textEn: Liu Yu did not know where to go; a soldier, Gao Hu, cut off his head and surrendered, and the land of Liang was wholly pacified.

label.zh: 帝自將征之，先理兵任城
label.en: Guangwu gathers his troops at Rencheng

label.zh: 進幸湖陵，征董憲。又幸蕃

question.en: Was Liu Yu captured or killed?

claim.zh: 吳漢拔郯，獲劉紆。
claim.en: Wu Han took Tan and captured him.

accounts.quoteZh: 吳漢拔郯，獲劉紆

claim.zh: 劉紆無所歸，軍士高扈斬其首而降。
claim.en: With nowhere to go, he was beheaded by a soldier, Gao Hu, who surrendered.

accounts.quoteZh: 軍士高扈斬其首降

names.name: 耿弇平齊（祝阿、臨淄之戰）
Geng Yan conquers Qi (Zhu'a and Linzi)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 光武遣耿弇率二將軍討張步。弇與騎都尉劉歆、太山太守陳俊引兵東進，從朝陽橋渡河；張步使大將軍費邑軍歷下，分兵屯祝阿，又於太山鍾城列營數十以待。弇先擊祝阿，自旦至日未中即拔之，故開一角令其眾奔鍾城；後於巨里乘高合戰，臨陣斬費邑，平四十餘營，遂定濟南。時張步都劇，使其弟藍以精兵二萬守西安，諸郡太守合萬餘人守臨淄；弇出其不意攻臨淄，半日拔之，張藍亡歸劇。張步與三弟及大彤渠帥重異等號二十萬眾至臨淄大城東攻弇，弇出兵大戰，自旦至昏，大破之，城中溝塹皆滿；步夜引去，伏兵追擊至鉅昧水，八九十里僵屍相屬。步還劇，後奔平壽，肉袒負斧锧詣軍門降。弇樹十二郡旗鼓，令步兵各以郡人詣旗下，眾尚十餘萬，皆罷遣歸鄉里。本紀：張步斬蘇茂以降，齊地平。
summary.en: Guangwu sent Geng Yan with two generals against Zhang Bu. With Liu Xin and Chen Jun he marched east and crossed the Yellow River by the Chaoyang bridge, while Zhang Bu put his grand general Fei Yi at Lixia, troops at Zhu'a and dozens of camps at Zhongcheng. Yan took Zhu'a between dawn and noon, leaving a gap for its men to flee; then at Juli he attacked from the heights, beheaded Fei Yi on the field, levelled over forty camps and secured Jinan. Zhang Bu had his capital at Ju, his brother Lan at Xi'an with twenty thousand picked men and his governors at Linzi with over ten thousand; Yan fell on Linzi without warning and took it in half a day, and Zhang Lan fled to Ju. Bu, his three brothers and the Datong chief Chong Yi came with forces called two hundred thousand to attack Yan east of the great city of Linzi; Yan fought them from dawn to dusk and crushed them, the city's ditches filling with the dead, and when Bu withdrew that night the ambush chased him to the Jumei River, corpses lying for eighty or ninety li. Bu went back to Ju and then fled to Pingshou, where he came to Yan's camp gate stripped to the waist with an axe and block on his back. Yan set up the flags of the twelve commanderies, had Bu's soldiers report under their own, and sent all of them, over a hundred thousand, home. The Annals: Zhang Bu beheaded Su Mao and surrendered, and Qi was pacified.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 大司馬吳漢率建威大將軍耿弇擊富平、獲索賊於平原，大破降之。復遣耿弇率二將軍討張步。
passages.textEn: Grand Marshal Wu Han, with Geng Yan, Grand General Who Establishes Might, attacked the Fuping and Huosuo bandits in Pingyuan, crushed them and took their surrender. Geng Yan was then sent with two generals against Zhang Bu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 騎都尉劉歆、太山太守陳俊引兵而東，從朝陽橋濟河以度。張歩聞之，乃使其大將軍費邑軍歷下，又分兵屯祝阿，別於太山鍾城列營數十以待弇。弇度河先擊祝阿，自旦攻城，日未中而拔之，故開圍一角，令其眾得奔歸鍾城。
passages.textEn: …with Liu Xin, Commandant of Cavalry, and Chen Jun, governor of Taishan, he led the troops east and crossed the Yellow River by the Chaoyang bridge. Hearing of it, Zhang Bu sent his grand general Fei Yi to hold Lixia, posted troops at Zhu'a, and set up dozens of camps at Zhongcheng in Taishan to await Yan. Yan crossed the river and attacked Zhu'a first; he assaulted it at dawn and took it before noon, deliberately leaving one corner of the ring open so that its men could flee back to Zhongcheng.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 即分三千人守巨里，自引精兵上岡阪，乘高合戰，大破之，臨陳斬邑。
passages.textEn: He left three thousand men to watch Juli, took his picked troops up the slope himself and attacked from the heights, crushing the enemy and beheading Fei Yi on the field.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 弇復收其積聚，縱兵擊諸未下者，平四十餘營，遂定濟南。
passages.textEn: Yan then took over their stores and turned his troops on all who had not yet submitted, levelling more than forty camps, and so secured Jinan.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 時，張歩都劇，使其弟藍將精兵二萬守西安，諸郡太守合萬餘人守臨淄，相去四十里。
passages.textEn: At this time Zhang Bu had his capital at Ju; he had his brother Lan hold Xi'an with twenty thousand picked troops, and the governors of his commanderies hold Linzi, forty li away, with over ten thousand.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 遂攻臨淄，半日拔之，入據其城。張藍聞之大懼，遂將其眾亡歸劇。
passages.textEn: So he attacked Linzi, took it in half a day and occupied it. Zhang Lan was terrified when he heard and fled back to Ju with his men.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 乃與三弟藍、弘、壽及故大彤渠帥重異等兵號二十萬，至臨淄大城東，將攻弇。
passages.textEn: With his three brothers Lan, Hong and Shou, and Chong Yi, the former chief of the Datong, at the head of forces called two hundred thousand strong, he came to the east of the great city of Linzi to attack Yan.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 乃出兵大戰，自旦及昏，復大破之，殺傷無數，城中溝塹皆滿。
passages.textEn: So he came out and fought a great battle from dawn to dusk, crushing the enemy again; the dead and wounded were past counting, and the ditches and moats of the city were full.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 人定時，歩果引去，伏兵起縱擊，追至鉅昧水上，八九十里僵屍相屬，收得輜重二千餘兩。歩還劇，兄弟各分兵散去。
passages.textEn: Late that night Bu did withdraw; the ambush rose and fell on him, pursuing him to the Jumei River, with corpses lying one after another for eighty or ninety li, and over two thousand wagons of baggage were taken. Bu went back to Ju, and he and his brothers each scattered with their troops.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 弇因復追步，步奔平壽，乃肉袒負斧锧於軍門。
passages.textEn: Yan pursued Bu again; Bu fled to Pingshou, and then came to the gate of Yan's camp stripped to the waist with an axe and block on his back.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 樹十二郡旗鼓，令步兵各以郡人詣旗下，眾尚十餘萬，輜重七千餘兩，皆罷遣歸鄉里。
passages.textEn: He set up flags and drums for the twelve commanderies and had Bu's soldiers report under the flag of their own commandery; there were still over a hundred thousand of them, with over seven thousand wagons, and all were disbanded and sent home.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 耿弇等與張步戰於臨淄，大破之。帝幸臨淄，進幸劇。張步斬蘇茂以降，齊地平。
passages.textEn: Geng Yan and the others fought Zhang Bu at Linzi and crushed him. The emperor went to Linzi and on to Ju. Zhang Bu beheaded Su Mao and surrendered, and the land of Qi was pacified.

label.zh: 引兵而東，濟河先擊祝阿

label.en: Linzi taken in half a day

label.zh: 步與三弟兵號二十萬，至臨淄大城東
步奔平壽，肉袒負斧锧於軍門
label.en: Zhang Bu flees to Pingshou and surrenders

names.name: Siege of Qu (the end of Dong Xian and Pang Meng)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 吳漢再拔郯，董憲與龐萌走保朐，吳漢進圍之。次年城中穀盡，憲、萌潛出，襲取贛榆，琅邪太守陳俊攻之，憲、萌走入澤中。二月，吳漢拔朐。本紀記「獲董憲、龐萌，山東悉平」；〈劉永傳〉記吳漢校尉韓湛追斬憲於方與，方與人黔陵亦斬萌，皆傳首洛陽。
summary.en: When Wu Han took Tan again, Dong Xian and Pang Meng fell back to hold Qu, and Wu Han besieged it. The next year the grain ran out; Xian and Meng slipped out and seized Ganyu, and when Chen Jun, governor of Langye, attacked them they fled into the marshes. In the second month Wu Han took Qu. The Annals say he "captured Dong Xian and Pang Meng, and everything east of the mountains was pacified"; the biography of Liu Yong says Wu Han's colonel Han Zhan chased Xian down and beheaded him at Fangyu, and Qian Ling of Fangyu beheaded Meng, both heads going to Luoyang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 吳漢等復攻拔郯，憲與龐萌走保朐。
passages.textEn: Wu Han and the others attacked Tan again and took it; Xian and Pang Meng fell back to hold Qu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 吳漢進圍朐。明年，城中穀盡，憲、萌潛出，襲取贛榆，琅邪太守陳俊攻之，憲、萌走澤中。
passages.textEn: Wu Han advanced and besieged Qu. The next year the grain in the city ran out; Xian and Meng slipped out and seized Ganyu, and when Chen Jun, governor of Langye, attacked them they fled into the marshes.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 二月，大司馬吳漢拔朐，獲董憲、龐萌，山東悉平。
passages.textEn: In the second month Grand Marshal Wu Han took Qu and captured Dong Xian and Pang Meng; everything east of the mountains was pacified.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 而吳漢校尉韓湛追斬憲於方與，方與人黔陵亦斬萌，皆傳首洛陽。
passages.textEn: Wu Han's colonel Han Zhan pursued Xian and beheaded him at Fangyu, and Qian Ling of Fangyu beheaded Meng; both heads were sent to Luoyang.

label.en: Dong Xian and Pang Meng break out to Ganyu

question.zh: 董憲、龐萌是被擒還是被斬？
question.en: Were Dong Xian and Pang Meng captured or beheaded?

claim.en: Wu Han took Qu and captured both.

accounts.quoteZh: 吳漢拔朐，獲董憲、龐萌

claim.zh: 韓湛追斬董憲於方與，方與人黔陵斬龐萌，傳首洛陽。
claim.en: Han Zhan beheaded Dong Xian at Fangyu, and Qian Ling beheaded Pang Meng; their heads went to Luoyang.

confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 李憲於王莽時任廬江連率，莽敗後據郡自守，更始元年自稱淮南王，建武三年自立為天子，擁九城，眾十餘萬。四年秋，光武幸壽春，遣揚武將軍馬成率三將軍伐憲，九月圍之於舒，至六年正月拔之。本紀記「獲李憲」；〈李憲傳〉記憲亡走，其軍士帛意追斬憲而降。
summary.en: Li Xian had been Wang Mang's governor of Lujiang; when Mang fell he held the commandery for himself, called himself King of Huainan in the first Gengshi year and emperor in the third year of Jianwu, with nine cities and over a hundred thousand men. In the autumn of the fourth year Guangwu went to Shouchun and sent Ma Cheng with three generals against him; they besieged him at Shu from the ninth month and took it in the first month of the sixth year. The Annals say Li Xian was captured; his biography, that he fled and was beheaded by one of his own soldiers, Bo Yi, who then surrendered.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 莽以憲爲偏將軍、廬江連率，擊破州公。莽敗，憲據郡自守。更始元年，自稱淮南王。建武三年，遂自立爲天子，置公卿百官，擁九城，衆十餘萬。
passages.textEn: Wang Mang made Xian a lieutenant general and governor of Lujiang, and he beat Wang Zhougong. When Mang fell, Xian held the commandery for himself. In the first Gengshi year he called himself King of Huainan, and in the third year of Jianwu made himself emperor, with ministers and officials, nine cities and over a hundred thousand men.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一上 光武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 遣揚武將軍馬成率三將軍伐李憲。九月，圍憲於舒。
passages.textEn: He sent Ma Cheng, General Who Displays Martial Might, with three generals against Li Xian; in the ninth month they besieged Xian at Shu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十二 王劉張李彭盧列傳
passages.textZh: 四年秋，光武幸壽春，遣楊武將軍馬成等擊憲，圍舒。至六年正月，拔之。憲亡走，其軍士帛意追斬憲而降
passages.textEn: In autumn of the fourth year Guangwu went to Shouchun and sent Ma Cheng and others against Xian; they besieged Shu and took it in the first month of the sixth year. Xian fled, and one of his own soldiers, Bo Yi, went after him, beheaded him and surrendered

passages.textEn: Ma Cheng and the others took Shu and captured Li Xian.

question.zh: 李憲是被擒還是被部下所殺？
question.en: Was Li Xian captured, or killed by his own man?

claim.zh: 馬成等拔舒，獲李憲。
claim.en: Ma Cheng took Shu and captured him.

summary.zh: 夏四月，光武幸長安，遣虎牙大將軍蓋延等七將軍從隴道伐公孫述。隗囂反，蓋延等因與囂戰於隴阺，諸將敗績。
summary.en: In the fourth month Guangwu went to Chang'an and sent Gai Yan and seven generals to attack Gongsun Shu by the Long road. Wei Xiao rebelled, Gai Yan and the others fought him on the Long slope, and the generals were routed.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 夏四月丙子，幸長安，始謁高廟，遂有事十一陵。
passages.textEn: On bingzi of the fourth month, in summer, he went to Chang'an, paid his first visit to the temple of Gaozu, and sacrificed at the eleven imperial tombs.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)

summary.en: Wei Xiao sent his general Xing Xun to raid Fufeng; Feng Yi, Grand General Who Conquers the West, held him off and beat him.

passages.textZh: 隗嚻遣將行巡寇扶風，征西大將軍馮異拒破之。

summary.zh: 代郡太守劉興擊盧芳將賈覽於高柳，戰歿。〈盧芳傳〉記賈覽將胡騎擊殺劉興。
summary.en: Liu Xing, governor of Dai, attacked Lu Fang's general Jia Lan at Gaoliu and died in battle; the biography of Lu Fang says Jia Lan, leading Hu horsemen, attacked and killed him.

passages.textEn: In the sixth year Fang's general Jia Lan, leading Hu horsemen, attacked and killed Liu Xing, governor of Dai.

summary.zh: 光武遣前將軍李通率二將軍，與公孫述的將領戰於西城，破之。
summary.en: Guangwu sent Li Tong, General of the Van, with two generals; they fought Gongsun Shu's generals at Xicheng and beat them.

passages.textEn: He sent Li Tong, General of the Van, with two generals; they fought Gongsun Shu's generals at Xicheng and beat them.

summary.zh: 公孫述立隗囂為朔寧王。秋，囂將步騎三萬侵安定，至陰槃，馮異率諸將拒之；本紀記征西大將軍馮異、征虜將軍祭遵擊卻之。
summary.en: Gongsun Shu made Wei Xiao King of Shuoning. In autumn Xiao led thirty thousand foot and horse into Anding as far as Yinpan; Feng Yi led the generals against him, and the Annals say Feng Yi and Ji Zun drove him back.

passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下

passages.textEn: Wei Xiao raided Anding; Feng Yi and Ji Zun, General Who Conquers the Caitiffs, drove him back.

label.zh: 囂將步騎三萬侵安定，至陰槃

names.name: 略陽之戰與光武親征隴右
Lüeyang, and Guangwu's march into Longyou

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 八年春，來歙與征虜將軍祭遵襲略陽，遵道病而還，分遣精兵隨歙，合二千餘人，伐山開道，從番須、回中直至略陽，斬隗囂守將金梁，據守其城。隗囂攻來歙，不能下。閏月，光武親征隗囂，竇融率河西五郡太守與車駕會於高平。隴右潰，隗囂奔西城，光武遣吳漢、岑彭圍之；進至上邽，上邽不降，命蓋延、耿弇攻之。其後公孫述遣兵救囂，吳漢、蓋延等還軍長安，天水、隴西復反歸囂；〈隗囂傳〉記王元等決圍死戰入城，迎囂歸冀，適吳漢等食盡退去，安定、北地、天水、隴西復為囂有。
summary.en: In spring of the eighth year Lai Xi and Ji Zun set out to surprise Lüeyang; Zun fell ill and turned back but sent picked troops on, and with some two thousand men Lai Xi cut a road through the mountains by Fanxu and Huizhong, reached Lüeyang, beheaded Wei Xiao's commander Jin Liang and held the city. Wei Xiao attacked him but could not take it. In the intercalary month Guangwu marched against Xiao himself, and Dou Rong brought the governors of the five Hexi commanderies to meet him at Gaoping. Longyou collapsed and Wei Xiao fled to Xicheng, where Wu Han and Cen Peng besieged him; Guangwu went on to Shanggui, which would not surrender, and set Gai Yan and Geng Yan against it. Then Gongsun Shu sent troops to relieve Xiao, Wu Han and Gai Yan withdrew to Chang'an, and Tianshui and Longxi went back over to Xiao; the biography of Wei Xiao says Wang Yuan broke through the siege lines, took Xiao back to Ji, and when Wu Han ran out of food and withdrew, Anding, Beidi, Tianshui and Longxi went back to him.

label.zh: 漢：取略陽、隴右潰，終以食盡退
label.en: Han: took Lüeyang and broke Longyou, then withdrew for want of food
besieged Xicheng, withdrew when food ran out

label.zh: 率河西五郡太守會高平
label.en: brought the five Hexi governors to Gaoping

label.zh: 隗囂：隴右潰，後復得四郡
label.en: Wei Xiao: Longyou collapsed, later regained four commanderies
sent troops to relieve Wei Xiao

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十五 李王鄧來列傳
passages.textZh: 八年春，歙與征虜將軍祭遵襲略陽，遵道病還，分遣精兵隨歙，合二千餘人，伐山開道，從番須、回中徑至略陽，斬囂守將金梁，因保其城。
passages.textEn: In spring of the eighth year Xi and Ji Zun set out to surprise Lüeyang; Zun fell ill on the way and turned back, sending picked troops on with Xi, over two thousand men in all. They cut a road through the mountains, went straight by Fanxu and Huizhong to Lüeyang, beheaded Xiao's commander Jin Liang and held the city.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 八年春正月，中郎將來歙襲略陽，殺隗嚻守將而據其城。
passages.textEn: In the first month of the eighth year, in spring, the General of the Household Lai Xi took Lüeyang by surprise, killed Wei Xiao's commander there and held the city.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 隗嚻攻來歙，不能下。閏月，帝自征嚻，河西太守竇融率五郡太守與車駕會高平。隴右潰，隗嚻奔西城，遣大司馬吳漢、征南大將軍岑彭圍之；進幸上邽，不降，命虎牙大將軍蓋延、建威大將軍耿弇攻之。
passages.textEn: Wei Xiao attacked Lai Xi but could not take the city. In the intercalary month the emperor led the campaign against Xiao himself; Dou Rong brought the governors of the five commanderies of Hexi to meet him at Gaoping. Longyou collapsed and Wei Xiao fled to Xicheng; the emperor sent Grand Marshal Wu Han and Cen Peng to besiege him there, went on to Shanggui, which would not surrender, and ordered Gai Yan and Geng Yan to attack it.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十九 耿弇列傳
passages.textZh: 六年，西拒隗囂，屯兵於漆。八年，從上隴。
passages.textEn: In the sixth year he held off Wei Xiao in the west, camping his troops at Qi. In the eighth year he went up into Long with the emperor.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 公孫述遣兵救隗嚻，吳漢、蓋延等還軍長安。天水、隴西復反歸嚻。
passages.textEn: Gongsun Shu sent troops to relieve Wei Xiao; Wu Han, Gai Yan and the others withdrew to Chang'an, and Tianshui and Longxi went back over to Xiao.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十三 隗囂公孫述列傳
passages.textZh: 元等決圍，殊死戰，遂得入城，迎囂歸冀。會吳漢等食盡退去，於是安定、北地、天水、隴西復反為囂。
passages.textEn: Wang Yuan and the others broke through the siege lines, fought desperately, got into the city and took Xiao back to Ji. Just then Wu Han and the others ran out of food and withdrew, and Anding, Beidi, Tianshui and Longxi went back over to Xiao.

label.zh: 來歙伐山開道，從番須、回中徑至略陽
label.en: Lai Xi through Fanxu and Huizhong to Lüeyang

label.zh: 竇融率五郡太守與車駕會高平
label.en: Dou Rong from Hexi to Gaoping

summary.zh: 光武遣大司馬吳漢率四將軍擊盧芳將賈覽於高柳，戰不利；驃騎大將軍杜茂與賈覽戰於繁畤，茂軍敗績。次年正月，吳漢率捕虜將軍王霸等五將軍再擊賈覽於高柳，匈奴遣騎救覽，諸將與戰，卻之。
summary.en: Guangwu sent Grand Marshal Wu Han with four generals against Lu Fang's general Jia Lan at Gaoliu, and the battle went badly; Du Mao, Grand General of Swift Cavalry, fought Jia Lan at Fanzhi and was routed. In the first month of the next year Wu Han led Wang Ba and five generals in all against Jia Lan at Gaoliu again; the Xiongnu sent horsemen to relieve Lan, and the generals fought them and drove them back.

label.zh: 漢：先兩戰不利，後卻匈奴騎
label.en: Han: beaten twice, then drove off the Xiongnu horse
sent horsemen to relieve Jia Lan

passages.textZh: 遣大司馬吳漢率四將軍擊盧芳將賈覽於高柳，戰不利。
passages.textEn: He sent Grand Marshal Wu Han with four generals against Lu Fang's general Jia Lan at Gaoliu; the battle went badly.

passages.textZh: 驃騎大將軍杜茂與賈覽戰於繁畤，茂軍敗績。

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 十年春正月，大司馬吳漢率捕虜將軍王霸等五將軍擊賈覽於高柳，匈奴遣騎救覽，諸將與戰，郤之。
passages.textEn: In the first month of the tenth year, in spring, Wu Han led Wang Ba and five generals in all against Jia Lan at Gaoliu; the Xiongnu sent horsemen to relieve Lan, and the generals fought them and drove them back.

summary.zh: 九年正月，隗囂病死，其將王元、周宗立其子純為王；〈隗囂傳〉記囂病且餓，出城食糗糒，恚憤而死。八月，光武遣中郎將來歙監征西大將軍馮異等五將軍討隗純於天水。十年冬十月，來歙等大破隗純於落門，其將王元奔蜀，純與周宗降，隴右平。
summary.en: In the first month of the ninth year Wei Xiao died of illness, and his generals Wang Yuan and Zhou Zong made his son Chun king; his biography says that, ill and starving, he came out of the city to eat parched grain and died in a fit of rage. In the eighth month Guangwu sent Lai Xi to oversee Feng Yi and five generals in all against Wei Chun in Tianshui. In the tenth month of the tenth year Lai Xi and the others crushed Wei Chun at Luomen; his general Wang Yuan fled to Shu, Chun and Zhou Zong surrendered, and Longyou was pacified.

label.en: Wei Chun and Zhou Zong, surrendered (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 九年春正月，隗嚻病死，其將王元、周宗復立嚻子純爲王。
passages.textEn: In the first month of the ninth year, in spring, Wei Xiao died of illness; his generals Wang Yuan and Zhou Zong set up his son Chun as king.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十三 隗囂公孫述列傳
passages.textZh: 九年春，囂病且餓，出城餐糗糒，恚憤而死。王元、周宗立囂少子純為王。明年，來歙、耿弇、蓋延等攻破落門，周宗、行巡、苛宇、趙恢等將純降。
passages.textEn: In spring of the ninth year Xiao, ill and starving, came out of the city to eat parched grain and died in a fit of rage. Wang Yuan and Zhou Zong made his youngest son Chun king. The next year Lai Xi, Geng Yan, Gai Yan and the others broke through at Luomen, and Zhou Zong, Xing Xun, Ke Yu, Zhao Hui and the others brought Chun in to surrender.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 秋八月，遣中郎將來歙監征西大將軍馮異等五將軍討隗純於天水。
passages.textEn: In autumn, in the eighth month, he sent Lai Xi to oversee Feng Yi and five generals in all against Wei Chun in Tianshui.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 冬十月，中郎將來歙等大破隗純於落門，其將王元奔蜀，純與周宗降，隴右平。
passages.textEn: In winter, in the tenth month, Lai Xi and the others crushed Wei Chun at Luomen; his general Wang Yuan fled to Shu, Chun and Zhou Zong surrendered, and Longyou was pacified.

label.zh: 來歙等五將軍討隗純於天水
label.en: Lai Xi and five generals against Wei Chun

confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 建武九年，公孫述遣任滿、田戎、程汎率數萬人乘筏下江關，擊破馮駿等，拔夷道、夷陵，據荊門、虎牙，橫江起浮橋、鬥樓，立欑柱絕水道，結營山上以拒漢兵。十一年閏月，岑彭率三將軍攻荊門：時天風狂急，偏將軍魯奇船逆流直衝浮橋，被欑柱鉤住，奇等殊死戰，以火炬焚之，風怒火盛，橋樓崩燒；岑彭悉軍順風並進，蜀兵大亂，溺死數千人。任滿被斬（本紀作「獲」），程汎被生擒，田戎退保江州。岑彭留馮駿圍江州，自引兵直指墊江，攻破平曲；又溯都江而上，襲破侯丹，倍道兼行二千餘里，徑拔武陽。後蜀刺客詐為亡奴來降，夜刺殺岑彭。
summary.en: In the ninth year of Jianwu Gongsun Shu sent Ren Man, Tian Rong and Cheng Fan with tens of thousands of men down through the Jiang Pass on rafts; they beat Feng Jun and others, took Yidao and Yiling and held Jingmen and Huya, throwing a floating bridge with fighting towers across the river, planting stakes to close it and camping on the hills. In the intercalary month of the eleventh year Cen Peng attacked with three generals. In a fierce wind Lu Qi's boat rammed the floating bridge from downstream and was caught on the stakes; his men fought to the death and threw torches, and the bridge and towers burned and collapsed. Cen Peng sent his whole army forward with the wind; the Shu troops broke and several thousand drowned. Ren Man was beheaded (the Annals say captured), Cheng Fan taken alive, and Tian Rong fell back to hold Jiangzhou. Leaving Feng Jun to besiege Jiangzhou, Cen Peng pressed on to Dianjiang and broke Pingqu, then went up the Du River, crushed Hou Dan, and marching at double pace for over two thousand li took Wuyang. Later an assassin from Shu, posing as a runaway slave, stabbed him to death in the night.

label.zh: 公孫述：任滿、田戎、程汎（敗）
label.en: Gongsun Shu: Ren Man, Tian Rong, Cheng Fan (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 公孫述遣將田戎、任滿據荊門。
passages.textEn: Gongsun Shu sent his generals Tian Rong and Ren Man to hold Jingmen.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 九年，公孫述遣其將任滿、田戎、程汎，將數萬人乘枋箄下江關，擊破馮駿及田鴻、李玄等。遂拔夷道、夷陵，據荊門、虎牙。橫江水起浮橋、鬥樓，立欑柱絕水道，結營山上，以拒漢兵。
passages.textEn: In the ninth year Gongsun Shu sent his generals Ren Man, Tian Rong and Cheng Fan with several tens of thousands of men down through the Jiang Pass on rafts. They beat Feng Jun, Tian Hong, Li Xuan and the others, took Yidao and Yiling, and held Jingmen and Huya. They threw a floating bridge with fighting towers across the river, planted stakes to close the waterway and camped on the hills to hold off the Han army.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 閏月，征南大將軍岑彭率三將軍與公孫述將田戎、任滿戰於荊門，大破之，獲任滿。威虜將軍馮駿圍田戎於江州，岑彭遂率舟師伐公孫述，平巴郡。
passages.textEn: In the intercalary month Cen Peng with three generals fought Gongsun Shu's generals Tian Rong and Ren Man at Jingmen, crushed them and captured Ren Man. Feng Jun, General Who Awes the Caitiffs, besieged Tian Rong at Jiangzhou, and Cen Peng went on with his fleet against Gongsun Shu and pacified Ba commandery.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 時天風狂急，奇船逆流而上，直沖浮橋，而欑柱鉤不得去，奇等乘勢殊死戰，因飛炬焚之，風怒火盛，橋樓崩燒。彭復悉軍順風並進，所向無前。蜀兵大亂，溺死者數千人。斬任滿，生獲程汎，而田戎亡保江州。
passages.textEn: A fierce wind was blowing. Lu Qi's boat went upstream and rammed straight into the floating bridge, where the stakes caught it and it could not get free; Qi and his men fought to the death where they were and threw torches, and with the wind roaring and the fire blazing the bridge and its towers burned and collapsed. Peng then sent his whole army forward with the wind behind it, and nothing could stand before it. The Shu troops fell into confusion and several thousand drowned. Ren Man was beheaded and Cheng Fan taken alive, while Tian Rong fled to hold Jiangzhou.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 彭到江州，以田戎食多，難卒拔，留馮駿守之，自引兵乘利直指墊江，攻破平曲，收其米數十萬石。
passages.textEn: Peng reached Jiangzhou; since Tian Rong had plenty of food and could not be taken quickly, he left Feng Jun to besiege it and himself pressed on to Dianjiang, broke Pingqu and seized several hundred thousand shi of its rice.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 自分兵浮江下還江州，溯都江而上，襲擊侯丹，大破之。因晨夜倍道兼行二千餘里，徑拔武陽。
passages.textEn: He himself took part of the army down the river back to Jiangzhou and up the Du River, fell on Hou Dan and crushed him; then, marching day and night at double pace for over two thousand li, he went straight on and took Wuyang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷十七 馮岑賈列傳
passages.textZh: 會日暮，蜀刺客詐為亡奴降，夜刺殺彭。
passages.textEn: Night was falling; an assassin from Shu, pretending to be a runaway slave come to surrender, stabbed Peng to death in the night.

label.zh: 溯都江而上，襲擊侯丹…徑拔武陽
label.en: Up the Du River to Wuyang

question.en: Was Ren Man captured or beheaded?

claim.zh: 岑彭大破之，獲任滿。
claim.en: Cen Peng crushed them and captured Ren Man.

accounts.quoteZh: 大破之，獲任滿

claim.zh: 蜀兵大亂，斬任滿，生獲程汎。
claim.en: The Shu army broke; Ren Man was beheaded and Cheng Fan taken alive.

accounts.quoteZh: 斬任滿，生獲程汎

summary.zh: 六月，中郎將來歙率揚武將軍馬成，於下辯擊破公孫述將王元、環安。環安遣人刺殺來歙。
summary.en: In the sixth month Lai Xi with Ma Cheng beat Gongsun Shu's generals Wang Yuan and Huan An at Xiabian. Huan An sent an assassin who stabbed Lai Xi to death.

label.en: Gongsun Shu: Wang Yuan, Huan An (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷一下 光武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 六月，中郎將來歙率揚武將軍馬成破公孫述將王元、環安於下辯。安遣間人刺殺中郎將來歙。
passages.textEn: In the sixth month Lai Xi with Ma Cheng beat Gongsun Shu's generals Wang Yuan and Huan An at Xiabian. Huan An sent an assassin who stabbed Lai Xi to death.

summary.zh: 成吉思汗封為太師、國王，受命經略太行以南。自燕南下，破大名，東定益都諸州；後由西京入河東，太原諸州悉降，遂取平陽。
summary.en: Made Grand Preceptor and Prince of State by Chinggis Khan and charged with the lands south of the Taihang. He went south from Yan, broke Daming and secured Yidu and the prefectures around it; then from the Western Capital he entered Hedong, where Taiyuan and the other prefectures surrendered, and took Pingyang.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十九 木華黎傳
passages.textZh: 丁丑八月，詔封太師、國王、都行省承制行事
passages.textEn: In the eighth month of dingchou he was made Grand Preceptor and Prince of State, head of the branch secretariat with power to act on the emperor's behalf

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十九 木華黎傳
passages.textZh: 太行之北，朕自經略，太行以南，卿其勉之。
passages.textEn: "North of the Taihang I shall see to myself; south of the Taihang, do your best."

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十九 木華黎傳
passages.textZh: 乃建行省于雲、燕，以圖中原。遂自燕南攻遂城及蠡州諸城，拔之。冬，破大名府，遂東定益都、淄、登、萊、濰、密等州。戊寅，自西京由太和嶺入河東，攻太原、忻、代、澤、潞、汾、霍等州，悉降之。遂徇平陽，金守臣棄城遁
passages.textEn: He set up the branch secretariat in Yun and Yan to take the Central Plain. From Yan he went south and took Suicheng, Lizhou and other towns; in winter he broke Daming and went on east to secure Yidu, Zi, Deng, Lai, Wei, Mi and other prefectures. In wuyin he went from the Western Capital by the Taihe ridge into Hedong, attacked Taiyuan, Xin, Dai, Ze, Lu, Fen, Huo and other prefectures, and all surrendered. He then took Pingyang, whose Jin commander abandoned the city and fled

summary.zh: 成吉思汗之子。伐金時總右軍，自鳳翔過寶雞，入宋境沿漢水而下，渡漢後輕騎北進，於三峯山大破金軍，金之精銳盡於此役。
summary.en: A son of Chinggis Khan. In the campaign against Jin he led the right wing from Fengxiang past Baoji through Song territory and down the Han; across the Han he pressed north with light horse and crushed the Jin army at Sanfeng Mountain, where the flower of Jin's army was lost.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十五 睿宗傳
passages.textZh: 太宗以中軍自碗子城南下，渡河，由洛陽進；斡陳那顏以左軍由濟南進；而拖雷總右軍自鳳翔渡渭水，過寶雞，入小潼關，涉宋人之境，沿漢水而下。期以明年春，俱會于汴。
passages.textEn: Taizong took the centre south from Wanzicheng across the Yellow River by way of Luoyang; Wochen Noyan took the left by way of Jinan; and Tolui led the right from Fengxiang across the Wei, past Baoji, through the Little Tong Pass into Song territory and down the Han. They were to meet at Bian in the spring of the next year.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十五 睿宗傳
passages.textZh: 拖雷既渡漢，金大將合達設伏二十餘萬于鄧州之西，據隘待之。時拖雷兵不滿四萬，及得諜報，乃悉留輜重，輕騎以進。
passages.textEn: When Tolui had crossed the Han, the Jin grand general Heda laid an ambush of over two hundred thousand west of Dengzhou, holding the passes to wait for him. Tolui had fewer than forty thousand; told of it by his scouts, he left all his baggage and pressed on with light horse.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十五 睿宗傳
passages.textZh: 遂奮擊于三峯山，大破之，追奔數十里，流血被道，資仗委積，金之精銳盡於此矣。
passages.textEn: So he attacked furiously at Sanfeng Mountain and crushed them, pursuing for dozens of li; blood covered the roads, abandoned arms lay in heaps, and the flower of Jin's army was gone.

summary.zh: 張氏據姑臧之涼。前秦遣苟萇等率騎十三萬伐之，涼軍敗於洪池、赤岸，張天錫面縛輿櫬，降於軍門。
summary.en: The Liang state of the Zhang family at Guzang. Former Qin sent Gou Chang and others with a hundred and thirty thousand horse against it; its armies were beaten at Hongchi and Chi'an, and Zhang Tianxi surrendered at the camp gate with his hands bound and his coffin behind him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十三 苻堅載記上
passages.textZh: 遣其武衛苟萇、左將軍毛盛、中書令梁熙、步兵校尉姚萇等率騎十三萬伐張天賜于姑臧。
passages.textEn: He sent Gou Chang, Mao Sheng, Liang Xi, Yao Chang and others with a hundred and thirty thousand horse against Zhang Tianxi at Guzang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十三 苻堅載記上
passages.textZh: 萇、熙聞天錫來逼，急攻據、建，建降於萇，遂攻據，害之，及其軍司席仂。萇進軍入清塞，乘高列陣。天錫又遣司兵趙充哲為前鋒，率勁勇五萬，與萇等戰於赤岸，哲大敗。天錫懼而奔還，至箋請降。萇至姑臧，天錫乘素車白馬，面縛輿櫬，降於軍門。
passages.textEn: Hearing that Tianxi was coming against them, Gou Chang and Liang Xi attacked Zhang Ju and Ma Jian at once; Ma Jian went over to Chang, who then attacked Zhang Ju and killed him with his adjutant Xi Le. Chang advanced into Qingsai and drew up on the heights. Tianxi sent Zhao Chongzhe ahead with fifty thousand of his best, who fought Chang and the others at Chi'an and was routed. Tianxi fled home in fear and wrote asking to surrender; when Chang reached Guzang, Tianxi came out in a plain carriage drawn by a white horse, hands bound and his coffin carried behind him, and surrendered at the gate of the camp.

summary.zh: 拓跋氏之國。前秦遣苻洛等諸道來伐，代軍敗於石子嶺，代王（〈序紀〉稱帝）避於陰山之北，後至雲中而崩；《晉書》則稱其子縛父請降。
summary.en: The state of the Tuoba. Former Qin sent Fu Luo and others against it by several roads; the Dai army was beaten at Shiziling and the ruler withdrew north of the Yin Mountains, dying later at Yunzhong according to the Book of Wei; the Book of Jin says his son bound him and surrendered.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷一 序紀
passages.textZh: 三十九年，苻堅遣其大司馬苻洛率眾二十萬及朱彤、張蚝、鄧羌等諸道來寇，侵逼南境。冬十一月，白部、獨孤部禦之，敗績。南部大人劉庫仁走雲中。帝復遣庫仁率騎十萬逆戰於石子嶺，王師不利。帝時不豫，羣臣莫可任者，乃率國人避於陰山之北。
passages.textEn: In the thirty-ninth year Fu Jian sent his Grand Marshal Fu Luo with two hundred thousand men, with Zhu Tong, Zhang Ci, Deng Qiang and others, to invade by several roads and press on the southern border. In the eleventh month, in winter, the Bai and Dugu tribes met them and were routed; Liu Kuren, chief of the southern division, fled to Yunzhong. The ruler sent Kuren again with a hundred thousand horse to fight at Shiziling, and the royal army fared badly. The ruler was ill and no minister could be trusted with command, so he led his people away north of the Yin Mountains.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷一 序紀
passages.textZh: 堅軍稍退，乃還。十二月，至雲中，旬有二日，帝崩，時年五十七。
passages.textEn: When Jian's army drew back a little he returned. In the twelfth month he reached Yunzhong, and twelve days later he died, aged fifty-seven.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十三 苻堅載記上
passages.textZh: 堅既平涼州，又遣其安北將軍、幽州刺史苻洛為北討大都督，率幽州兵十萬討代王涉翼犍。又遣後將軍俱難與鄧羌等率步騎二十萬東出和龍，西出上郡，與洛會於涉翼犍庭。翼犍戰敗，遁于弱水。苻洛逐之，勢窘迫，退還陰山。其子翼圭縛父請降
passages.textEn: With Liang pacified, Jian sent Fu Luo, Governor of You Province, as grand commander of the northern campaign with a hundred thousand troops of You against Sheyijian, King of Dai, and sent Ju Nan, Deng Qiang and others with two hundred thousand foot and horse out east from Helong and west from Shang commandery to meet Fu Luo at Sheyijian's court. Yijian was beaten and fled to the Ruo River; Fu Luo pursued him, and in desperate straits he fell back to the Yin Mountains. His son Yigui bound his father and asked to surrender

summary.zh: 前趙之主。敗石季龍於高候，圍洛陽；石勒親救，於西陽門大戰，曜軍大潰，被石堪所執。
summary.en: Ruler of Former Zhao. He beat Shi Jilong at Gaohou and besieged Luoyang; Shi Le came to its relief himself, and in the great battle at the Xiyang Gate Yao's army broke and Shi Kan seized him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百五 石勒載記下
passages.textZh: 劉曜敗季龍于高候，遂圍洛陽。
passages.textEn: Liu Yao beat Shi Jilong at Gaohou and besieged Luoyang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百五 石勒載記下
passages.textZh: 勒統步騎四萬人自宣陽門，升故太極前殿。季龍步卒三萬，自城北而西，攻其中軍，石堪、石聰等各以精騎八千，城西而北，擊其前鋒，大戰于西陽門。勒躬貫甲胄，出自閶闔，夾擊之。曜軍大潰，石堪執曜，送之以徇於軍，斬首五萬餘級，枕屍于金穀。
passages.textEn: Le led forty thousand foot and horse in by the Xuanyang Gate and up to the old Taiji Hall. Shi Jilong with thirty thousand foot came west round the north of the city against Liu Yao's centre, while Shi Kan and Shi Cong, each with eight thousand picked horse, came north round the west of the city against his van, and a great battle was fought at the Xiyang Gate. Le in his armour came out by the Changhe Gate to take them from both sides. Yao's army collapsed; Shi Kan seized Yao and paraded him before the troops, over fifty thousand were beheaded, and the dead lay as far as Jingu.

summary.zh: 字季龍，石勒部將。洛陽之戰攻劉曜中軍；後於義渠大破劉胤，乘勝追至上邽，上邽潰，執前趙太子劉熙等，秦、隴悉平。
summary.en: Courtesy name Jilong, a general of Shi Le. At Luoyang he attacked Liu Yao's centre; later he crushed Liu Yin at Yiqu, pursued him to Shanggui, which fell, and seized the Former Zhao crown prince Liu Xi and the rest, so that Qin and Long were pacified.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百五 石勒載記下
passages.textZh: 勒統步騎四萬人自宣陽門，升故太極前殿。季龍步卒三萬，自城北而西，攻其中軍，石堪、石聰等各以精騎八千，城西而北，擊其前鋒，大戰于西陽門。勒躬貫甲胄，出自閶闔，夾擊之。曜軍大潰，石堪執曜，送之以徇於軍，斬首五萬餘級，枕屍于金穀。
passages.textEn: Le led forty thousand foot and horse in by the Xuanyang Gate and up to the old Taiji Hall. Shi Jilong with thirty thousand foot came west round the north of the city against Liu Yao's centre, while Shi Kan and Shi Cong, each with eight thousand picked horse, came north round the west of the city against his van, and a great battle was fought at the Xiyang Gate. Le in his armour came out by the Changhe Gate to take them from both sides. Yao's army collapsed; Shi Kan seized Yao and paraded him before the troops, over fifty thousand were beheaded, and the dead lay as far as Jingu.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百三 劉曜載記
passages.textZh: 胤及劉遵率眾數萬，自上邽將攻石生於長安，隴東、武都、安定、新平、北地、扶風、始平諸郡戎夏皆起兵應胤。胤次於仲橋，石生固守長安。勒使石季龍率騎二萬距胤，戰于義渠，為季龍所敗，死者五千餘人。胤奔上邽，季龍乘勝追戰，枕屍千里，上邽潰。季龍執其偽太子熙、南陽王劉胤並將相諸王等及其諸卿校公侯已下三千餘人，皆殺之。
passages.textEn: Liu Yin and Liu Zun led several tens of thousands from Shanggui to attack Shi Sheng at Chang'an, and the barbarians and Chinese of Longdong, Wudu, Anding, Xinping, Beidi, Fufeng and Shiping all rose in support. Yin camped at Zhongqiao while Shi Sheng held Chang'an. Le sent Shi Jilong with twenty thousand horse against Yin; they fought at Yiqu, and Yin was beaten with over five thousand dead. He fled to Shanggui with Jilong in pursuit, the dead lying for a thousand li, and Shanggui fell. Jilong seized the crown prince Xi, Liu Yin, Prince of Nanyang, the generals, ministers and princes, and their officials down to the marquises, over three thousand in all, and killed them all.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百五 石勒載記下
passages.textZh: 季龍克上邽，遣主簿趙封送傳國玉璽、金璽、太子玉璽各一於勒。季龍進攻集木且羌於河西，克之，俘獲數萬，秦、隴悉平。
passages.textEn: Jilong took Shanggui and sent his secretary Zhao Feng to Le with the jade seal of the realm, the gold seal and the crown prince's jade seal. He went on to attack the Jimuqie Qiang west of the Yellow River and beat them, taking tens of thousands of captives, and Qin and Long were wholly pacified.

summary.zh: 揚州刺史，州治壽春為袁術所據，乃渡江治曲阿，遣將屯橫江津、當利口以拒袁術。孫策渡江轉鬥，劉繇棄軍遁逃。
summary.en: Governor of Yang Province. With his seat at Shouchun held by Yuan Shu, he crossed the Yangzi to govern from Qu'a and posted troops at the Hengjiang ford and Dangli against Shu. When Sun Ce crossed and fought his way forward, Liu Yao abandoned his army and fled.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷四十六 吳書 孫破虜討逆傳
passages.textZh: 繇遣樊能、于麋東屯橫江津，張英屯當利口，以距術。
passages.textEn: Liu Yao sent Fan Neng and Yu Mi east to camp at the Hengjiang ford, and Zhang Ying to camp at Dangli, to keep Yuan Shu out.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷四十六 吳書 孫破虜討逆傳
passages.textZh: 劉繇棄軍遁逃，諸郡守皆捐城郭奔走。
passages.textEn: Liu Yao abandoned his army and fled, and the governors of the commanderies all left their cities and ran.

summary.zh: 廬江太守。袁術死後截取其部眾，孫策誘其往攻上繚，乘虛襲拔廬江，勳歸曹操。
summary.en: Governor of Lujiang. After Yuan Shu's death he seized Shu's followers; Sun Ce lured him away to attack Shangliao, took Lujiang behind his back, and Xun went over to Cao Cao.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷四十六 吳書 孫破虜討逆傳
passages.textZh: 後術死，長史楊弘、大將張勳等將其衆欲就策，廬江太守劉勳要擊，悉虜之，收其珍寶以歸。策聞之，僞與勳好盟。勳新得術衆，時豫章上繚宗民萬餘家在江東。策勸勳攻取之。勳旣行，策輕軍晨夜襲拔廬江，勳衆盡降，勳獨與麾下數百人自歸曹公。
passages.textEn: After Yuan Shu died, his chief clerk Yang Hong and his general Zhang Xun set out with his followers to join Sun Ce, but Liu Xun, governor of Lujiang, waylaid and captured them all and took their treasure home. Hearing of it, Ce pretended friendship and swore an alliance with Xun. Xun had just taken over Shu's followers, and the clans of Shangliao in Yuzhang, over ten thousand households, were then east of the river; Ce urged Xun to attack them. When Xun had gone, Ce came with light troops by day and night and took Lujiang by surprise; Xun's men all surrendered, and Xun went over to Cao Cao with a few hundred of his own guard.

summary.zh: 據宛，降曹操後復反，敗曹軍，曹昂等遇害；與劉表合兵，於穰、安眾與曹操相持。建安四年率眾降曹，封列侯。
summary.en: He held Wan, surrendered to Cao Cao and then rebelled, beating Cao's army and killing his son Ang; joined with Liu Biao he fought Cao at Rang and Anzhong. In 199 he surrendered with his followers and was made a marquis.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷一 魏書 武帝紀
passages.textZh: 二年春正月，公到宛。張繡降，旣而悔之，復反。公與戰，軍敗，爲流矢所中，長子昂、弟子安民遇害。
passages.textEn: In the first month of the second year, in spring, Cao reached Wan. Zhang Xiu surrendered, then regretted it and rebelled. Cao fought him and was beaten, struck by a stray arrow; his eldest son Ang and his nephew Anmin were killed.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷一 魏書 武帝紀
passages.textZh: 三月，公圍張繡於穰。夏五月，劉表遣兵救繡，以絕軍後。
passages.textEn: In the third month Cao besieged Zhang Xiu at Rang. In the fifth month, in summer, Liu Biao sent troops to relieve Xiu and cut off Cao's rear.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷一 魏書 武帝紀
passages.textZh: 冬十一月，張繡率衆降，封列侯。
passages.textEn: In the eleventh month, in winter, Zhang Xiu surrendered with his followers and was made a marquis.

summary.zh: 延光二年為西域長史，出屯柳中，鄯善、龜茲相繼歸附，擊走匈奴伊蠡王，車師前部復通；又破車師後部，後與張朗分道擊焉耆。
summary.en: Made Chief Clerk of the Western Regions in the second Yanguang year, he camped at Liuzhong; Shanshan and Qiuci came over, he drove off the Xiongnu King Yili and reopened the Nearer Jushi; he then broke the Further Jushi, and later attacked Yanqi with Zhang Lang by two roads.

label.en: Chief Clerk of the Western Regions

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷四十七 班梁列傳
passages.textZh: 延光二年夏，復以勇爲西域長史，將兵五百人出屯柳中。明年正月，勇至樓蘭，以鄯善歸附，特加三綬。而龜茲王白英猶自疑未下，勇開以恩信，白英乃率姑墨、溫宿自縛詣勇降。勇因發其兵步騎萬餘人到車師前王庭，擊走匈奴伊蠡王於伊和谷，收得前部五千餘人，於是前部始復開通。
passages.textEn: In the summer of the second Yanguang year Yong was again made Chief Clerk of the Western Regions and went out with five hundred men to camp at Liuzhong. In the first month of the next year he reached Loulan and, since Shanshan had come over, it was given three ribbons of office. Baiying, king of Qiuci, still hesitated, but Yong won him with kindness and good faith, and Baiying came with Gumo and Wensu, bound himself and surrendered. Yong then raised their troops, over ten thousand foot and horse, went to the court of the Nearer Jushi king, drove the Xiongnu King Yili from the Yihe valley, and won back five thousand people of the Nearer Division, which was opened again.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷四十七 班梁列傳
passages.textZh: 四年秋，勇發敦煌、張掖、酒泉六千騎及鄯善、疏勒、車師前部兵擊後部王軍就，大破之。
passages.textEn: In the autumn of the fourth year Yong raised six thousand horsemen from Dunhuang, Zhangye and Jiuquan, with troops of Shanshan, Shule and the Nearer Jushi, and attacked Junjiu, king of the Further Division, crushing him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷四十七 班梁列傳
passages.textZh: 二年，勇上請攻元孟，於是遣敦煌太守張朗將河西四郡兵三千人配勇。因發諸國兵四萬餘人，分騎爲兩道擊之。勇從南道，朗從北道，約期俱至焉耆。
passages.textEn: In the second year Yong asked leave to attack Yuanmeng, and Zhang Lang, governor of Dunhuang, was sent with three thousand troops of the four Hexi commanderies to join him. They raised over forty thousand troops of the states and attacked in two columns, Yong by the southern road and Lang by the northern, agreeing to meet at Yanqi.

summary.zh: 羌之一種。永初元年叛，斷隴道，大敗鄧隲、任尚，其豪滇零稱天子於北地，寇三輔、趙魏、益州。後為段熲所破於逢義山。
summary.en: A Qiang people. In 107 they rebelled, cut the Long road and beat Deng Zhi and Ren Shang; their chief Dianling proclaimed himself emperor in Beidi and raided the Three Adjuncts, Zhao and Wei, and Yi Province. Later Duan Jiong broke them at Mount Fengyi.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷五 孝安帝紀
passages.textZh: 先零種羌叛，斷隴道，大爲寇掠，遣車騎將軍鄧隲、征西校尉任尚討之。
passages.textEn: The Xianling Qiang rebelled, cut the Long road and plundered far and wide; General of Chariots and Cavalry Deng Zhi and Colonel Ren Shang were sent against them.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷五 孝安帝紀
passages.textZh: 先零羌滇零稱天子於北地，遂寇三輔，東犯趙、魏，南入益州，殺漢中太守董炳。
passages.textEn: Dianling of the Xianling Qiang proclaimed himself emperor in Beidi, then raided the Three Adjuncts, struck east into Zhao and Wei and south into Yi Province, killing Dong Bing, governor of Hanzhong.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷六十五 皇甫張段列傳
passages.textZh: 建寧元年春，熲將兵萬餘人，繼十五日糧，從彭陽直指高平，與先零諸種戰於逢義山。
passages.textEn: In the spring of the first Jianning year Jiong led over ten thousand men with fifteen days' rations from Pengyang straight for Gaoping, and fought the Xianling tribes at Mount Fengyi.

summary.zh: 東漢將領。建寧元年率萬餘人自彭陽直指高平，於逢義山大破先零羌，又追至奢延澤，羌眾散入漢陽山谷。
summary.en: A general of Eastern Han. In 168 he led over ten thousand men from Pengyang to Gaoping and crushed the Xianling Qiang at Mount Fengyi, then pursued them to the Sheyan marsh until they scattered into the valleys of Hanyang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷六十五 皇甫張段列傳
passages.textZh: 建寧元年春，熲將兵萬餘人，繼十五日糧，從彭陽直指高平，與先零諸種戰於逢義山。
passages.textEn: In the spring of the first Jianning year Jiong led over ten thousand men with fifteen days' rations from Pengyang straight for Gaoping, and fought the Xianling tribes at Mount Fengyi.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷六十五 皇甫張段列傳
passages.textZh: 夏，熲復追羌出橋門，至走馬水上。尋聞虜在奢延澤，乃將輕兵兼行，一日一夜二百餘里，晨及賊，擊破之。
passages.textEn: In summer Jiong pursued the Qiang again out through Qiaomen to the Zouma River. Hearing that they were at the Sheyan marsh, he took light troops at double pace, over two hundred li in a day and a night, caught them at dawn and broke them.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷六十五 皇甫張段列傳
passages.textZh: 既到涇陽，餘寇四千落，悉散入漢陽山谷閒。
passages.textEn: When they reached Jingyang, the four thousand camps left of the raiders all scattered into the valleys of Hanyang.

summary.zh: 檀石槐所統之鮮卑。寇抄漢邊不止，漢欲封王和親，檀石槐不受，分其地為三部。熹平六年漢三道出塞擊之，大敗而還。
summary.en: The Xianbei under Tanshihuai. They raided the Han frontier ceaselessly; when Han offered a kingship and marriage alliance he refused, and divided his lands into three divisions. In 177 Han sent three columns beyond the frontier against them, and all were routed.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷九十 烏桓鮮卑列傳
passages.textZh: 朝廷積患之，而不能制，遂遣使持印綬封檀石槐為王，欲與和親。檀石槐不肯受，而寇抄滋甚。乃自分其地為三部
passages.textEn: The court suffered from them for years and could not stop them, so it sent envoys with a seal to make Tanshihuai a king and seek peace by marriage. He would not accept, and raided all the more; he divided his lands into three divisions

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷九十 烏桓鮮卑列傳
passages.textZh: 遂遣夏育出高柳，田晏出雲中，匈奴中郎將臧旻率南單于出鴈門，各將萬騎，三道出塞二千餘里。檀石槐命三部大人各帥眾逆戰，育等大敗，喪其節傳輜重，各將數十騎奔還，死者十七八。
passages.textEn: So Xia Yu was sent out from Gaoliu, Tian Yan from Yunzhong, and Zang Min, General of the Household for the Xiongnu, with the southern chanyu from Yanmen, each with ten thousand horse, by three roads over two thousand li beyond the frontier. Tanshihuai had the chiefs of his three divisions each lead their men against them; Xia Yu and the others were routed, lost their credentials and baggage, and each fled home with a few dozen horsemen; seven or eight in ten had died.

summary.zh: 北宋秦鳳路沿邊安撫。復武勝軍（改熙州，置熙河路），又復河州，獲木征妻子，入岷州。
summary.en: Pacification Commissioner of the Qinfeng frontier under Northern Song. He recovered Wushengjun (made Xizhou, seat of the new Xihe circuit), then Hezhou, where he captured Muzheng's wife and children, and entered Minzhou.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 秦鳳路沿邊安撫王韶復武勝軍。
passages.textEn: Wang Shao, Pacification Commissioner of the Qinfeng frontier, recovered Wushengjun.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 冬十月戊戌，升鎮洮軍爲熙州、鎮洮軍節度，置熙河路。
passages.textEn: On wuxu of the tenth month, in winter, Zhentao was raised to Xizhou with a military governor, and the Xihe circuit was set up.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 王韶復河州，獲木征妻子。
passages.textEn: Wang Shao recovered Hezhou and captured Muzheng's wife and children.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 戊午，岷州首領木令征以其城降，王韶入岷州。
passages.textEn: On wuwu Mulingzheng, chief of Minzhou, surrendered his town, and Wang Shao entered Minzhou.

summary.zh: 河州吐蕃首領。王韶復河州，獲其妻子。
summary.en: A Tibetan chief at Hezhou. When Wang Shao recovered Hezhou he captured Muzheng's wife and children.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 王韶復河州，獲木征妻子。
passages.textEn: Wang Shao recovered Hezhou and captured Muzheng's wife and children.

summary.zh: 北宋安南道招討使。率軍自桂州分水陸南下，敗交阯於富良江，獲其太子，李乾德奉表請降。
summary.en: Commander of the Annam campaign under Northern Song. He led the army south from Guizhou by land and sea, beat Jiaozhi on the Fuliang River and captured its crown prince, and Li Qiande submitted.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 二月戊子，宣徽南院使郭逵爲安南道招討使，罷李憲，以趙禼副之。詔占城、占臘合擊交阯。
passages.textEn: On wuzi of the second month Guo Kui was made commander of the Annam campaign, replacing Li Xian, with Zhao Xie as his deputy, and Champa and Cambodia were called on to join the attack on Jiaozhi.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 是月，安南行營次桂州，郭逵遣鈐轄和斌等督水軍涉海自廣東入，諸軍自廣南入。
passages.textEn: That month the Annam army reached Guizhou; Guo Kui sent He Bin and others with the fleet by sea from Guangdong, and the other armies went in from Guangnan.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 癸卯，郭逵敗交阯于富良江，獲其偽太子洪真，李乾德遣人奉表詣軍門降，逵遂班師。
passages.textEn: On guimao Guo Kui beat Jiaozhi on the Fuliang River and captured its pretended crown prince Hongzhen; Li Qiande sent a memorial of submission to the camp gate, and Kui led the army home.

summary.zh: 宋人所稱交阯，時由李乾德主政。熙寧八、九年攻陷欽、廉、邕三州；宋遣郭逵南伐，敗之於富良江，李乾德奉表請降。
summary.en: The state the Song called Jiaozhi, then ruled by Li Qiande (Lý Càn Đức). In 1075–76 it took Qinzhou, Lianzhou and Yongzhou; Song sent Guo Kui south, who beat it on the Fuliang River, and Li Qiande submitted.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 十一月戊寅，交阯陷欽州。壬午，立陝西蕃丁法。甲申，交阯陷廉州。
passages.textEn: On wuyin of the eleventh month Jiaozhi took Qinzhou. On renwu the law on barbarian conscripts in Shaanxi was made. On jiashen Jiaozhi took Lianzhou.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 戊辰，交阯陷邕州，知州蘇緘死之。
passages.textEn: On wuchen Jiaozhi took Yongzhou, and its prefect Su Jian died there.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 癸卯，郭逵敗交阯于富良江，獲其偽太子洪真，李乾德遣人奉表詣軍門降，逵遂班師。
passages.textEn: On guimao Guo Kui beat Jiaozhi on the Fuliang River and captured its pretended crown prince Hongzhen; Li Qiande sent a memorial of submission to the camp gate, and Kui led the army home.

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 成吉思汗親自南伐，於野狐嶺擊敗金將定薛，取大水濼、豐利等縣。金重築烏沙堡，七月遮別攻拔之；八月成吉思汗與金軍戰於宣平之會河川，大敗之；九月拔德興府，居庸關守將遁走，遮別入關直抵中都。《金史》記九月金將千家奴、胡沙敗績於會河堡，居庸關失守。
summary.en: Chinggis Khan led the southern campaign himself, beat the Jin general Dingxue at Yehuling and took Dashuiluo, Fengli and other counties. Jin rebuilt the fortress of Wushabao, which Jebe stormed in the seventh month; in the eighth Chinggis beat the Jin army in the Huihe valley at Xuanping; in the ninth he took Dexing, the commander of the Juyong Pass fled, and Jebe went through to the Middle Capital. The History of Jin puts the rout of Qianjianu and Husha at Huihebao, and the loss of the Juyong Pass, in the ninth month.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一 太祖本紀
passages.textZh: 二月，帝自將南伐，敗金將定薛於野狐嶺，取大水濼、豐利等縣。金復築烏沙堡。
passages.textEn: In the second month the emperor led the southern campaign himself, beat the Jin general Dingxue at Yehuling, and took Dashuiluo, Fengli and other counties. Jin built the fortress of Wushabao again.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一 太祖本紀
passages.textZh: 秋七月，命遮別攻烏沙堡及烏月營，拔之。
passages.textEn: In the seventh month, in autumn, he had Jebe attack Wushabao and the Wuyue camp, and took them.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一 太祖本紀
passages.textZh: 八月，帝及金師戰于宣平之會河川，敗之。
passages.textEn: In the eighth month the emperor fought the Jin army at the Huihe valley in Xuanping and beat it.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一 太祖本紀
passages.textZh: 九月，拔德興府，居庸關守將遁去。遮別遂入關，抵中都。
passages.textEn: In the ninth month he took Dexing; the commander of the Juyong Pass fled, and Jebe went through the pass and reached the Middle Capital.

passages.sourceEn: History of Jin (Toqto'a et al., 1344)
passages.locator: 卷十三 衛紹王紀
passages.textZh: 九月，千家奴、胡沙敗績於會河堡，居庸關失守。
passages.textEn: In the ninth month Qianjianu and Husha were routed at Huihebao, and the Juyong Pass was lost.

label.zh: 敗定薛於野狐嶺；遮別攻烏沙堡
戰于宣平之會河川，敗之

question.zh: 會河之戰在八月還是九月？
question.en: Was the battle of Huihe in the eighth month or the ninth?

claim.zh: 八月，戰於宣平之會河川。
claim.en: In the eighth month, in the Huihe valley at Xuanping.

source.en: 元史, 卷一 太祖本紀

accounts.quoteZh: 八月，帝及金師戰于宣平之會河川，敗之。

claim.zh: 九月，千家奴、胡沙敗績於會河堡。
claim.en: In the ninth month, at Huihebao.

source.en: 金史, 卷十三 衛紹王紀

accounts.quoteZh: 九月，千家奴、胡沙敗績於會河堡

summary.zh: 成吉思汗出紫荊關，敗金師於五回嶺，拔涿、易二州。是秋分兵三道：朮赤、察合台、窩闊台為右軍，循太行而南，取保、邢、相、懷、孟等州，掠澤、潞、平陽、太原，拔汾、忻、代等州而還；哈撒兒等為左軍，沿海東進，取薊、平、灤及遼西諸郡而還；成吉思汗與拖雷為中軍，取雄、霸、河間、濟南、益都、登、萊等郡。是歲河北郡縣盡被攻拔，唯中都、真定、大名、東平等十一城不下。次年春，蒙古軍駐中都北郊，未攻燕京。
summary.en: Chinggis came out through the Zijing Pass, beat the Jin army at Wuhuiling and took Zhuo and Yi. That autumn he split his army into three. The right wing under Jochi, Chagatai and Ögedei went south along the Taihang, taking Bao, Xing, Xiang, Huai, Meng and other prefectures, plundering Ze, Lu, Pingyang and Taiyuan, and storming Fen, Xin, Dai and others before turning back; the left wing under Qasar went east along the sea, taking Jizhou, Ping, Luan and the commanderies of Liaoxi; the centre under Chinggis and Tolui took Xiong, Ba, Hejian, Jinan, Yidu, Deng, Lai and others. That year every commandery and county north of the Yellow River was taken except eleven cities, among them the Middle Capital, Zhending, Daming and Dongping. The next spring the Mongols camped outside the Middle Capital but did not attack it.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一 太祖本紀
passages.textZh: 帝出紫荊關，敗金師于五回嶺，拔涿、易二州。
passages.textEn: The emperor came out through the Zijing Pass, beat the Jin army at Wuhuiling and took Zhuo and Yi.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一 太祖本紀
passages.textZh: 是秋，分兵三道：命皇子朮赤、察合台、窩闊台為右軍，循太行而南，取保、遂、安肅、安定、邢、洺、磁、相、衞、輝、懷、孟，掠澤、潞、遼、沁、平陽、太原、吉、隰，拔汾、石、嵐、忻、代、武等州而還；皇弟哈撒兒及斡陳那顏、拙赤䚟、薄剎為左軍，遵海而東，取薊州、平、灤、遼西諸郡而還；帝與皇子拖雷為中軍，取雄、霸、莫、安、河間、滄、景、獻、深、祁、蠡、冀、恩、濮、開、滑、博、濟、泰安、濟南、濱、棣、益都、淄、濰、登、萊、沂等郡。
passages.textEn: That autumn he divided his army into three: the princes Jochi, Chagatai and Ögedei led the right wing south along the Taihang, taking Bao, Sui, Anshu, Anding, Xing, Ming, Ci, Xiang, Wei, Hui, Huai and Meng, plundering Ze, Lu, Liao, Qin, Pingyang, Taiyuan, Ji and Xi, and storming Fen, Shi, Lan, Xin, Dai and Wu before returning; his brother Qasar with others led the left wing east along the sea, taking Jizhou, Ping, Luan and the commanderies of Liaoxi before returning; and the emperor with Prince Tolui led the centre, taking Xiong, Ba, Mo, An, Hejian, Cang, Jing, Xian, Shen, Qi, Li, Ji, En, Pu, Kai, Hua, Bo, Ji, Tai'an, Jinan, Bin, Di, Yidu, Zi, Wei, Deng, Lai, Yi and other commanderies.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一 太祖本紀
passages.textZh: 是歲，河北郡縣盡拔，唯中都、通、順、真定、清、沃、大名、東平、德、邳、海州十一城不下。
passages.textEn: That year every commandery and county north of the Yellow River was taken, except eleven cities: the Middle Capital, Tong, Shun, Zhending, Qing, Wo, Daming, Dongping, De, Pi and Haizhou.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一 太祖本紀
passages.textZh: 九年甲戌春三月，駐蹕中都北郊。諸將請乘勝破燕，帝不從。
passages.textEn: In the third month of the ninth year, jiaxu, in spring, he camped in the northern outskirts of the Middle Capital. His generals asked to follow up the victories and break Yan, but the emperor would not.

names.name: Muqali's campaigns south of the Taihang
