summary.zh: 丁丑八月，成吉思汗封木華黎為太師、國王，命曰：「太行之北，朕自經略，太行以南，卿其勉之。」木華黎建行省於雲、燕，自燕南攻遂城、蠡州諸城，拔之；冬破大名府，東定益都、淄、登、萊、濰、密等州。次年自西京由太和嶺入河東，攻太原、忻、代、澤、潞、汾、霍等州，皆降，遂取平陽，金守臣棄城而逃。
summary.en: In the eighth month of 1217 Chinggis Khan made Muqali Grand Preceptor and Prince of State, telling him: "North of the Taihang I shall see to myself; south of the Taihang, do your best." Muqali set up his branch secretariat in Yun and Yan, went south from Yan and took Suicheng, Lizhou and other towns, broke Daming in the winter and secured Yidu, Zi, Deng, Lai, Wei and Mi to the east. The next year he went from the Western Capital over the Taihe ridge into Hedong; Taiyuan, Xin, Dai, Ze, Lu, Fen, Huo and others all surrendered, and he took Pingyang, whose Jin commander abandoned it and fled.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十九 木華黎傳
passages.textZh: 丁丑八月，詔封太師、國王、都行省承制行事
passages.textEn: In the eighth month of dingchou he was made Grand Preceptor and Prince of State, head of the branch secretariat with power to act on the emperor's behalf

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十九 木華黎傳
passages.textZh: 太行之北，朕自經略，太行以南，卿其勉之。
passages.textEn: "North of the Taihang I shall see to myself; south of the Taihang, do your best."

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十九 木華黎傳
passages.textZh: 乃建行省于雲、燕，以圖中原。遂自燕南攻遂城及蠡州諸城，拔之。冬，破大名府，遂東定益都、淄、登、萊、濰、密等州。戊寅，自西京由太和嶺入河東，攻太原、忻、代、澤、潞、汾、霍等州，悉降之。遂徇平陽，金守臣棄城遁
passages.textEn: He set up the branch secretariat in Yun and Yan to take the Central Plain. From Yan he went south and took Suicheng, Lizhou and other towns; in winter he broke Daming and went on east to secure Yidu, Zi, Deng, Lai, Wei, Mi and other prefectures. In wuyin he went from the Western Capital by the Taihe ridge into Hedong, attacked Taiyuan, Xin, Dai, Ze, Lu, Fen, Huo and other prefectures, and all surrendered. He then took Pingyang, whose Jin commander abandoned the city and fled

自西京由太和嶺入河東

summary.zh: 窩闊台三路伐金：中軍自碗子城南下渡河經洛陽，斡陳那顏左軍由濟南，拖雷總右軍自鳳翔渡渭水，過寶雞，入小潼關，涉宋境沿漢水而下，約次年春會於汴。拖雷前鋒破金兵於武當山，乘馬浮渡漢水；金將合達設伏二十餘萬於鄧州之西，拖雷兵不滿四萬，棄輜重輕騎而進。壬辰春，合達等以步騎十五萬尾隨，時大雨雪，金兵僵凍幾不成軍，拖雷奮擊於三峯山，大破之，金之精銳盡喪。窩闊台至三峯，攻克鈞州，擒合達（《金史》記合達等走鈞州，城破皆死），擒蒲阿；隨後商、虢、嵩、汝、陝、洛、許、鄭、陳、亳、潁等州相繼歸降。
summary.en: Ögedei attacked Jin in three columns: the centre south from Wanzicheng across the Yellow River by Luoyang, the left under Wochen Noyan by Jinan, and the right under Tolui from Fengxiang across the Wei, past Baoji, through the Little Tong Pass into Song territory and down the Han, all to meet at Bian the next spring. Tolui's vanguard broke a Jin army at Mount Wudang and swam the horses across the Han. Heda laid an ambush of over two hundred thousand west of Dengzhou; Tolui, with fewer than forty thousand, left his baggage and pushed on with light horse. In the spring of 1232 Heda followed with a hundred and fifty thousand; heavy snow left the Jin troops frozen and hardly able to fight, and Tolui attacked at Sanfeng Mountain and crushed them, the flower of Jin's army lost. Ögedei came to Sanfeng, took Junzhou and captured Heda (the History of Jin says Heda and the others fled to Junzhou and died when it fell) and Pu'a; then Shang, Guo, Song, Ru, Shan, Luo, Xu, Zheng, Chen, Bo, Ying and other prefectures fell.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十五 睿宗傳
passages.textZh: 太宗以中軍自碗子城南下，渡河，由洛陽進；斡陳那顏以左軍由濟南進；而拖雷總右軍自鳳翔渡渭水，過寶雞，入小潼關，涉宋人之境，沿漢水而下。期以明年春，俱會于汴。
passages.textEn: Taizong took the centre south from Wanzicheng across the Yellow River by way of Luoyang; Wochen Noyan took the left by way of Jinan; and Tolui led the right from Fengxiang across the Wei, past Baoji, through the Little Tong Pass into Song territory and down the Han. They were to meet at Bian in the spring of the next year.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十五 睿宗傳
passages.textZh: 遂由金取房，前鋒三千人破金兵十餘萬于武當山，趨均州。乘騎浮渡漢水
passages.textEn: Then by way of Jin and Fang, his vanguard of three thousand broke over a hundred thousand Jin troops at Mount Wudang and made for Junzhou, swimming the horses across the Han

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十五 睿宗傳
passages.textZh: 拖雷既渡漢，金大將合達設伏二十餘萬于鄧州之西，據隘待之。時拖雷兵不滿四萬，及得諜報，乃悉留輜重，輕騎以進。
passages.textEn: When Tolui had crossed the Han, the Jin grand general Heda laid an ambush of over two hundred thousand west of Dengzhou, holding the passes to wait for him. Tolui had fewer than forty thousand; told of it by his scouts, he left all his baggage and pressed on with light horse.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十五 睿宗傳
passages.textZh: 壬辰春，合達等知拖雷已北，合步騎十五萬躡其後。
passages.textEn: In the spring of renchen Heda and the others, learning that Tolui had gone north, followed on his heels with a hundred and fifty thousand foot and horse.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十五 睿宗傳
passages.textZh: 天大雨雪，金人僵凍無人色，幾不能軍，拖雷即欲擊之
passages.textEn: Heavy snow fell; the Jin troops were frozen stiff and ashen, hardly able to fight, and Tolui wanted to attack at once

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十五 睿宗傳
passages.textZh: 遂奮擊于三峯山，大破之，追奔數十里，流血被道，資仗委積，金之精銳盡於此矣。
passages.textEn: So he attacked furiously at Sanfeng Mountain and crushed them, pursuing for dozens of li; blood covered the roads, abandoned arms lay in heaps, and the flower of Jin's army was gone.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷二 太宗本紀
passages.textZh: 四年壬辰春正月戊子，帝由白坡渡河。庚寅，拖雷渡漢江，遣使來報，即詔諸軍進發。
passages.textEn: On wuzi of the first month of the fourth year, renchen, in spring, the emperor crossed the Yellow River at Baipo. On gengyin Tolui crossed the Han and sent word, and the emperor at once ordered all the armies forward.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷二 太宗本紀
passages.textZh: 是日，拖雷及金師戰于鈞州之三峯，大敗之，獲金將蒲阿。戊戌，帝至三峯。壬寅，攻鈞州，克之，獲金將合達。遂下商、虢、嵩、汝、陝、洛、許、鄭、陳、亳、潁、壽、睢、永等州。
passages.textEn: That day Tolui fought the Jin army at Sanfeng in Junzhou, routed it and captured the Jin general Pu'a. On wuxu the emperor reached Sanfeng; on renyin he took Junzhou and captured the Jin general Heda. Then Shang, Guo, Song, Ru, Shan, Luo, Xu, Zheng, Chen, Bo, Ying, Shou, Sui, Yong and other prefectures fell.

passages.sourceEn: History of Jin (Toqto'a et al., 1344)
passages.locator: 卷十七 哀宗紀上
passages.textZh: 大元兵及兩省軍戰鈞州之三峰山，兩省軍大潰，合達、陳和尚、楊沃衍走鈞州，城破皆死之。樞密副使蒲阿就執，尋亦死。
passages.textEn: The Great Yuan army fought the armies of the two branch secretariats at Sanfeng Mountain in Junzhou; the two armies collapsed, and Heda, Chen Heshang and Yang Wuyan fled to Junzhou, where all died when the city fell. The Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Pu'a was captured and soon died too.

label.zh: 拖雷自鳳翔渡渭水，過寶雞
乘騎浮渡漢水，輕騎以進
太宗以中軍自碗子城南下，由洛陽進
合達等合步騎十五萬躡其後

names.name: Siege of Bian (Cui Li surrenders the capital)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 三峯山之後，窩闊台命速不台等圍金南京（汴），金主遣弟曹王訛可入質；八月金將完顏思烈、武仙來救，為蒙古軍所敗。次年正月，金主出奔歸德；金西面元帥崔立殺留守完顏奴申、完顏習捏阿不，以南京降。四月，崔立送金太后、皇后及宗室至速不台軍中，速不台入南京。六月金主再奔蔡州，塔察兒率師圍之。
summary.en: After Sanfeng Ögedei had Sübe'etei and others besiege the Jin Southern Capital at Bian, and the Jin ruler sent his brother, the Prince of Cao, as a hostage; in the eighth month Wanyan Silie and Wu Xian came to relieve the city and were beaten. In the first month of the next year the Jin ruler fled to Guide; Cui Li, commander of the western walls, killed the regents Wanyan Nushen and Wanyan Xinie'abu and surrendered the city. In the fourth month Cui Li brought the empress dowager, the empress and the imperial clan to Sübe'etei's camp, and Sübe'etei entered the city. In the sixth month the Jin ruler fled again to Cai, where Tachar besieged him.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷二 太宗本紀
passages.textZh: 三月，命速不台等圍南京，金主遣其弟曹王訛可入質。
passages.textEn: In the third month he had Sübe'etei and others besiege the Southern Capital, and the Jin ruler sent his brother Ehke, Prince of Cao, as a hostage.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷二 太宗本紀
passages.textZh: 金參政完顏思烈、恒山公武仙救南京，諸軍與戰，敗之。
passages.textEn: The Jin Assistant Councillor Wanyan Silie and Wu Xian, Duke of Hengshan, came to relieve the Southern Capital; the armies fought them and beat them.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷二 太宗本紀
passages.textZh: 五年癸巳春正月庚申，金主奔歸德。戊辰，金西面元帥崔立殺留守完顏奴申、完顏習捏阿不，以南京降。
passages.textEn: On gengshen of the first month of the fifth year, guisi, in spring, the Jin ruler fled to Guide. On wuchen Cui Li, Jin commander of the western walls, killed the regents Wanyan Nushen and Wanyan Xinie'abu and surrendered the Southern Capital.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷二 太宗本紀
passages.textZh: 夏四月，速不台進至青城，崔立以金太后王氏、后徒單氏及（荊）〔梁〕王從恪、（梁）〔荊〕王守純等至軍中，速不台遣送行在，遂入南京。
passages.textEn: In the fourth month, in summer, Sübe'etei advanced to Qingcheng; Cui Li brought the Jin empress dowager, the empress and the princes Congke and Shouchun to his camp, Sübe'etei sent them on to the emperor, and entered the Southern Capital.

passages.sourceEn: History of Yuan (Song Lian et al., 1370)
passages.locator: 卷二 太宗本紀
passages.textZh: 六月，金主奔蔡，塔察兒率師圍之。
passages.textEn: In the sixth month the Jin ruler fled to Cai, and Tachar besieged him there.

label.en: The Jin ruler flees to Guide

names.name: 前秦滅前涼（洪池、赤岸之戰）
Former Qin conquers Former Liang (Hongchi and Chi'an)

summary.zh: 苻堅遣苟萇、毛盛、梁熙、姚萇等率騎十三萬伐張天錫於姑臧。梁熙、王統自清石津攻陷河會城；苟萇自石城津渡河，與梁熙會攻纏縮城，又陷之。天錫遣掌據率三萬與馬建陣於洪池，馬建降秦，掌據被殺。苟萇進入清塞，天錫又遣趙充哲率勁卒五萬戰於赤岸，大敗。天錫懼而奔還請降；苟萇至姑臧，天錫素車白馬、面縛輿櫬，降於軍門。
summary.en: Fu Jian sent Gou Chang, Mao Sheng, Liang Xi, Yao Chang and others with a hundred and thirty thousand horse against Zhang Tianxi at Guzang. Liang Xi and Wang Tong crossed at the Qingshi ford and took Hehui; Gou Chang crossed at the Shicheng ford, joined Liang Xi against Chansuo and took it too. Tianxi sent Zhang Ju with thirty thousand to hold Hongchi with Ma Jian; Ma Jian went over to Qin and Zhang Ju was killed. Gou Chang advanced into Qingsai, and Tianxi's general Zhao Chongzhe, with fifty thousand of his best, was routed at Chi'an. Tianxi fled home and asked to surrender; when Gou Chang reached Guzang he came out in a plain carriage drawn by a white horse, hands bound and his coffin behind him, and surrendered at the camp gate.

label.en: Former Qin: Gou Chang, Liang Xi, Yao Chang (victor)

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十三 苻堅載記上
passages.textZh: 遣其武衛苟萇、左將軍毛盛、中書令梁熙、步兵校尉姚萇等率騎十三萬伐張天賜于姑臧。
passages.textEn: He sent Gou Chang, Mao Sheng, Liang Xi, Yao Chang and others with a hundred and thirty thousand horse against Zhang Tianxi at Guzang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十三 苻堅載記上
passages.textZh: 俄而梁熙、王統等自清石津攻其將梁粲於河會城，陷之。苟萇濟自石城津，與梁熙等會攻纏縮城，又陷之。
passages.textEn: Soon Liang Xi, Wang Tong and others crossed at the Qingshi ford and attacked his general Liang Can at Hehui, taking it; Gou Chang crossed at the Shicheng ford, joined Liang Xi and the others to attack Chansuo, and took it too.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十三 苻堅載記上
passages.textZh: 天錫又遣將軍掌據率眾三萬，與馬建陣于洪池。
passages.textEn: Tianxi then sent his general Zhang Ju with thirty thousand men to draw up with Ma Jian at Hongchi.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十三 苻堅載記上
passages.textZh: 萇、熙聞天錫來逼，急攻據、建，建降於萇，遂攻據，害之，及其軍司席仂。萇進軍入清塞，乘高列陣。天錫又遣司兵趙充哲為前鋒，率勁勇五萬，與萇等戰於赤岸，哲大敗。天錫懼而奔還，至箋請降。萇至姑臧，天錫乘素車白馬，面縛輿櫬，降於軍門。
passages.textEn: Hearing that Tianxi was coming against them, Gou Chang and Liang Xi attacked Zhang Ju and Ma Jian at once; Ma Jian went over to Chang, who then attacked Zhang Ju and killed him with his adjutant Xi Le. Chang advanced into Qingsai and drew up on the heights. Tianxi sent Zhao Chongzhe ahead with fifty thousand of his best, who fought Chang and the others at Chi'an and was routed. Tianxi fled home in fear and wrote asking to surrender; when Chang reached Guzang, Tianxi came out in a plain carriage drawn by a white horse, hands bound and his coffin carried behind him, and surrendered at the gate of the camp.

label.zh: 梁熙、王統自清石津攻河會城，陷之
苟萇濟自石城津…進軍入清塞
label.en: Gou Chang across the Yellow River to Hongchi

label.zh: 戰於赤岸，哲大敗；萇至姑臧

summary.zh: 苻堅平涼州後，遣幽州刺史苻洛為北討大都督，率幽州兵十萬伐代王拓跋什翼犍（《晉書》作涉翼犍），又遣俱難、鄧羌等率步騎二十萬東出和龍、西出上郡，會於代王庭。《魏書·序紀》記：秦軍諸道來寇，白部、獨孤部迎戰敗績，劉庫仁再戰石子嶺亦不利；代王時病，率國人避於陰山之北，秦軍稍退乃還，十二月至雲中而崩。《晉書》則記代王戰敗遁於弱水，退還陰山，其子翼圭縛父請降。
summary.en: With Liang pacified, Fu Jian sent Fu Luo, Governor of You, with a hundred thousand troops against Tuoba Shiyijian, King of Dai (Sheyijian in the Book of Jin), and sent Ju Nan, Deng Qiang and others with two hundred thousand foot and horse east from Helong and west from Shang commandery to meet at the Dai court. The Book of Wei says the Qin armies came by several roads; the Bai and Dugu tribes met them and were routed, and Liu Kuren fought again at Shiziling without success; the ruler, who was ill, led his people north of the Yin Mountains, came back when the Qin army drew off, and died at Yunzhong in the twelfth month. The Book of Jin says he was beaten, fled to the Ruo River and back to the Yin Mountains, and his son Yigui bound him and surrendered.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百一十三 苻堅載記上
passages.textZh: 堅既平涼州，又遣其安北將軍、幽州刺史苻洛為北討大都督，率幽州兵十萬討代王涉翼犍。又遣後將軍俱難與鄧羌等率步騎二十萬東出和龍，西出上郡，與洛會於涉翼犍庭。翼犍戰敗，遁于弱水。苻洛逐之，勢窘迫，退還陰山。其子翼圭縛父請降
passages.textEn: With Liang pacified, Jian sent Fu Luo, Governor of You Province, as grand commander of the northern campaign with a hundred thousand troops of You against Sheyijian, King of Dai, and sent Ju Nan, Deng Qiang and others with two hundred thousand foot and horse out east from Helong and west from Shang commandery to meet Fu Luo at Sheyijian's court. Yijian was beaten and fled to the Ruo River; Fu Luo pursued him, and in desperate straits he fell back to the Yin Mountains. His son Yigui bound his father and asked to surrender

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷一 序紀
passages.textZh: 三十九年，苻堅遣其大司馬苻洛率眾二十萬及朱彤、張蚝、鄧羌等諸道來寇，侵逼南境。冬十一月，白部、獨孤部禦之，敗績。南部大人劉庫仁走雲中。帝復遣庫仁率騎十萬逆戰於石子嶺，王師不利。帝時不豫，羣臣莫可任者，乃率國人避於陰山之北。
passages.textEn: In the thirty-ninth year Fu Jian sent his Grand Marshal Fu Luo with two hundred thousand men, with Zhu Tong, Zhang Ci, Deng Qiang and others, to invade by several roads and press on the southern border. In the eleventh month, in winter, the Bai and Dugu tribes met them and were routed; Liu Kuren, chief of the southern division, fled to Yunzhong. The ruler sent Kuren again with a hundred thousand horse to fight at Shiziling, and the royal army fared badly. The ruler was ill and no minister could be trusted with command, so he led his people away north of the Yin Mountains.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷一 序紀
passages.textZh: 堅軍稍退，乃還。十二月，至雲中，旬有二日，帝崩，時年五十七。
passages.textEn: When Jian's army drew back a little he returned. In the twelfth month he reached Yunzhong, and twelve days later he died, aged fifty-seven.

label.zh: 苻洛率幽州兵十萬討代王
西出上郡，與洛會於涉翼犍庭
退還陰山（避於陰山之北）

question.zh: 代王是被其子縛降，還是病逝於雲中？
question.en: Was the King of Dai handed over by his son, or did he die at Yunzhong?

claim.zh: 代王戰敗退還陰山，其子翼圭縛父請降。
claim.en: Beaten, he fell back to the Yin Mountains, and his son Yigui bound him and surrendered.

source.en: 晉書, 卷一百一十三 苻堅載記上

accounts.quoteZh: 其子翼圭縛父請降

claim.zh: 代王避於陰山之北，秦軍稍退乃還，十二月至雲中而崩。
claim.en: He withdrew north of the Yin Mountains, returned when Qin drew off, and died at Yunzhong in the twelfth month.

source.en: 魏書, 卷一 序紀

accounts.quoteZh: 十二月，至雲中，旬有二日，帝崩

names.name: Battle of Luoyang (Shi Le captures Liu Yao)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 劉曜敗石季龍於高候，進圍洛陽。石勒不顧群臣勸阻親往救援：命石堪、石聰、桃豹等會兵滎陽，石季龍進據石門，自率步騎四萬赴金墉，自大堨渡河；諸軍會於成皋，步卒六萬、騎二萬七千，卷甲銜枚，出於鞏、訾之間。石勒自宣陽門入城，石季龍以步卒三萬自城北而西攻劉曜中軍，石堪、石聰各以精騎八千自城西而北擊其前鋒，大戰於西陽門；石勒披甲出閶闔門夾擊，劉曜軍大潰，石堪擒劉曜，斬首五萬餘級。
summary.en: Liu Yao beat Shi Jilong at Gaohou and besieged Luoyang. Overruling his ministers, Shi Le went to its relief himself: Shi Kan, Shi Cong and Tao Bao gathered at Xingyang, Shi Jilong held Shimen, and Le led forty thousand foot and horse to Jinyong, crossing the Yellow River at the Great Weir. The armies met at Chenggao, sixty thousand foot and twenty-seven thousand horse, and went by hidden roads between Gong and Zi. Le entered the city by the Xuanyang Gate; Shi Jilong with thirty thousand foot came round the north against Liu Yao's centre, and Shi Kan and Shi Cong with eight thousand horse each came round the west against his van, in a great battle at the Xiyang Gate. Le came out by the Changhe Gate to take them from both sides; Liu Yao's army collapsed, Shi Kan seized him, and over fifty thousand were beheaded.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百五 石勒載記下
passages.textZh: 劉曜敗季龍于高候，遂圍洛陽。
passages.textEn: Liu Yao beat Shi Jilong at Gaohou and besieged Luoyang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百五 石勒載記下
passages.textZh: 命石堪、石聰及豫州刺史桃豹等各統見眾會滎陽，使石季龍進據石門，以左衛石邃都督中軍事，勒統步騎四萬赴金墉，濟自大堨。
passages.textEn: He ordered Shi Kan, Shi Cong and Tao Bao, Governor of Yu, to bring what troops they had to Xingyang, sent Shi Jilong to hold Shimen, put Shi Sui of the Left Guard in charge of the central army, and himself led forty thousand foot and horse to Jinyong, crossing at the Great Weir.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百五 石勒載記下
passages.textZh: 諸軍集于成皋，步卒六萬，騎二萬七千。
passages.textEn: The armies gathered at Chenggao: sixty thousand foot and twenty-seven thousand horse.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百五 石勒載記下
passages.textZh: 乃卷甲銜枚而詭道兼路，出於鞏、訾之間。
passages.textEn: They rolled up their armour, gagged their mouths and went by hidden roads at double pace, coming out between Gong and Zi.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百五 石勒載記下
passages.textZh: 勒統步騎四萬人自宣陽門，升故太極前殿。季龍步卒三萬，自城北而西，攻其中軍，石堪、石聰等各以精騎八千，城西而北，擊其前鋒，大戰于西陽門。勒躬貫甲胄，出自閶闔，夾擊之。曜軍大潰，石堪執曜，送之以徇於軍，斬首五萬餘級，枕屍于金穀。
passages.textEn: Le led forty thousand foot and horse in by the Xuanyang Gate and up to the old Taiji Hall. Shi Jilong with thirty thousand foot came west round the north of the city against Liu Yao's centre, while Shi Kan and Shi Cong, each with eight thousand picked horse, came north round the west of the city against his van, and a great battle was fought at the Xiyang Gate. Le in his armour came out by the Changhe Gate to take them from both sides. Yao's army collapsed; Shi Kan seized Yao and paraded him before the troops, over fifty thousand were beheaded, and the dead lay as far as Jingu.

label.zh: 勒統步騎四萬赴金墉，濟自大堨
label.en: Shi Le from Xiangguo across the Yellow River

label.zh: 出於鞏、訾之間，大戰于西陽門
label.en: Between Gong and Zi to Luoyang

names.name: 義渠、上邽之戰（前趙之亡）
Yiqu and Shanggui (the end of Former Zhao)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 劉曜被擒後，太子劉熙等棄長安奔上邽。劉胤、劉遵率眾數萬自上邽攻石生於長安，隴東、武都、安定、新平、北地、扶風、始平諸郡戎夏皆起兵響應。石勒遣石季龍率騎二萬迎擊，戰於義渠，劉胤大敗，死者五千餘人；季龍乘勝追擊，枕屍千里，上邽潰，執太子劉熙、南陽王劉胤及將相王公以下三千餘人，盡殺之。季龍又攻克河西集木且羌，秦、隴悉平。
summary.en: With Liu Yao captured, the crown prince Liu Xi and the others abandoned Chang'an for Shanggui. Liu Yin and Liu Zun led several tens of thousands from Shanggui against Shi Sheng at Chang'an, and the peoples of Longdong, Wudu, Anding, Xinping, Beidi, Fufeng and Shiping rose in their support. Shi Le sent Shi Jilong with twenty thousand horse; at Yiqu Liu Yin was routed with over five thousand dead, and Jilong pursued him, the dead lying for a thousand li, until Shanggui fell. He seized Liu Xi, Liu Yin and over three thousand generals, ministers, princes and officials and killed them all, then beat the Jimuqie Qiang west of the Yellow River, and Qin and Long were pacified.

label.en: Former Zhao: Liu Xi, Liu Yin (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百五 石勒載記下
passages.textZh: 劉曜子熙等去長安，奔於上邽，遣季龍討之。
passages.textEn: Liu Yao's son Xi and the others left Chang'an and fled to Shanggui, and Le sent Shi Jilong against them.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百三 劉曜載記
passages.textZh: 胤及劉遵率眾數萬，自上邽將攻石生於長安，隴東、武都、安定、新平、北地、扶風、始平諸郡戎夏皆起兵應胤。胤次於仲橋，石生固守長安。勒使石季龍率騎二萬距胤，戰于義渠，為季龍所敗，死者五千餘人。胤奔上邽，季龍乘勝追戰，枕屍千里，上邽潰。季龍執其偽太子熙、南陽王劉胤並將相諸王等及其諸卿校公侯已下三千餘人，皆殺之。
passages.textEn: Liu Yin and Liu Zun led several tens of thousands from Shanggui to attack Shi Sheng at Chang'an, and the barbarians and Chinese of Longdong, Wudu, Anding, Xinping, Beidi, Fufeng and Shiping all rose in support. Yin camped at Zhongqiao while Shi Sheng held Chang'an. Le sent Shi Jilong with twenty thousand horse against Yin; they fought at Yiqu, and Yin was beaten with over five thousand dead. He fled to Shanggui with Jilong in pursuit, the dead lying for a thousand li, and Shanggui fell. Jilong seized the crown prince Xi, Liu Yin, Prince of Nanyang, the generals, ministers and princes, and their officials down to the marquises, over three thousand in all, and killed them all.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百五 石勒載記下
passages.textZh: 季龍克上邽，遣主簿趙封送傳國玉璽、金璽、太子玉璽各一於勒。季龍進攻集木且羌於河西，克之，俘獲數萬，秦、隴悉平。
passages.textEn: Jilong took Shanggui and sent his secretary Zhao Feng to Le with the jade seal of the realm, the gold seal and the crown prince's jade seal. He went on to attack the Jimuqie Qiang west of the Yellow River and beat them, taking tens of thousands of captives, and Qin and Long were wholly pacified.

label.zh: 胤及劉遵率眾數萬，自上邽將攻石生於長安
石季龍率騎二萬距胤，戰于義渠
label.en: Shi Jilong meets him at Yiqu

confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 揚州刺史劉繇因壽春為袁術所據，渡江治曲阿，遣樊能、于麋屯橫江津，張英屯當利口以拒袁術。孫策說袁術，請助吳景等平定江東，袁術表其為折衝校尉，兵僅千餘、騎數十；至歷陽時眾已五六千。孫策渡江轉戰，所向皆破，劉繇棄軍遁逃，諸郡守皆棄城奔走。孫策又渡浙江，據會稽，屠東冶，攻破嚴白虎等，自領會稽太守。
summary.en: With Shouchun held by Yuan Shu, Liu Yao, Governor of Yang, had crossed the Yangzi to govern from Qu'a, posting Fan Neng and Yu Mi at the Hengjiang ford and Zhang Ying at Dangli against Shu. Sun Ce asked Yuan Shu to let him help Wu Jing conquer the land east of the river; Shu gave him a colonelcy and barely a thousand men and a few dozen horse, and by Liyang he had five or six thousand. He crossed the river and fought his way forward, breaking every force he met; Liu Yao abandoned his army and fled, and the governors left their cities and ran. Sun Ce then crossed the Zhe, took Kuaiji, put Dongye to the sword, broke Yan Baihu and the others, and made himself governor of Kuaiji.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷四十六 吳書 孫破虜討逆傳
passages.textZh: 繇遣樊能、于麋東屯橫江津，張英屯當利口，以距術。
passages.textEn: Liu Yao sent Fan Neng and Yu Mi east to camp at the Hengjiang ford, and Zhang Ying to camp at Dangli, to keep Yuan Shu out.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷四十六 吳書 孫破虜討逆傳
passages.textZh: 策乃説術，乞助景等平定江東。術表策爲折衝校尉，行殄寇將軍，兵財千餘，騎數十匹，賓客願從者數百人。比至歷陽，衆五六千。策母先自曲阿徙於歷陽，策又徙母阜陵，渡江轉鬥，所向皆破。
passages.textEn: Sun Ce then asked Yuan Shu to let him help Wu Jing and the others conquer the land east of the Yangzi. Shu made him a colonel, acting as general, with barely a thousand troops, a few dozen horse and a few hundred followers; by the time he reached Liyang he had five or six thousand. His mother had moved from Qu'a to Liyang; Ce moved her on to Fuling, crossed the river and fought his way forward, breaking every force he met.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷四十六 吳書 孫破虜討逆傳
passages.textZh: 劉繇棄軍遁逃，諸郡守皆捐城郭奔走。
passages.textEn: Liu Yao abandoned his army and fled, and the governors of the commanderies all left their cities and ran.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷四十六 吳書 孫破虜討逆傳
passages.textZh: 遂引兵渡浙江，據會稽，屠東冶，乃攻破虎等。盡更置長吏，策自領會稽太守
passages.textEn: Then he led his troops across the Zhe River, took Kuaiji, put Dongye to the sword and broke Yan Baihu and the others. He replaced all the senior officials and made himself governor of Kuaiji

label.zh: 比至歷陽，衆五六千，渡江轉鬥
所向皆破，劉繇棄軍遁逃

names.name: Sun Ce takes Lujiang by surprise

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 袁術死後，其長史楊弘、大將張勳率部眾欲投孫策，廬江太守劉勳中途截擊，盡數俘獲，並收其珍寶。孫策假意與劉勳結盟，勸其出兵攻取豫章上繚宗民萬餘家；劉勳出兵後，孫策輕軍晝夜兼程襲取廬江，劉勳部眾盡降，劉勳僅率數百人投奔曹操。
summary.en: After Yuan Shu died, his chief clerk Yang Hong and his general Zhang Xun set out with his followers to join Sun Ce, but Liu Xun, governor of Lujiang, waylaid and captured them all and took their treasure. Sun Ce pretended friendship with Liu Xun and urged him to attack the ten thousand clan households of Shangliao in Yuzhang; when Xun had gone, Ce came with light troops day and night and took Lujiang by surprise. Xun's men all surrendered, and he went over to Cao Cao with a few hundred.

label.en: Liu Xun, went over to Cao Cao (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷四十六 吳書 孫破虜討逆傳
passages.textZh: 後術死，長史楊弘、大將張勳等將其衆欲就策，廬江太守劉勳要擊，悉虜之，收其珍寶以歸。策聞之，僞與勳好盟。勳新得術衆，時豫章上繚宗民萬餘家在江東。策勸勳攻取之。勳旣行，策輕軍晨夜襲拔廬江，勳衆盡降，勳獨與麾下數百人自歸曹公。
passages.textEn: After Yuan Shu died, his chief clerk Yang Hong and his general Zhang Xun set out with his followers to join Sun Ce, but Liu Xun, governor of Lujiang, waylaid and captured them all and took their treasure home. Hearing of it, Ce pretended friendship and swore an alliance with Xun. Xun had just taken over Shu's followers, and the clans of Shangliao in Yuzhang, over ten thousand households, were then east of the river; Ce urged Xun to attack them. When Xun had gone, Ce came with light troops by day and night and took Lujiang by surprise; Xun's men all surrendered, and Xun went over to Cao Cao with a few hundred of his own guard.

label.zh: 策勸勳攻取上繚，勳旣行
label.en: Liu Xun lured away to Shangliao

names.name: Cao Cao breaks the Yellow Turbans of Runan and Yingchuan
Cáo Cāo pò Rǔ Yǐng Huángjīn

summary.zh: 建安元年正月，曹操軍臨武平，袁術所置陳相袁嗣出降。汝南、潁川黃巾何儀、劉辟、黃邵、何曼等各擁眾數萬，先應袁術，後附孫堅；二月曹操進軍討破之，斬劉辟、黃邵等，何儀及其眾皆降。
summary.en: In the first month of 196 Cao Cao came to Wuping, and Yuan Si, whom Yuan Shu had made chancellor of Chen, surrendered. The Yellow Turbans of Runan and Yingchuan under He Yi, Liu Pi, Huang Shao and He Man, each with tens of thousands, had first answered Yuan Shu and then joined Sun Jian; in the second month Cao advanced against them, beheaded Liu Pi, Huang Shao and others, and took the surrender of He Yi and his followers.

label.en: the Yellow Turbans of Runan and Yingchuan (defeated)

label.zh: 袁術所置陳相袁嗣，降（敗）
label.en: Yuan Shu's chancellor of Chen, surrendered (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷一 魏書 武帝紀
passages.textZh: 建安元年春正月，太祖軍臨武平，袁術所置陳相袁嗣降。
passages.textEn: In the first month of the first Jian'an year, in spring, Taizu's army came to Wuping, and Yuan Si, whom Yuan Shu had made chancellor of Chen, surrendered.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷一 魏書 武帝紀
passages.textZh: 汝南、潁川黃巾何儀、劉辟、黃邵、何曼等，衆各數萬，初應袁術，又附孫堅。二月，太祖進軍討破之，斬辟、邵等，儀及其衆皆降。
passages.textEn: The Yellow Turbans of Runan and Yingchuan under He Yi, Liu Pi, Huang Shao, He Man and others, each with tens of thousands, had first answered Yuan Shu and then joined Sun Jian. In the second month Taizu advanced against them and broke them, beheading Liu Pi, Huang Shao and others; He Yi and his men all surrendered.

names.name: Battle of Chen (Cao Cao against Yuan Shu)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 袁術侵陳，曹操東征。袁術聞曹操親至，棄軍而走，留部將橋蕤、李豐、梁綱、樂就；曹操擊破之，皆斬，袁術渡淮而逃。此後袁術漸困，欲經下邳北投袁譚，曹操遣劉備、朱靈截擊，袁術病死。
summary.en: Yuan Shu invaded Chen and Cao Cao marched east. Hearing that Cao was coming himself, Shu left his army and fled, leaving his generals Qiao Rui, Li Feng, Liang Gang and Yue Jiu, whom Cao broke and beheaded; Shu fled across the Huai. He grew steadily weaker; when he tried to pass north by Xiapi to join Yuan Tan, Cao sent Liu Bei and Zhu Ling to cut him off, and he died of illness.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷一 魏書 武帝紀
passages.textZh: 九月，術侵陳，公東征之。術聞公自來，棄軍走，留其將橋蕤、李豐、梁綱、樂就；公到，擊破蕤等，皆斬之。術走渡淮。公還許。
passages.textEn: In the ninth month Yuan Shu invaded Chen, and Cao went east against him. Hearing that Cao was coming himself, Shu left his army and fled, leaving his generals Qiao Rui, Li Feng, Liang Gang and Yue Jiu; Cao came up, broke them and beheaded them all. Shu fled across the Huai, and Cao returned to Xu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷一 魏書 武帝紀
passages.textZh: 袁術自敗於陳，稍困，袁譚自青州遣迎之。術欲從下邳北過，公遣劉備、朱靈要之。會術病死。
passages.textEn: After his defeat at Chen, Yuan Shu grew steadily weaker; Yuan Tan sent from Qing Province to fetch him, and Shu meant to pass north by Xiapi, but Cao sent Liu Bei and Zhu Ling to cut him off. Just then Shu died of illness.

label.en: Yuan Shu flees across the Huai

names.name: 宛、穰、安眾之戰（曹操與張繡）
Wan, Rang and Anzhong (Cao Cao against Zhang Xiu)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 建安二年正月，曹操至宛，張繡投降後又反，曹軍戰敗，曹操中流矢，長子曹昂、姪曹安民遇害。同年冬曹操再征南陽，攻拔湖陽，生擒劉表將鄧濟，又下舞陰。三年三月圍張繡於穰；五月劉表出兵救繡，截斷曹軍後路。至安眾，繡、表合兵據險，曹軍腹背受敵；曹操夜鑿地道運過輜重、伏下奇兵，天明敵軍以為曹軍逃遁，全軍來追，曹操縱奇兵步騎夾擊，大破之。四年十一月，張繡率眾投降，封列侯。
summary.en: In the first month of 197 Cao Cao reached Wan; Zhang Xiu surrendered, then rebelled and beat him, Cao was struck by a stray arrow, and his eldest son Ang and nephew Anmin were killed. That winter Cao came back south, stormed Huyang, captured Liu Biao's general Deng Ji and took Wuyin. In the third month of 198 he besieged Zhang Xiu at Rang; in the fifth Liu Biao sent troops to relieve Xiu and cut off Cao's rear. At Anzhong, attacked front and rear by Xiu and Biao holding the pass, Cao dug a tunnel by night, got his baggage through and placed a hidden force; at dawn the enemy thought he had fled and pursued with their whole army, and he loosed the hidden foot and horse from both sides and crushed them. In the eleventh month of 199 Zhang Xiu surrendered with his followers and was made a marquis.

label.zh: 統帥：宛之敗，安眾之勝，終受繡降
label.en: commander: beaten at Wan, won at Anzhong, took Xiu's surrender in the end

label.zh: 張繡：宛勝曹，安眾敗，終降曹
label.en: Zhang Xiu: beat Cao at Wan, lost at Anzhong, surrendered in the end
Liu Biao: sent troops to help Xiu

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷一 魏書 武帝紀
passages.textZh: 二年春正月，公到宛。張繡降，旣而悔之，復反。公與戰，軍敗，爲流矢所中，長子昂、弟子安民遇害。
passages.textEn: In the first month of the second year, in spring, Cao reached Wan. Zhang Xiu surrendered, then regretted it and rebelled. Cao fought him and was beaten, struck by a stray arrow; his eldest son Ang and his nephew Anmin were killed.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷一 魏書 武帝紀
passages.textZh: 冬十一月，公自南征，至宛。表將鄧濟據湖陽。攻拔之，生禽濟，湖陽降。攻舞陰，下之。
passages.textEn: In the eleventh month, in winter, Cao went south himself to Wan. Liu Biao's general Deng Ji held Huyang; Cao stormed it, took Ji alive and Huyang surrendered. He attacked Wuyin and took it.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷一 魏書 武帝紀
passages.textZh: 三月，公圍張繡於穰。夏五月，劉表遣兵救繡，以絕軍後。
passages.textEn: In the third month Cao besieged Zhang Xiu at Rang. In the fifth month, in summer, Liu Biao sent troops to relieve Xiu and cut off Cao's rear.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷一 魏書 武帝紀
passages.textZh: 到安衆，繡與表兵合守險，公軍前後受敵。公乃夜鑿險爲地道，悉過輜重，設奇兵。會明，賊謂公爲遁也，悉軍來追。乃縱奇兵步騎夾攻，大破之。
passages.textEn: At Anzhong Xiu and Biao's troops joined to hold the pass, and Cao's army was attacked front and rear. By night he cut a tunnel through the pass, got all his baggage through and placed a hidden force. At dawn the enemy thought he had fled and came after him with their whole army; he loosed the hidden foot and horse on them from both sides and crushed them.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷一 魏書 武帝紀
passages.textZh: 冬十一月，張繡率衆降，封列侯。
passages.textEn: In the eleventh month, in winter, Zhang Xiu surrendered with his followers and was made a marquis.

label.zh: 到安衆…縱奇兵步騎夾攻，大破之

names.name: Battle of Shequan (Cao Cao takes Henei)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 張楊部將楊醜殺張楊，眭固又殺楊醜，率其眾歸附袁紹，屯於射犬。四月曹操進軍臨河，派史渙、曹仁渡河擊之；眭固留薛洪、繆尚守營，自率兵北上向袁紹求救，與史渙、曹仁遇於犬城，交戰大敗被斬。曹操渡河圍射犬，薛洪、繆尚率眾投降，曹操以魏种為河內太守。
summary.en: Zhang Yang's officer Yang Chou killed Zhang Yang, and Sui Gu killed Yang Chou in turn and put his men under Yuan Shao at Shequan. In the fourth month Cao Cao came to the Yellow River and sent Shi Huan and Cao Ren across; Sui Gu left Xue Hong and Miao Shang in camp and went north to ask Yuan Shao for help, met Shi Huan and Cao Ren at Quancheng, and was crushed and beheaded. Cao crossed and besieged Shequan; Xue Hong and Miao Shang surrendered, and Cao made Wei Zhong governor of Henei.

label.zh: 眭固（以眾屬袁紹），被斬（敗）

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 卷一 魏書 武帝紀
passages.textZh: 張楊將楊醜殺楊，眭固又殺醜，以其衆屬袁紹，屯射犬。夏四月，進軍臨河，使史渙、曹仁渡河擊之。固使楊故長史薛洪、河內太守繆尚留守，自將兵北迎紹求救，與渙、仁相遇犬城。交戰，大破之，斬固。公遂濟河，圍射犬。洪、尚率衆降，封爲列侯，還軍敖倉。以魏种爲河內太守，屬以河北事。
passages.textEn: Zhang Yang's officer Yang Chou killed Yang, and Sui Gu killed Chou in turn, put his men under Yuan Shao and camped at Shequan. In the fourth month, in summer, Cao advanced to the Yellow River and sent Shi Huan and Cao Ren across against him. Sui Gu left Xue Hong and Miao Shang, governor of Henei, to hold the camp and went north himself to ask Yuan Shao for help; he ran into Shi Huan and Cao Ren at Quancheng, was crushed in the fighting and beheaded. Cao then crossed the river and besieged Shequan; Xue Hong and Miao Shang surrendered with their men and were made marquises, and Cao withdrew to Aocang. He made Wei Zhong governor of Henei and put him in charge of affairs north of the river.

label.zh: 進軍臨河，使史渙、曹仁渡河擊之
label.en: Shi Huan and Cao Ren across the Yellow River

names.name: Ban Yong in the Western Regions

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 延光二年，班勇為西域長史，率兵五百出屯柳中。次年正月至樓蘭，鄯善歸附；龜茲王白英率姑墨、溫宿自縛來降。班勇發其兵萬餘人至車師前王庭，擊走匈奴伊蠡王，車師前部復通。四年秋，勇發敦煌、張掖、酒泉六千騎及鄯善、疏勒、車師前部兵，大破車師後部王軍就。永建二年，勇與敦煌太守張朗分南北兩道會擊焉耆。
summary.en: In 123 Ban Yong was made Chief Clerk of the Western Regions and camped at Liuzhong with five hundred men. The next month he reached Loulan and Shanshan came over; Baiying, king of Qiuci, came with Gumo and Wensu and surrendered. With over ten thousand of their troops Ban Yong went to the Nearer Jushi court, drove off the Xiongnu King Yili and reopened the Nearer Division. In the autumn of 125 he crushed Junjiu, king of the Further Jushi, with six thousand horse from Dunhuang, Zhangye and Jiuquan and troops of Shanshan, Shule and the Nearer Jushi. In 127 he and Zhang Lang, governor of Dunhuang, attacked Yanqi by the southern and northern roads.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷四十七 班梁列傳
passages.textZh: 延光二年夏，復以勇爲西域長史，將兵五百人出屯柳中。明年正月，勇至樓蘭，以鄯善歸附，特加三綬。而龜茲王白英猶自疑未下，勇開以恩信，白英乃率姑墨、溫宿自縛詣勇降。勇因發其兵步騎萬餘人到車師前王庭，擊走匈奴伊蠡王於伊和谷，收得前部五千餘人，於是前部始復開通。
passages.textEn: In the summer of the second Yanguang year Yong was again made Chief Clerk of the Western Regions and went out with five hundred men to camp at Liuzhong. In the first month of the next year he reached Loulan and, since Shanshan had come over, it was given three ribbons of office. Baiying, king of Qiuci, still hesitated, but Yong won him with kindness and good faith, and Baiying came with Gumo and Wensu, bound himself and surrendered. Yong then raised their troops, over ten thousand foot and horse, went to the court of the Nearer Jushi king, drove the Xiongnu King Yili from the Yihe valley, and won back five thousand people of the Nearer Division, which was opened again.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷四十七 班梁列傳
passages.textZh: 四年秋，勇發敦煌、張掖、酒泉六千騎及鄯善、疏勒、車師前部兵擊後部王軍就，大破之。
passages.textEn: In the autumn of the fourth year Yong raised six thousand horsemen from Dunhuang, Zhangye and Jiuquan, with troops of Shanshan, Shule and the Nearer Jushi, and attacked Junjiu, king of the Further Division, crushing him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷四十七 班梁列傳
passages.textZh: 二年，勇上請攻元孟，於是遣敦煌太守張朗將河西四郡兵三千人配勇。因發諸國兵四萬餘人，分騎爲兩道擊之。勇從南道，朗從北道，約期俱至焉耆。
passages.textEn: In the second year Yong asked leave to attack Yuanmeng, and Zhang Lang, governor of Dunhuang, was sent with three thousand troops of the four Hexi commanderies to join him. They raised over forty thousand troops of the states and attacked in two columns, Yong by the southern road and Lang by the northern, agreeing to meet at Yanqi.

label.zh: 到車師前王庭，擊走匈奴伊蠡王
勇從南道，朗從北道，約期俱至焉耆

names.name: 永初羌亂（冀西、平襄之戰）
The Qiang rising of 107 (Jixi and Pingxiang)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 永初元年，先零種羌叛，截斷隴道，大肆寇掠，朝廷遣車騎將軍鄧隲、征西校尉任尚討伐。次年正月鄧隲為羌所敗於冀西；十月任尚與先零羌戰於平襄，又敗績。十一月鄧隲被召還京師，留任尚屯隴右；先零羌滇零在北地稱天子，隨即寇掠三輔，東犯趙、魏，南入益州，殺漢中太守董炳。
summary.en: In 107 the Xianling Qiang rebelled, cut the Long road and plundered far and wide, and Deng Zhi and Ren Shang were sent against them. In the first month of 108 Deng Zhi was beaten west of Ji; in the tenth month Ren Shang was routed at Pingxiang. In the eleventh month Deng Zhi was recalled, leaving Ren Shang in Longyou, and Dianling of the Xianling Qiang proclaimed himself emperor in Beidi, then raided the Three Adjuncts, struck east into Zhao and Wei and south into Yi Province, killing Dong Bing, governor of Hanzhong.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷五 孝安帝紀
passages.textZh: 先零種羌叛，斷隴道，大爲寇掠，遣車騎將軍鄧隲、征西校尉任尚討之。
passages.textEn: The Xianling Qiang rebelled, cut the Long road and plundered far and wide; General of Chariots and Cavalry Deng Zhi and Colonel Ren Shang were sent against them.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷五 孝安帝紀
passages.textZh: 車騎大將軍鄧隲爲種羌所敗於兾西。
passages.textEn: Deng Zhi, General of Chariots and Cavalry, was beaten by the Qiang west of Ji.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷五 孝安帝紀
passages.textZh: 征西校尉任尚與先零羌戰于平襄，尚軍敗績。
passages.textEn: Ren Shang, Colonel Who Conquers the West, fought the Xianling Qiang at Pingxiang, and his army was routed.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷五 孝安帝紀
passages.textZh: 先零羌滇零稱天子於北地，遂寇三輔，東犯趙、魏，南入益州，殺漢中太守董炳。
passages.textEn: Dianling of the Xianling Qiang proclaimed himself emperor in Beidi, then raided the Three Adjuncts, struck east into Zhao and Wei and south into Yi Province, killing Dong Bing, governor of Hanzhong.

label.zh: 滇零稱天子於北地，遂寇三輔
南入益州，殺漢中太守董炳

names.name: 逢義山之戰（段熲破先零羌）
Battle of Mount Fengyi (Duan Jiong against the Xianling Qiang)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 建寧元年春，段熲率兵萬餘人，攜十五日糧，從彭陽直趨高平，與先零諸種戰於逢義山，斬首八千餘級，獲牛馬羊二十八萬頭。夏，段熲再追羌出橋門，至走馬水；聞羌眾在奢延澤，率輕兵一晝夜疾行二百餘里，清晨追及，擊破之；此後連番追擊，至涇陽時，殘餘四千落皆散入漢陽山谷之間。
summary.en: In the spring of 168 Duan Jiong led over ten thousand men with fifteen days' rations from Pengyang straight for Gaoping and fought the Xianling tribes at Mount Fengyi, taking over eight thousand heads and two hundred and eighty thousand oxen, horses and sheep. In the summer he pursued the Qiang again out through Qiaomen to the Zouma River; hearing they were at the Sheyan marsh, he took light troops two hundred li in a day and a night, caught them at dawn and broke them; by the time the pursuit reached Jingyang the four thousand camps left had scattered into the valleys of Hanyang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷六十五 皇甫張段列傳
passages.textZh: 建寧元年春，熲將兵萬餘人，繼十五日糧，從彭陽直指高平，與先零諸種戰於逢義山。
passages.textEn: In the spring of the first Jianning year Jiong led over ten thousand men with fifteen days' rations from Pengyang straight for Gaoping, and fought the Xianling tribes at Mount Fengyi.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷六十五 皇甫張段列傳
passages.textZh: 斬首八千餘級，獲牛馬羊二十八萬頭。
passages.textEn: He took over eight thousand heads and two hundred and eighty thousand oxen, horses and sheep.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷六十五 皇甫張段列傳
passages.textZh: 夏，熲復追羌出橋門，至走馬水上。尋聞虜在奢延澤，乃將輕兵兼行，一日一夜二百餘里，晨及賊，擊破之。
passages.textEn: In summer Jiong pursued the Qiang again out through Qiaomen to the Zouma River. Hearing that they were at the Sheyan marsh, he took light troops at double pace, over two hundred li in a day and a night, caught them at dawn and broke them.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷六十五 皇甫張段列傳
passages.textZh: 既到涇陽，餘寇四千落，悉散入漢陽山谷閒。
passages.textEn: When they reached Jingyang, the four thousand camps left of the raiders all scattered into the valleys of Hanyang.

label.zh: 從彭陽直指高平，戰於逢義山
追羌出橋門…奢延澤，擊破之
label.en: The pursuit to the Sheyan marsh

label.zh: 既到涇陽，餘寇散入漢陽山谷

names.name: The three-column expedition against the Xianbei

summary.zh: 鮮卑檀石槐寇抄漢邊不止，拒受王號，分其地為三部。熹平六年八月，漢遣夏育出高柳、田晏出雲中、臧旻率南單于出鴈門，各領萬騎，三道出塞二千餘里。檀石槐命三部大人各率眾迎戰，夏育等大敗，失其節傳輜重，各率數十騎逃還，士卒死者十之七八。戰場所在史未明記。
summary.en: Tanshihuai's Xianbei raided the frontier ceaselessly, refused a royal title and divided their lands into three divisions. In the eighth month of 177 Han sent Xia Yu out from Gaoliu, Tian Yan from Yunzhong and Zang Min with the southern chanyu from Yanmen, each with ten thousand horse, by three roads over two thousand li beyond the frontier. Tanshihuai had the chiefs of his three divisions meet them; all three were routed, losing their credentials and baggage, and fled home with a few dozen horsemen each, seven or eight in ten of their men dead. The sources do not say where the battles were fought.

label.en: Han: Xia Yu, Tian Yan, Zang Min (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷九十 烏桓鮮卑列傳
passages.textZh: 朝廷積患之，而不能制，遂遣使持印綬封檀石槐為王，欲與和親。檀石槐不肯受，而寇抄滋甚。乃自分其地為三部
passages.textEn: The court suffered from them for years and could not stop them, so it sent envoys with a seal to make Tanshihuai a king and seek peace by marriage. He would not accept, and raided all the more; he divided his lands into three divisions

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷九十 烏桓鮮卑列傳
passages.textZh: 遂遣夏育出高柳，田晏出雲中，匈奴中郎將臧旻率南單于出鴈門，各將萬騎，三道出塞二千餘里。檀石槐命三部大人各帥眾逆戰，育等大敗，喪其節傳輜重，各將數十騎奔還，死者十七八。
passages.textEn: So Xia Yu was sent out from Gaoliu, Tian Yan from Yunzhong, and Zang Min, General of the Household for the Xiongnu, with the southern chanyu from Yanmen, each with ten thousand horse, by three roads over two thousand li beyond the frontier. Tanshihuai had the chiefs of his three divisions each lead their men against them; Xia Yu and the others were routed, lost their credentials and baggage, and each fled home with a few dozen horsemen; seven or eight in ten had died.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷八 孝靈帝紀
passages.textZh: 八月，遣破鮮卑中郎將田晏出雲中，使匈奴中郎將臧旻與南單于出鴈門，護烏桓校尉夏育出高柳，並伐鮮卑，晏等大敗。
passages.textEn: In the eighth month Tian Yan was sent out from Yunzhong, Zang Min with the southern chanyu from Yanmen, and Xia Yu, Protector of the Wuhuan, from Gaoliu, all against the Xianbei; Tian Yan and the others were routed.

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 慶曆二年閏九月，元昊攻定川寨，涇原路副都總管葛懷敏戰死，諸將死者十四人，元昊大掠渭州而去。
summary.en: In the intercalary ninth month of 1042 Yuanhao attacked the Dingchuan stockade; Ge Huaimin, deputy commander of the Jingyuan circuit, fell with fourteen of his generals, and Yuanhao plundered Weizhou far and wide before leaving.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十一 仁宗紀三
passages.textZh: 是月，元昊寇定川砦，涇原路馬步軍副都總管葛懷敏戰沒，諸將死者十四人，元昊大掠渭州而去。
passages.textEn: That month Yuanhao attacked the Dingchuan stockade; Ge Huaimin, deputy commander of the Jingyuan circuit, fell in battle with fourteen of his generals, and Yuanhao plundered Weizhou far and wide before leaving.

names.name: 熙河開邊（王韶取熙、河、岷）
The opening of Xihe (Wang Shao takes Xi, He and Min)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 熙寧五年八月，秦鳳路沿邊安撫王韶收復武勝軍，十月升為熙州，設熙河路。六年二月王韶收復河州，俘木征妻子；九月岷州首領木令征以城降，王韶入岷州。
summary.en: In the eighth month of 1072 Wang Shao, Pacification Commissioner of the Qinfeng frontier, recovered Wushengjun, which became Xizhou in the tenth month, seat of a new Xihe circuit. In the second month of 1073 he recovered Hezhou, capturing Muzheng's wife and children; in the ninth the chief of Minzhou, Mulingzheng, surrendered his town and Wang Shao entered it.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 秦鳳路沿邊安撫王韶復武勝軍。
passages.textEn: Wang Shao, Pacification Commissioner of the Qinfeng frontier, recovered Wushengjun.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 冬十月戊戌，升鎮洮軍爲熙州、鎮洮軍節度，置熙河路。
passages.textEn: On wuxu of the tenth month, in winter, Zhentao was raised to Xizhou with a military governor, and the Xihe circuit was set up.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 王韶復河州，獲木征妻子。
passages.textEn: Wang Shao recovered Hezhou and captured Muzheng's wife and children.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 戊午，岷州首領木令征以其城降，王韶入岷州。
passages.textEn: On wuwu Mulingzheng, chief of Minzhou, surrendered his town, and Wang Shao entered Minzhou.

names.name: The war with Jiaozhi (the Fuliang River)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 熙寧八年十一月，交阯攻陷欽州、廉州；次年正月陷邕州，知州蘇緘殉城。二月宋以郭逵為安南道招討使，並詔占城、真臘合擊交阯。宋軍至桂州，郭逵遣和斌等督水軍渡海自廣東入，諸軍自廣南入。十二月郭逵敗交阯於富良江，擒其太子洪真，李乾德遣人奉表請降，郭逵班師。
summary.en: In the eleventh month of 1075 Jiaozhi took Qinzhou and Lianzhou; in the first month of 1076 it took Yongzhou, whose prefect Su Jian died with the city. In the second month Song made Guo Kui commander of the Annam campaign and called on Champa and Cambodia to join the attack. The army reached Guizhou; Guo Kui sent He Bin with the fleet by sea from Guangdong while the rest went in from Guangnan. In the twelfth month he beat Jiaozhi on the Fuliang River and captured its crown prince Hongzhen; Li Qiande submitted, and Guo Kui led the army home.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 十一月戊寅，交阯陷欽州。壬午，立陝西蕃丁法。甲申，交阯陷廉州。
passages.textEn: On wuyin of the eleventh month Jiaozhi took Qinzhou. On renwu the law on barbarian conscripts in Shaanxi was made. On jiashen Jiaozhi took Lianzhou.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 戊辰，交阯陷邕州，知州蘇緘死之。
passages.textEn: On wuchen Jiaozhi took Yongzhou, and its prefect Su Jian died there.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 二月戊子，宣徽南院使郭逵爲安南道招討使，罷李憲，以趙禼副之。詔占城、占臘合擊交阯。
passages.textEn: On wuzi of the second month Guo Kui was made commander of the Annam campaign, replacing Li Xian, with Zhao Xie as his deputy, and Champa and Cambodia were called on to join the attack on Jiaozhi.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 是月，安南行營次桂州，郭逵遣鈐轄和斌等督水軍涉海自廣東入，諸軍自廣南入。
passages.textEn: That month the Annam army reached Guizhou; Guo Kui sent He Bin and others with the fleet by sea from Guangdong, and the other armies went in from Guangnan.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十五 神宗紀二
passages.textZh: 癸卯，郭逵敗交阯于富良江，獲其偽太子洪真，李乾德遣人奉表詣軍門降，逵遂班師。
passages.textEn: On guimao Guo Kui beat Jiaozhi on the Fuliang River and captured its pretended crown prince Hongzhen; Li Qiande sent a memorial of submission to the camp gate, and Kui led the army home.

label.zh: 交阯陷邕州，知州蘇緘死之
安南行營次桂州，諸軍自廣南入

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 元豐四年七月，邊臣奏報夏人囚禁其主秉常，宋詔陝西、河東諸路討伐。九月李憲收復蘭州古城；种諤擊敗來救米脂砦的夏軍，又敗夏人於無定川，十月米脂砦降。高遵裕收復清遠軍，又復韋州；李憲敗夏人於屈吳山；种諤入夏州。十一月諸軍會攻靈州，种諤敗夏人於黑水。旋即班師，种諤三萬兵至夏州索家平因無糧而潰散，高遵裕撤軍時遭夏人追擊，亦潰。
summary.en: In the seventh month of 1081, told that the Xia had imprisoned their ruler Bingchang, Song ordered the Shaanxi and Hedong circuits to attack. In the ninth month Li Xian recovered the old city of Lanzhou; Zhong E beat a Xia army coming to relieve the Mizhi stockade and beat the Xia again on the Wuding River, and Mizhi surrendered in the tenth month. Gao Zunyu recovered Qingyuanjun and Weizhou, Li Xian beat the Xia at Mount Quwu, and Zhong E entered Xiazhou. In the eleventh month the armies joined to attack Lingzhou, and Zhong E beat the Xia on the Black River. Then the armies turned back: Zhong E's thirty thousand broke up for want of food at Suojiaping, and Gao Zunyu's army broke when the Xia pursued it.

label.zh: 宋：五路攻靈州不克，師潰（敗）
label.en: Song: failed at Lingzhou, its armies broke (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十六 神宗紀三
passages.textZh: 庚寅，西邊守臣言夏人囚其主秉常，詔陝西、河東路討之。
passages.textEn: On gengyin the western frontier commanders reported that the Xia had imprisoned their ruler Bingchang, and Shaanxi and Hedong were ordered to attack them.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十六 神宗紀三
passages.textZh: 李憲復蘭州古城。
passages.textEn: Li Xian recovered the old city of Lanzhou.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十六 神宗紀三
passages.textZh: 庚戌，夏兵救米脂砦，鄜延經略副使种諤率衆擊破之。辛亥，种諤又敗夏人於無定川。
passages.textEn: On gengxu Xia troops came to relieve the Mizhi stockade, and Zhong E, deputy commander of Fuyan, beat them; on xinhai Zhong E beat the Xia again on the Wuding River.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十六 神宗紀三
passages.textZh: 十月丁巳，米脂砦降。
passages.textEn: On dingsi of the tenth month the Mizhi stockade surrendered.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十六 神宗紀三
passages.textZh: 庚午，環慶行營經略使高遵裕復清遠軍。
passages.textEn: On gengwu Gao Zunyu, commander of the Huanqing field army, recovered Qingyuanjun.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十六 神宗紀三
passages.textZh: 癸酉，復韋州。乙亥，李憲敗夏人于屈吳山。
passages.textEn: On guiyou Weizhou was recovered. On yihai Li Xian beat the Xia at Mount Quwu.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十六 神宗紀三
passages.textZh: 戊寅，种諤入夏州。
passages.textEn: On wuyin Zhong E entered Xiazhou.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十六 神宗紀三
passages.textZh: 丁亥，諸軍合攻靈州，种諤敗夏人于黑水。
passages.textEn: On dinghai the armies joined to attack Lingzhou, and Zhong E beat the Xia on the Black River.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十六 神宗紀三
passages.textZh: 辛丑，師還。癸卯，种諤至夏州索家平，兵衆三萬人，以無食而潰。丙午，高遵裕以師還，夏人來追，遂潰。
passages.textEn: On xinchou the armies turned back. On guimao Zhong E reached Suojiaping in Xiazhou, where his thirty thousand men broke up for want of food. On bingwu Gao Zunyu's army was withdrawing when the Xia came after it, and it broke.

label.zh: 种諤破夏兵於米脂，米脂砦降

summary.zh: 元豐五年八月宋築永樂城。九月夏人三十萬眾來攻，曲珍戰事不利，裨將寇偉等戰死，夏人遂圍城。宋詔張世矩等領兵救援；九月戊戌永樂城陷，給事中徐禧、內侍李舜舉、陝西轉運判官李稷皆死。
summary.en: In the eighth month of 1082 Song walled Yongle. In the ninth three hundred thousand Xia attacked; Qu Zhen fared badly, his lieutenant Kou Wei and others were killed, and the Xia laid siege. Zhang Shiju and others were ordered to relieve it, but on wuxu of the ninth month Yongle fell, and Xu Xi, Li Shunju and Li Ji died there.

label.en: Song: Xu Xi and others killed (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十六 神宗紀三
passages.textZh: 甲戌，城永樂。
passages.textEn: On jiaxu Yongle was walled.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十六 神宗紀三
passages.textZh: 九月丁亥，夏人三十萬衆寇永樂，曲珍戰不利，裨將寇偉等死之，夏人遂圍城。
passages.textEn: On dinghai of the ninth month three hundred thousand Xia attacked Yongle; Qu Zhen fared badly, his lieutenant Kou Wei and others were killed, and the Xia besieged the town.

passages.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)
passages.locator: 卷十六 神宗紀三
passages.textZh: 戊戌，永樂陷，給事中徐禧、內侍李舜舉、陝西轉運判官李稷死之。
passages.textEn: On wuxu Yongle fell; the Supervising Secretary Xu Xi, the palace eunuch Li Shunju and the Shaanxi fiscal officer Li Ji died there.

summary.zh: 秦少府。以酈山徒眾擊敗周文入關之軍，後於定陶大破楚軍，項梁戰死。降楚後被項羽立為雍王，王咸陽以西，都廢丘。漢王還定三秦，章邯敗於陳倉、好畤，退守廢丘；漢引水灌城，廢丘降，章邯自殺。
summary.en: Privy Treasurer of Qin. With the convicts of Mount Li he routed Zhou Wen's army inside the pass, and later crushed the Chu army at Dingtao, where Xiang Liang died. After going over to Chu he was made King of Yong by Xiang Yu, ruling west of Xianyang from Feiqiu. When the King of Han came back to take the three Qin kingdoms, Zhang Han was beaten at Chencang and Haozhi and held out at Feiqiu until Han flooded it; Feiqiu surrendered and he killed himself.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷四十八 陳涉世家
passages.textZh: 周文，陳之賢人也，嘗為項燕軍視日，事春申君，自言習兵，陳王與之將軍印，西擊秦。行收兵至關，車千乘，卒數十萬，至戲，軍焉。秦令少府章邯免酈山徒、人奴產子生，悉發以擊楚大軍，盡敗之。周文敗，走出關，止次曹陽二三月。章邯追敗之，
passages.textEn: Zhou Wen, a worthy of Chen, who had served Xiang Yan's army as a reader of the days and Lord Chunshen, and said he knew war, was given a general's seal by King Chen and sent west against Qin. Gathering troops on the way, he reached the pass with a thousand chariots and several hundred thousand men and camped at Xi. Qin had the Privy Treasurer Zhang Han free the convicts at Mount Li and the slaves' sons and send them all against the great army of Chu, which he routed. Zhou Wen fled out through the pass and halted at Caoyang for two or three months. Zhang Han pursued and beat him,

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 秦果悉起兵益章邯，擊楚軍，大破之定陶，項梁死。
passages.textEn: Qin did send every man it had to reinforce Zhang Han, who attacked the Chu army and crushed it at Dingtao; Xiang Liang was killed.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 故立沛公為漢王，王巴、蜀、漢中，都南鄭。而三分關中，王秦降將以距塞漢王。項王乃立章邯為雍王，王咸陽以西，都廢邱。
passages.textEn: So the Lord of Pei was made King of Han, ruling Ba, Shu and Hanzhong from Nanzheng. The land within the passes was split in three and given to the surrendered Qin generals to block the King of Han: Zhang Han was made King of Yong, ruling west of Xianyang from Feiqiu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 八月，漢王用韓信之計，從故道還，襲雍王章邯。邯迎擊漢陳倉，雍兵敗，還走；止戰好畤，又復敗，走廢丘。漢王遂定雍地。東至咸陽，引兵圍雍王廢丘，而遣諸將略定隴西、北地、上郡。
passages.textEn: In the eighth month the King of Han, on Han Xin's plan, came back by the Gu road and fell on Zhang Han, King of Yong. Zhang Han met him at Chencang and was beaten and fell back; he made a stand at Haozhi, was beaten again, and fled to Feiqiu. The King of Han secured the land of Yong, went east to Xianyang, besieged the King of Yong at Feiqiu, and sent his generals to take Longxi, Beidi and Shang commandery.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 引水灌廢丘，廢丘降，章邯自殺。
passages.textEn: He turned a river on Feiqiu; Feiqiu surrendered and Zhang Han killed himself.

summary.zh: 項羽之叔，楚軍統帥。與田榮、龍且救東阿，大破秦軍；後秦增兵章邯，大破楚軍於定陶，項梁戰死。
summary.en: Xiang Yu's uncle and commander of the Chu army. With Tian Rong and Long Ju he relieved Dong'e and routed the Qin army; then Qin reinforced Zhang Han, who crushed the Chu army at Dingtao, and Xiang Liang was killed.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 居數月，引兵攻亢父，與齊田榮、司馬龍且軍救東阿，大破秦軍於東阿。
passages.textEn: Some months later he attacked Kangfu and, with the armies of Tian Rong of Qi and the Marshal Long Ju, went to relieve Dong'e, where they routed the Qin army.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 秦果悉起兵益章邯，擊楚軍，大破之定陶，項梁死。
passages.textEn: Qin did send every man it had to reinforce Zhang Han, who attacked the Chu army and crushed it at Dingtao; Xiang Liang was killed.

summary.zh: 秦長史，降楚後立為塞王，王咸陽以東至河，都櫟陽。漢東略地時降漢，彭城之敗後又亡入楚；後與大司馬曹咎於汜水兵敗，自剄。
summary.en: A Qin chief clerk who went over to Chu and was made King of Sai, ruling from Xianyang east to the Yellow River from Yueyang. He surrendered to Han, fled back to Chu after Pengcheng, and cut his own throat on the Si River after he and the Grand Marshal Cao Jiu were routed there.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 故立司馬欣為塞王，王咸陽以東至河，都櫟陽；立董翳為翟王，王上郡，都高奴。徙魏王豹為西魏王，王河東，都平陽。
passages.textEn: So Sima Xin was made King of Sai, ruling from Xianyang east to the Yellow River from Yueyang, and Dong Yi King of Zhai, ruling Shang commandery from Gaonu. Bao, King of Wei, was moved to be King of Western Wei, ruling Hedong from Pingyang.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 二年，漢王東略地，塞王欣、翟王翳、河南王申陽皆降。韓王昌不聽，使韓信擊破之。
passages.textEn: In the second year the King of Han went east to win land, and Xin of Sai, Yi of Zhai and Shen Yang of Henan all surrendered. Chang, King of Han, would not, and Han Xin was sent to break him.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 當是時，諸侯見楚彊漢敗，還皆去漢復為楚。塞王欣亡入楚。
passages.textEn: At this, seeing Chu strong and Han beaten, the lords all left Han and went back to Chu. Xin, the former King of Sai, fled to Chu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 漢果數挑楚軍，楚軍不出，使人辱之五六日，大司馬怒，度兵汜水。士卒半渡，漢擊之，大破楚軍，盡得楚國金玉貨賂。大司馬咎、長史欣皆自剄汜水上。
passages.textEn: Han did challenge the Chu army again and again; it would not come out, so Han had men insult it for five or six days until the Grand Marshal lost his temper and took his army across the Si River. When half had crossed, Han attacked and crushed the Chu army, taking all of Chu's gold, jade and treasure. The Grand Marshal Jiu and the Chief Clerk Xin cut their own throats on the bank of the Si.

summary.zh: 魏王，項羽徙為西魏王，王河東，都平陽。從漢東伐，後絕河津反漢歸楚；韓信自夏陽渡河襲安邑，虜之。後在滎陽被周苛等所殺。
summary.en: King of Wei, moved by Xiang Yu to be King of Western Wei, ruling Hedong from Pingyang. He followed Han east, then cut the river crossings and went back to Chu; Han Xin crossed at Xiayang, fell on Anyi and captured him. He was later killed in Xingyang by Zhou Ke and the others.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 故立司馬欣為塞王，王咸陽以東至河，都櫟陽；立董翳為翟王，王上郡，都高奴。徙魏王豹為西魏王，王河東，都平陽。
passages.textEn: So Sima Xin was made King of Sai, ruling from Xianyang east to the Yellow River from Yueyang, and Dong Yi King of Zhai, ruling Shang commandery from Gaonu. Bao, King of Wei, was moved to be King of Western Wei, ruling Hedong from Pingyang.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 三年，魏王豹謁歸視親疾，至即絕河津，反為楚。
passages.textEn: In the third year Bao, King of Wei, asked leave to visit a sick parent; on arriving he cut the Yellow River crossings and went over to Chu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷九十二 淮陰侯列傳
passages.textZh: 其八月，以信爲左丞相，擊魏。魏王盛兵蒲阪，塞臨晉，信乃益爲疑兵，陳船欲度臨晉，而伏兵從夏陽以木罌缻渡軍，襲安邑。魏王豹驚，引兵迎信，信遂虜豹，定魏爲河東郡。
passages.textEn: In the eighth month Xin was made Chancellor of the Left and sent against Wei. The King of Wei massed his troops at Puban and blocked Linjin; Xin made a show of more troops and drew up boats as if to cross at Linjin, but sent hidden troops across at Xiayang on wooden jars and fell on Anyi. Bao, King of Wei, in alarm led his army against Xin, who captured him and made Wei the commandery of Hedong.

summary.zh: 趙將，平定河內有功，立為殷王，王河內，都朝歌。漢王渡臨晉，下河內，虜殷王。
summary.en: A Zhao general who won Henei and was made King of Yin, ruling Henei from Zhaoge. The King of Han crossed at Linjin, took Henei and captured him.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 故立申陽為河南王，都雒陽。韓王成因故都，都陽翟。趙將司馬卬定河內，數有功，故立卬為殷王，王河內，都朝歌。徙趙王歇為代王。趙相張耳素賢，又從入關，故立耳為常山王，王趙地，都襄國。當陽君黥布為楚將，常冠軍，故立布為九江王，都六。
passages.textEn: So Shen Yang was made King of Henan with his seat at Luoyang. Cheng, King of Han, kept his old seat at Yangzhai. The Zhao general Sima Ang, who had won Henei and done much, was made King of Yin, ruling Henei from Zhaoge. Xie, King of Zhao, was moved to be King of Dai. Zhang Er, chancellor of Zhao, a man long esteemed who had also come in through the pass, was made King of Changshan, ruling the land of Zhao from Xiangguo. Qing Bu, Lord of Dangyang, a Chu general always first in the field, was made King of Jiujiang with his seat at Liu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 三月，漢王從臨晉渡，魏王豹將兵從。下河內，虜殷王，置河內郡。
passages.textEn: In the third month the King of Han crossed at Linjin, with Bao, King of Wei, following with his troops. He took Henei, captured the King of Yin and made Henei a commandery.

summary.zh: 趙相，立為常山王，王趙地，都襄國。陳餘與齊兵擊常山，張耳敗走歸漢；後與韓信東下井陘破趙，次年立為趙王。
summary.en: Chancellor of Zhao, made King of Changshan, ruling Zhao from Xiangguo. Beaten by Chen Yu and the Qi army, he fled to Han; with Han Xin he went down through Jingxing and broke Zhao, and the next year was made King of Zhao.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 故立申陽為河南王，都雒陽。韓王成因故都，都陽翟。趙將司馬卬定河內，數有功，故立卬為殷王，王河內，都朝歌。徙趙王歇為代王。趙相張耳素賢，又從入關，故立耳為常山王，王趙地，都襄國。當陽君黥布為楚將，常冠軍，故立布為九江王，都六。
passages.textEn: So Shen Yang was made King of Henan with his seat at Luoyang. Cheng, King of Han, kept his old seat at Yangzhai. The Zhao general Sima Ang, who had won Henei and done much, was made King of Yin, ruling Henei from Zhaoge. Xie, King of Zhao, was moved to be King of Dai. Zhang Er, chancellor of Zhao, a man long esteemed who had also come in through the pass, was made King of Changshan, ruling the land of Zhao from Xiangguo. Qing Bu, Lord of Dangyang, a Chu general always first in the field, was made King of Jiujiang with his seat at Liu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 陳餘悉發三縣兵，與齊并力擊常山，大破之。張耳走歸漢。陳餘迎故趙王歇於代，反之趙。趙王因立陳餘為代王。
passages.textEn: Chen Yu raised every man of his three counties and with Qi attacked Changshan, crushing it. Zhang Er fled to Han. Chen Yu brought back Xie, the former King of Zhao, from Dai to Zhao, and the King of Zhao made Chen Yu King of Dai.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 遂定魏地，置三郡，曰河東、太原、上黨。漢王乃令張耳與韓信遂東下井陘擊趙，斬陳餘、趙王歇。其明年，立張耳為趙王。
passages.textEn: So the land of Wei was secured and made into three commanderies, Hedong, Taiyuan and Shangdang. The King of Han then had Zhang Er and Han Xin go east down through Jingxing against Zhao, and they beheaded Chen Yu and Xie, King of Zhao. The next year Zhang Er was made King of Zhao.

summary.zh: 趙將。得齊兵擊破常山王張耳，迎趙王歇復王趙，受立為代王。漢使韓信、張耳東下井陘擊趙，斬陳餘。
summary.en: A Zhao general. With troops from Qi he broke Zhang Er, King of Changshan, brought King Xie back to Zhao, and was made King of Dai. Han sent Han Xin and Zhang Er through Jingxing against Zhao, and Chen Yu was beheaded.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 陳餘悉發三縣兵，與齊并力擊常山，大破之。張耳走歸漢。陳餘迎故趙王歇於代，反之趙。趙王因立陳餘為代王。
passages.textEn: Chen Yu raised every man of his three counties and with Qi attacked Changshan, crushing it. Zhang Er fled to Han. Chen Yu brought back Xie, the former King of Zhao, from Dai to Zhao, and the King of Zhao made Chen Yu King of Dai.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 遂定魏地，置三郡，曰河東、太原、上黨。漢王乃令張耳與韓信遂東下井陘擊趙，斬陳餘、趙王歇。其明年，立張耳為趙王。
passages.textEn: So the land of Wei was secured and made into three commanderies, Hedong, Taiyuan and Shangdang. The King of Han then had Zhang Er and Han Xin go east down through Jingxing against Zhao, and they beheaded Chen Yu and Xie, King of Zhao. The next year Zhang Er was made King of Zhao.

summary.zh: 趙王，項羽徙為代王；陳餘擊破常山後迎之復王趙。韓信、張耳破趙，趙王歇被斬。
summary.en: King of Zhao, moved by Xiang Yu to be King of Dai; Chen Yu brought him back to Zhao after breaking Changshan. When Han Xin and Zhang Er broke Zhao, he was beheaded.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 故立申陽為河南王，都雒陽。韓王成因故都，都陽翟。趙將司馬卬定河內，數有功，故立卬為殷王，王河內，都朝歌。徙趙王歇為代王。趙相張耳素賢，又從入關，故立耳為常山王，王趙地，都襄國。當陽君黥布為楚將，常冠軍，故立布為九江王，都六。
passages.textEn: So Shen Yang was made King of Henan with his seat at Luoyang. Cheng, King of Han, kept his old seat at Yangzhai. The Zhao general Sima Ang, who had won Henei and done much, was made King of Yin, ruling Henei from Zhaoge. Xie, King of Zhao, was moved to be King of Dai. Zhang Er, chancellor of Zhao, a man long esteemed who had also come in through the pass, was made King of Changshan, ruling the land of Zhao from Xiangguo. Qing Bu, Lord of Dangyang, a Chu general always first in the field, was made King of Jiujiang with his seat at Liu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 陳餘悉發三縣兵，與齊并力擊常山，大破之。張耳走歸漢。陳餘迎故趙王歇於代，反之趙。趙王因立陳餘為代王。
passages.textEn: Chen Yu raised every man of his three counties and with Qi attacked Changshan, crushing it. Zhang Er fled to Han. Chen Yu brought back Xie, the former King of Zhao, from Dai to Zhao, and the King of Zhao made Chen Yu King of Dai.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 遂定魏地，置三郡，曰河東、太原、上黨。漢王乃令張耳與韓信遂東下井陘擊趙，斬陳餘、趙王歇。其明年，立張耳為趙王。
passages.textEn: So the land of Wei was secured and made into three commanderies, Hedong, Taiyuan and Shangdang. The King of Han then had Zhang Er and Han Xin go east down through Jingxing against Zhao, and they beheaded Chen Yu and Xie, King of Zhao. The next year Zhang Er was made King of Zhao.

summary.zh: 楚將，常冠軍，立為九江王，都六。漢使隨何說之叛楚，楚使龍且擊之，布戰不勝，閒行歸漢。
summary.en: A Chu general always first in the field, made King of Jiujiang with his seat at Liu. Han sent Sui He to win him over; Chu sent Long Ju against him, and beaten, he went over to Han by back roads.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 故立申陽為河南王，都雒陽。韓王成因故都，都陽翟。趙將司馬卬定河內，數有功，故立卬為殷王，王河內，都朝歌。徙趙王歇為代王。趙相張耳素賢，又從入關，故立耳為常山王，王趙地，都襄國。當陽君黥布為楚將，常冠軍，故立布為九江王，都六。
passages.textEn: So Shen Yang was made King of Henan with his seat at Luoyang. Cheng, King of Han, kept his old seat at Yangzhai. The Zhao general Sima Ang, who had won Henei and done much, was made King of Yin, ruling Henei from Zhaoge. Xie, King of Zhao, was moved to be King of Dai. Zhang Er, chancellor of Zhao, a man long esteemed who had also come in through the pass, was made King of Changshan, ruling the land of Zhao from Xiangguo. Qing Bu, Lord of Dangyang, a Chu general always first in the field, was made King of Jiujiang with his seat at Liu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 使謁者隨何之九江王布所，曰：「公能令布舉兵叛楚，項羽必留擊之。得留數月，吾取天下必矣。」隨何往說九江王布，布果背楚。楚使龍且往擊之。
passages.textEn: He sent the herald Sui He to Bu, King of Jiujiang, saying, "If you can get Bu to rise against Chu, Xiang Yu is sure to stay and fight him. If he is kept a few months, the realm is mine." Sui He went and won Bu over, and Bu did turn against Chu. Chu sent Long Ju against him.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 是時九江王布與龍且戰，不勝，與隨何閒行歸漢。
passages.textEn: At this time Bu, King of Jiujiang, fought Long Ju and lost, and went over to Han by back roads with Sui He.

summary.zh: 楚將。曾與項梁救東阿；擊破叛楚的九江王黥布。後率號稱二十萬之眾救齊，與韓信夾濰水而陣，韓信囊沙壅水，佯敗誘其渡水，決囊水至，龍且被殺。
summary.en: A Chu general. He was with Xiang Liang at Dong'e and beat Qing Bu when Jiujiang turned against Chu. Sent to save Qi with an army called two hundred thousand, he faced Han Xin across the Wei River; Han Xin dammed the river with sandbags, feigned defeat to draw him across, then broke the dam, and Long Ju was killed.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 居數月，引兵攻亢父，與齊田榮、司馬龍且軍救東阿，大破秦軍於東阿。
passages.textEn: Some months later he attacked Kangfu and, with the armies of Tian Rong of Qi and the Marshal Long Ju, went to relieve Dong'e, where they routed the Qin army.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 使謁者隨何之九江王布所，曰：「公能令布舉兵叛楚，項羽必留擊之。得留數月，吾取天下必矣。」隨何往說九江王布，布果背楚。楚使龍且往擊之。
passages.textEn: He sent the herald Sui He to Bu, King of Jiujiang, saying, "If you can get Bu to rise against Chu, Xiang Yu is sure to stay and fight him. If he is kept a few months, the realm is mine." Sui He went and won Bu over, and Bu did turn against Chu. Chu sent Long Ju against him.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷九十二 淮陰侯列傳
passages.textZh: 遂戰，與信夾濰水陳。韓信乃夜令人爲萬餘囊，滿盛沙，壅水上流，引軍半渡，擊龍且，詳不勝，還走。龍且果喜曰：『固知信怯也。』遂追信渡水。信使人決壅囊，水大至。龍且軍大半不得渡，即急擊，殺龍且。龍且水東軍散走，齊王廣亡去。信遂追北至城陽，皆虜楚卒。
passages.textEn: So they fought, drawn up on either side of the Wei River. Han Xin had over ten thousand bags filled with sand by night to dam the river upstream, led half his army across, attacked Long Ju, pretended to be beaten and fell back. Long Ju was delighted: "I always knew Xin was a coward." He followed Xin across. Xin had the dam of bags broken and the water came down in flood; most of Long Ju's army could not cross, and Xin attacked at once and killed Long Ju. Long Ju's men east of the river scattered, Tian Guang fled, and Xin pursued the beaten army to Chengyang, capturing all the Chu soldiers.

summary.zh: 燕將，從楚救趙入關，立為燕王，都薊；回國後擊殺遼東王韓廣於無終，兼併其地。韓信破趙後遣使至燕，燕從風而靡。
summary.en: A Yan general who joined Chu to save Zhao and entered the pass, made King of Yan with his seat at Ji. Back home he killed Han Guang, King of Liaodong, at Wuzhong and took his land. When Han Xin had broken Zhao and sent an envoy, Yan bowed before him.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 鄱君吳芮率百越佐諸侯，又從入關，故立芮為衡山王，都邾。義帝柱國共敖將兵擊南郡，功多，因立敖為臨江王，都江陵。徙燕王韓廣為遼東王。燕將臧荼從楚救趙，因從入關，故立荼為燕王，都薊。徙齊王田市為膠東王。齊將田都從共救趙，因從入關，故立都為齊王，都臨菑。
passages.textEn: Wu Rui, Lord of Po, who had led the Hundred Yue to help the lords and come in through the pass, was made King of Hengshan with his seat at Zhu. Gong Ao, Pillar of State of the Righteous Emperor, who had done much in attacking Nan commandery, was made King of Linjiang with his seat at Jiangling. Han Guang, King of Yan, was moved to be King of Liaodong; the Yan general Zang Tu, who had joined Chu to save Zhao and come in through the pass, was made King of Yan with his seat at Ji. Shi, King of Qi, was moved to be King of Jiaodong; the Qi general Tian Du, who had joined in saving Zhao and come in through the pass, was made King of Qi with his seat at Linzi.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 臧荼之國，因逐韓廣之遼東，廣弗聽，荼擊殺廣無終，並王其地。
passages.textEn: Zang Tu went to his kingdom and tried to drive Han Guang off to Liaodong; Guang would not go, so Zang Tu attacked and killed him at Wuzhong and ruled his land as well.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷九十二 淮陰侯列傳
passages.textZh: 從其策，發使使燕，燕從風而靡。
passages.textEn: He followed this plan and sent an envoy to Yan, and Yan bowed before him like grass before the wind.

summary.zh: 奉趙王命北徇燕地，自立為燕王。項羽徙為遼東王，不肯就國，被臧荼擊殺於無終。
summary.en: Sent north by the King of Zhao to win the land of Yan, he made himself King of Yan. Xiang Yu moved him to Liaodong; he would not go, and Zang Tu killed him at Wuzhong.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷四十八 陳涉世家
passages.textZh: 韓廣以為然，乃自立為燕王。
passages.textEn: Han Guang agreed, and made himself King of Yan.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 鄱君吳芮率百越佐諸侯，又從入關，故立芮為衡山王，都邾。義帝柱國共敖將兵擊南郡，功多，因立敖為臨江王，都江陵。徙燕王韓廣為遼東王。燕將臧荼從楚救趙，因從入關，故立荼為燕王，都薊。徙齊王田市為膠東王。齊將田都從共救趙，因從入關，故立都為齊王，都臨菑。
passages.textEn: Wu Rui, Lord of Po, who had led the Hundred Yue to help the lords and come in through the pass, was made King of Hengshan with his seat at Zhu. Gong Ao, Pillar of State of the Righteous Emperor, who had done much in attacking Nan commandery, was made King of Linjiang with his seat at Jiangling. Han Guang, King of Yan, was moved to be King of Liaodong; the Yan general Zang Tu, who had joined Chu to save Zhao and come in through the pass, was made King of Yan with his seat at Ji. Shi, King of Qi, was moved to be King of Jiaodong; the Qi general Tian Du, who had joined in saving Zhao and come in through the pass, was made King of Qi with his seat at Linzi.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 臧荼之國，因逐韓廣之遼東，廣弗聽，荼擊殺廣無終，並王其地。
passages.textEn: Zang Tu went to his kingdom and tried to drive Han Guang off to Liaodong; Guang would not go, so Zang Tu attacked and killed him at Wuzhong and ruled his land as well.

summary.zh: 齊人。不從楚擊秦，項羽分封時未得封。遂自立為齊王，殺濟北王田安，并王三齊。漢二年冬項羽北擊齊，田榮戰敗，走至平原，為平原民所殺。
summary.en: A man of Qi who would not join Chu against Qin and was left out of the enfeoffment. He made himself King of Qi, killed Tian An, King of Jibei, and ruled all three Qi. In the winter of 205 BCE Xiang Yu came north; Tian Rong was beaten, fled to Pingyuan, and was killed by its people.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 故立安為濟北王，都博陽。田榮者，數負項梁，又不肯將兵從楚擊秦，以故不封。
passages.textEn: So Tian An was made King of Jibei with his seat at Boyang. Tian Rong, who had repeatedly let Xiang Liang down and would not lead his troops with Chu against Qin, was given nothing.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 榮因自立為齊王，而西殺擊濟北王田安，并王三齊。
passages.textEn: Rong then made himself King of Qi, went west and killed Tian An, King of Jibei, and ruled all three Qi.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 漢之二年冬，項羽遂北至城陽，田榮亦將兵會戰。田榮不勝，走至平原，平原民殺之。遂北燒夷齊城郭室屋，皆阬田榮降卒，系虜其老弱婦女。徇齊至北海，多所殘滅。齊人相聚而叛之。於是田榮弟田橫收齊亡卒得數萬人，反城陽。項王因留，連戰未能下。
passages.textEn: In the winter of the second year of Han Xiang Yu went north to Chengyang, and Tian Rong came to fight him. Tian Rong was beaten and fled to Pingyuan, where its people killed him. Xiang Yu then went north burning the walls and houses of Qi, burying alive Tian Rong's surrendered troops and carrying off the old, the weak and the women. He went through Qi as far as Beihai, destroying much; the people of Qi gathered and rose against him. Tian Rong's brother Tian Heng gathered the scattered soldiers of Qi, several tens of thousands, and held Chengyang against him. King Xiang stayed, fighting battle after battle without taking it.

names.name: Battle of Xi (Zhang Han breaks Zhou Wen)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 陳勝遣周文西擊秦，周文沿途收兵，至函谷關時已有車千乘、卒數十萬，進至戲。秦令少府章邯赦免酈山刑徒及奴隸之子，悉數發兵迎擊，大敗楚軍。周文敗走出關，駐於曹陽二三月，章邯追擊再敗之。
summary.en: Chen Sheng sent Zhou Wen west against Qin; gathering troops on the way, he reached the pass with a thousand chariots and several hundred thousand men and camped at Xi. Qin had the Privy Treasurer Zhang Han free the convicts of Mount Li and the sons of slaves and throw them all against the Chu army, which he routed. Zhou Wen fled out through the pass and halted at Caoyang for two or three months, where Zhang Han caught and beat him again.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷四十八 陳涉世家
passages.textZh: 周文，陳之賢人也，嘗為項燕軍視日，事春申君，自言習兵，陳王與之將軍印，西擊秦。行收兵至關，車千乘，卒數十萬，至戲，軍焉。秦令少府章邯免酈山徒、人奴產子生，悉發以擊楚大軍，盡敗之。周文敗，走出關，止次曹陽二三月。章邯追敗之，
passages.textEn: Zhou Wen, a worthy of Chen, who had served Xiang Yan's army as a reader of the days and Lord Chunshen, and said he knew war, was given a general's seal by King Chen and sent west against Qin. Gathering troops on the way, he reached the pass with a thousand chariots and several hundred thousand men and camped at Xi. Qin had the Privy Treasurer Zhang Han free the convicts at Mount Li and the slaves' sons and send them all against the great army of Chu, which he routed. Zhou Wen fled out through the pass and halted at Caoyang for two or three months. Zhang Han pursued and beat him,

label.zh: 章邯擊楚大軍，周文走出關，止次曹陽
label.en: Zhang Han drives him back to Caoyang

names.name: 東阿、定陶之戰（項梁之死）
Dong'e and Dingtao (the death of Xiang Liang)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 項梁與齊田榮、司馬龍且救東阿，大破秦軍；劉邦、項羽攻定陶未下，西至雍丘，大破秦軍，斬李由。項梁連勝而驕，秦盡起兵增援章邯，於定陶大破楚軍，項梁戰死。
summary.en: Xiang Liang, with Tian Rong of Qi and the Marshal Long Ju, relieved Dong'e and routed the Qin army; the Lord of Pei and Xiang Yu failed to take Dingtao but went west to Yongqiu, routed another Qin army and beheaded Li You. Xiang Liang grew proud with victory; Qin threw everything it had in behind Zhang Han, who crushed the Chu army at Dingtao, and Xiang Liang was killed.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
