passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 居數月，引兵攻亢父，與齊田榮、司馬龍且軍救東阿，大破秦軍於東阿。
passages.textEn: Some months later he attacked Kangfu and, with the armies of Tian Rong of Qi and the Marshal Long Ju, went to relieve Dong'e, where they routed the Qin army.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 沛公、項羽乃攻定陶。定陶未下，去，西略地至雝丘，大破秦軍，斬李由。
passages.textEn: The Lord of Pei and Xiang Yu attacked Dingtao; when it did not fall they went on west to Yongqiu, routed a Qin army and beheaded Li You.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 秦果悉起兵益章邯，擊楚軍，大破之定陶，項梁死。
passages.textEn: Qin did send every man it had to reinforce Zhang Han, who attacked the Chu army and crushed it at Dingtao; Xiang Liang was killed.

label.zh: 救東阿，大破秦軍；攻定陶
西略地至雝丘，大破秦軍，斬李由

names.name: Liu Bang's march into the pass (Wu Pass and Lantian)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 楚懷王遣宋義、項羽北救趙，令沛公西略地入關，並約「先入定關中者王之」。劉邦西與秦將楊熊戰於白馬、曲遇東，大破之；略南陽郡，南陽守齮退保宛城。劉邦原欲越宛西進，用張良之諫，夜間改道回師，黎明圍宛三匝，招降宛守，封為殷侯，此後西進所過皆下。又襲破武關，戰於藍田南，多張疑兵旗幟，禁止掠奪，秦人喜悅，秦軍瓦解，連戰大破之。漢元年十月，劉邦先諸侯至霸上，秦王子嬰素車白馬、繫頸以組，奉皇帝璽符降於軹道旁，秦亡。
summary.en: King Huai sent Song Yi and Xiang Yu north to save Zhao and the Lord of Pei west to enter the pass, promising the land within the passes to whoever got there first. Liu Bang beat the Qin general Yang Xiong at Baima and east of Quyu, and overran Nanyang, whose governor fell back to Wan. Meaning to bypass Wan, he took Zhang Liang's advice, came back by night and surrounded it at dawn; the governor surrendered and was made a marquis, and every town further west opened to him. He broke the Wu Pass, fought south of Lantian, spreading banners to deceive the enemy and forbidding plunder, so that the people of Qin welcomed him and its army melted away, and routed it there and north of Lantian. In the tenth month of the first year of Han he reached Bashang ahead of all the lords, and Ziying, King of Qin, came in a plain carriage with a cord round his neck and the imperial seals to surrender beside the Zhi road. Qin was at an end.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 趙數請救，懷王乃以宋義為上將軍，項羽為次將，范增為末將，北救趙。令沛公西略地入關。與諸將約，先入定關中者王之。
passages.textEn: Zhao asked again and again for help, so King Huai made Song Yi supreme general, Xiang Yu second and Fan Zeng third, and sent them north to save Zhao. He sent the Lord of Pei west to win land and enter the pass, agreeing with the generals that whoever first entered and settled the land within the passes should be its king.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 西與秦將楊熊戰白馬，又戰曲遇東，大破之。
passages.textEn: Going west he fought the Qin general Yang Xiong at Baima and again east of Quyu, and routed him.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 略南陽郡，南陽守齮走，保城守宛。
passages.textEn: He overran Nanyang commandery; Yi, governor of Nanyang, fell back to hold the city of Wan.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 於是沛公乃夜引兵從他道還，更旗幟，黎明，圍宛城三匝。
passages.textEn: So the Lord of Pei led his troops back by another road in the night, changed his banners, and at dawn surrounded Wan three times over.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 乃以宛守為殷侯，封陳恢千戶。引兵西，無不下者。
passages.textEn: He made the governor of Wan Marquis of Yin and gave Chen Hui a thousand households, and led his army west; every town opened to him.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 因襲攻武關，破之。又與秦軍戰於藍田南，益張疑兵旗幟，諸所過毋得掠鹵，秦人喜，秦軍解，因大破之。又戰其北，大破之。
passages.textEn: Then he fell on the Wu Pass and broke it. He fought the Qin army south of Lantian, spreading many banners to deceive it and forbidding plunder wherever he passed; the people of Qin were glad, the Qin army melted away, and he routed it; he fought north of Lantian and routed it again.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 漢元年十月，沛公兵遂先諸侯至霸上。秦王子嬰素車白馬，系頸以組，封皇帝璽符節，降軹道旁。
passages.textEn: In the tenth month of the first year of Han the Lord of Pei's army reached Bashang ahead of all the lords. Ziying, King of Qin, came in a plain carriage drawn by a white horse, a cord round his neck, with the sealed imperial seals and tallies, and surrendered beside the Zhi road.

label.zh: 引兵西，無不下者；襲攻武關，破之
與秦軍戰於藍田南，大破之
沛公兵遂先諸侯至霸上

names.name: The return to take the three Qin kingdoms (Chencang and Feiqiu)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 漢元年八月，漢王用韓信之計，從故道北還，襲擊雍王章邯。章邯迎戰於陳倉，敗走；再戰於好畤，又敗，退守廢丘。漢王遂定雍地，東至咸陽，圍章邯於廢丘，遣諸將略定隴西、北地、上郡。次年，漢王東出略地，塞王司馬欣、翟王董翳、河南王申陽皆降；韓王鄭昌不降，韓信擊破之。六月，漢引水灌廢丘，廢丘降，章邯自殺。
summary.en: In the eighth month of 206 BCE the King of Han, on Han Xin's plan, came back north by the Gu road and fell on Zhang Han, King of Yong. Zhang Han met him at Chencang and was beaten; he made a stand at Haozhi, was beaten again, and held out at Feiqiu. The King of Han secured Yong, went on to Xianyang, besieged Feiqiu and sent his generals to take Longxi, Beidi and Shang. The next year, when he went east, Sima Xin of Sai, Dong Yi of Zhai and Shen Yang of Henan surrendered; Zheng Chang, King of Han, would not, and Han Xin broke him. In the sixth month Han turned a river on Feiqiu; it surrendered and Zhang Han killed himself.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 八月，漢王用韓信之計，從故道還，襲雍王章邯。邯迎擊漢陳倉，雍兵敗，還走；止戰好畤，又復敗，走廢丘。漢王遂定雍地。東至咸陽，引兵圍雍王廢丘，而遣諸將略定隴西、北地、上郡。
passages.textEn: In the eighth month the King of Han, on Han Xin's plan, came back by the Gu road and fell on Zhang Han, King of Yong. Zhang Han met him at Chencang and was beaten and fell back; he made a stand at Haozhi, was beaten again, and fled to Feiqiu. The King of Han secured the land of Yong, went east to Xianyang, besieged the King of Yong at Feiqiu, and sent his generals to take Longxi, Beidi and Shang commandery.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 二年，漢王東略地，塞王欣、翟王翳、河南王申陽皆降。韓王昌不聽，使韓信擊破之。
passages.textEn: In the second year the King of Han went east to win land, and Xin of Sai, Yi of Zhai and Shen Yang of Henan all surrendered. Chang, King of Han, would not, and Han Xin was sent to break him.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 引水灌廢丘，廢丘降，章邯自殺。
passages.textEn: He turned a river on Feiqiu; Feiqiu surrendered and Zhang Han killed himself.

label.zh: 走廢丘；引兵圍雍王廢丘

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 項羽分封後，燕王臧荼就國，欲驅逐故燕王韓廣往遼東；韓廣不從，臧荼擊殺之於無終，兼併其地。
summary.en: After the enfeoffment Zang Tu went to his kingdom of Yan and tried to drive the former king, Han Guang, off to Liaodong; Han Guang would not go, so Zang Tu killed him at Wuzhong and took his land.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 臧荼之國，因逐韓廣之遼東，廣弗聽，荼擊殺廣無終，並王其地。
passages.textEn: Zang Tu went to his kingdom and tried to drive Han Guang off to Liaodong; Guang would not go, so Zang Tu attacked and killed him at Wuzhong and ruled his land as well.

label.zh: 荼擊殺廣無終，並王其地

summary.zh: 陳餘未得封王，求兵於自立為齊王的田榮，盡發所封三縣之兵，與齊兵合力攻常山王張耳，大破之，張耳逃奔漢。陳餘迎故趙王歇自代返趙復位，趙王立陳餘為代王。
summary.en: Left without a kingdom, Chen Yu got troops from Tian Rong, now self-made King of Qi, raised every man of his three counties, and with Qi attacked Zhang Er, King of Changshan, crushing him; Zhang Er fled to Han. Chen Yu brought King Xie back from Dai to Zhao, and the king made him King of Dai.

label.en: King of Changshan, fled to Han (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 陳餘悉發三縣兵，與齊并力擊常山，大破之。張耳走歸漢。陳餘迎故趙王歇於代，反之趙。趙王因立陳餘為代王。
passages.textEn: Chen Yu raised every man of his three counties and with Qi attacked Changshan, crushing it. Zhang Er fled to Han. Chen Yu brought back Xie, the former King of Zhao, from Dai to Zhao, and the King of Zhao made Chen Yu King of Dai.

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 漢二年冬，項羽北至城陽，田榮迎戰敗走平原，為平原民所殺。項羽北焚齊國城郭屋舍，坑殺田榮降卒，擄掠老弱婦女，徇齊至北海，殘滅甚多，齊人相聚反叛。田榮弟田橫收齊散卒數萬，據城陽反抗，項羽連戰不能下——劉邦得以乘虛率五諸侯兵攻入彭城。
summary.en: In the winter of 205 BCE Xiang Yu went north to Chengyang; Tian Rong met him, was beaten, fled to Pingyuan and was killed by its people. Xiang Yu went north burning the walls and houses of Qi, burying alive Tian Rong's surrendered men and carrying off the old, weak and women, as far as Beihai; the people of Qi rose against him. Tian Rong's brother Tian Heng gathered tens of thousands and held Chengyang, and Xiang Yu fought battle after battle without taking it — which gave Liu Bang his chance to lead five lords' armies into Pengcheng.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷七 項羽本紀
passages.textZh: 漢之二年冬，項羽遂北至城陽，田榮亦將兵會戰。田榮不勝，走至平原，平原民殺之。遂北燒夷齊城郭室屋，皆阬田榮降卒，系虜其老弱婦女。徇齊至北海，多所殘滅。齊人相聚而叛之。於是田榮弟田橫收齊亡卒得數萬人，反城陽。項王因留，連戰未能下。
passages.textEn: In the winter of the second year of Han Xiang Yu went north to Chengyang, and Tian Rong came to fight him. Tian Rong was beaten and fled to Pingyuan, where its people killed him. Xiang Yu then went north burning the walls and houses of Qi, burying alive Tian Rong's surrendered troops and carrying off the old, the weak and the women. He went through Qi as far as Beihai, destroying much; the people of Qi gathered and rose against him. Tian Rong's brother Tian Heng gathered the scattered soldiers of Qi, several tens of thousands, and held Chengyang against him. King Xiang stayed, fighting battle after battle without taking it.

label.zh: 項羽遂北至城陽，田榮亦將兵會戰

names.name: 韓信破魏、代（夏陽木罌渡河）
Han Xin takes Wei and Dai (crossing at Xiayang)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 漢二年，魏王豹以探親為名歸國，隨即截斷黃河渡口，反漢歸楚。八月漢以韓信為左丞相擊魏。魏王重兵屯蒲阪、堵塞臨晉，韓信大張疑兵，陳列船隻作勢從臨晉渡河，暗中以伏兵從夏陽乘木罌缻渡河，襲取安邑。魏王豹大驚，引兵迎戰，被韓信所俘，魏地成為河東郡。後九月韓信與張耳又破代兵，擒代相夏說於閼與。
summary.en: In 205 BCE Bao, King of Wei, went home on the pretext of a sick parent, cut the Yellow River crossings and went over to Chu. In the eighth month Han Xin was sent against him. The King of Wei massed at Puban and blocked Linjin; Han Xin made a great show of troops and boats as if to cross at Linjin, but sent a hidden force across upstream at Xiayang floating on wooden jars, which fell on Anyi. The King of Wei turned to meet him in alarm and was captured, and Wei became the commandery of Hedong. In the intercalary ninth month Han Xin and Zhang Er broke the army of Dai and captured Xia Yue at Yuyu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 三年，魏王豹謁歸視親疾，至即絕河津，反為楚。
passages.textEn: In the third year Bao, King of Wei, asked leave to visit a sick parent; on arriving he cut the Yellow River crossings and went over to Chu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷九十二 淮陰侯列傳
passages.textZh: 其八月，以信爲左丞相，擊魏。魏王盛兵蒲阪，塞臨晉，信乃益爲疑兵，陳船欲度臨晉，而伏兵從夏陽以木罌缻渡軍，襲安邑。魏王豹驚，引兵迎信，信遂虜豹，定魏爲河東郡。
passages.textEn: In the eighth month Xin was made Chancellor of the Left and sent against Wei. The King of Wei massed his troops at Puban and blocked Linjin; Xin made a show of more troops and drew up boats as if to cross at Linjin, but sent hidden troops across at Xiayang on wooden jars and fell on Anyi. Bao, King of Wei, in alarm led his army against Xin, who captured him and made Wei the commandery of Hedong.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷九十二 淮陰侯列傳
passages.textZh: 漢王遣張耳與信俱，引兵東，北擊趙、代。後九月，破代兵，禽夏說閼與。
passages.textEn: The King of Han sent Zhang Er with Xin to lead the army east and north against Zhao and Dai. In the intercalary ninth month they broke the army of Dai and captured Xia Yue at Yuyu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 遂定魏地，置三郡，曰河東、太原、上黨。漢王乃令張耳與韓信遂東下井陘擊趙，斬陳餘、趙王歇。其明年，立張耳為趙王。
passages.textEn: So the land of Wei was secured and made into three commanderies, Hedong, Taiyuan and Shangdang. The King of Han then had Zhang Er and Han Xin go east down through Jingxing against Zhao, and they beheaded Chen Yu and Xie, King of Zhao. The next year Zhang Er was made King of Zhao.

label.zh: 伏兵從夏陽以木罌缻渡軍，襲安邑

summary.zh: 彭城大敗後，諸侯見楚強漢敗，紛紛離漢歸楚，塞王司馬欣也逃入楚。漢王逐步收集散卒，加上諸將及關中兵陸續東出，兵勢重振於滎陽，在京、索之間擊破楚軍，止住了楚軍西進。
summary.en: After the disaster at Pengcheng the lords, seeing Chu strong and Han beaten, went back to Chu, and Sima Xin of Sai fled to Chu. The King of Han gathered his scattered troops, and with his generals and more men from within the passes his army grew strong again at Xingyang, where it broke the Chu army between Jing and Suo and stopped its advance west.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 當是時，諸侯見楚彊漢敗，還皆去漢復為楚。塞王欣亡入楚。
passages.textEn: At this, seeing Chu strong and Han beaten, the lords all left Han and went back to Chu. Xin, the former King of Sai, fled to Chu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 漢王稍收士卒，與諸將及關中卒益出，是以兵大振滎陽，破楚京、索閒。
passages.textEn: The King of Han gradually gathered his soldiers, and with his generals and more men from within the passes his army grew strong again at Xingyang, and broke Chu between Jing and Suo.

names.name: Long Ju attacks Jiujiang (Qing Bu goes over to Han)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 彭城敗後，漢王遣謁者隨何遊說九江王黥布叛楚，以拖住項羽數月。黥布果然背楚，楚派龍且往擊，黥布戰敗，與隨何從小路逃歸漢。
summary.en: After Pengcheng the King of Han sent the herald Sui He to persuade Qing Bu, King of Jiujiang, to rise against Chu and tie Xiang Yu down for a few months. Qing Bu did turn against Chu; Chu sent Long Ju against him, and beaten, he fled to Han by back roads with Sui He.

label.en: King of Jiujiang, fled to Han (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 使謁者隨何之九江王布所，曰：「公能令布舉兵叛楚，項羽必留擊之。得留數月，吾取天下必矣。」隨何往說九江王布，布果背楚。楚使龍且往擊之。
passages.textEn: He sent the herald Sui He to Bu, King of Jiujiang, saying, "If you can get Bu to rise against Chu, Xiang Yu is sure to stay and fight him. If he is kept a few months, the realm is mine." Sui He went and won Bu over, and Bu did turn against Chu. Chu sent Long Ju against him.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 是時九江王布與龍且戰，不勝，與隨何閒行歸漢。
passages.textEn: At this time Bu, King of Jiujiang, fought Long Ju and lost, and went over to Han by back roads with Sui He.

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 漢王屯軍滎陽南，築甬道連接黃河以取敖倉之糧，與項羽相持一年多。項羽屢次攻奪甬道，漢軍缺糧，項羽遂圍漢王於滎陽。漢軍糧盡，夜間放出披甲女子二千餘人出東門，楚軍四面圍擊；將軍紀信乘漢王車駕詐降，楚軍皆呼萬歲、湧往城東觀看，漢王乘機與數十騎從西門逃出。其後項羽擊走彭越，回師攻拔滎陽，殺周苛、樅公，俘韓王信，進圍成皋；漢王與滕公獨乘一車出成皋玉門，北渡黃河，奔至修武。
summary.en: The King of Han camped south of Xingyang, building a walled road to the Yellow River to draw on the Ao granary, and faced Xiang Yu for over a year. Xiang Yu kept cutting the road; Han ran short of food and Xiang Yu besieged the king in Xingyang. With the food gone, Han sent over two thousand women in armour out of the east gate by night and Chu fell on them; General Ji Xin rode out in the king's carriage pretending to surrender, the Chu troops cheered and crowded to the east side to watch, and the king slipped out of the west gate with a few dozen horsemen. Later, having beaten off Peng Yue, Xiang Yu came back, took Xingyang, executed Zhou Ke and Lord Cong, captured Xin, King of Han, and besieged Chenggao; the king escaped alone in a chariot with the Lord of Teng out of Chenggao's Jade Gate, crossed the river and rode to Xiuwu.

label.en: Han: Zhou Ke and Lord Cong killed (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 漢王軍滎陽南，筑甬道屬之河，以取敖倉。與項羽相距歲餘。項羽數侵奪漢甬道，漢軍乏食，遂圍漢王。
passages.textEn: The King of Han camped south of Xingyang and built a walled road to the Yellow River to draw on the granary at Ao. He faced Xiang Yu for over a year. Xiang Yu repeatedly cut the walled road; the Han army ran short of food, and he besieged the King of Han.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 漢軍絕食，乃夜出女子東門二千餘人，被甲，楚因四面擊之。將軍紀信乃乘王駕，詐為漢王，誑楚，楚皆呼萬歲，之城東觀，以故漢王得與數十騎出西門遁。
passages.textEn: With the food gone, the Han sent over two thousand women in armour out of the east gate by night, and Chu attacked them from all sides. General Ji Xin rode out in the king's carriage pretending to be the King of Han; the Chu troops cheered "Ten thousand years!" and went to the east side of the city to watch, so the King of Han slipped out of the west gate with a few dozen horsemen.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 項羽已破走彭越，聞漢王復軍成皋，乃復引兵西，拔滎陽，誅周苛、樅公，而虜韓王信，遂圍成皋。
passages.textEn: Xiang Yu, having beaten off Peng Yue, heard that the King of Han was back at Chenggao, came west again, took Xingyang, executed Zhou Ke and Lord Cong, captured Xin, King of Han, and besieged Chenggao.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 漢王跳，獨與滕公共車出成皋玉門，北渡河，馳宿修武。
passages.textEn: The King of Han escaped, alone in a chariot with the Lord of Teng, out of Chenggao's Jade Gate, crossed the Yellow River northward and rode to spend the night at Xiuwu.

label.zh: 筑甬道屬之河，以取敖倉
label.en: The walled road from the Ao granary

label.zh: 漢王得與數十騎出西門遁
label.en: The king slips out of Xingyang

label.zh: 出成皋玉門，北渡河，馳宿修武
label.en: Out of Chenggao, across the river to Xiuwu

label.zh: 項羽已破走彭越…復引兵西，拔滎陽
label.en: Xiang Yu back from fighting Peng Yue

names.name: The Si River and the stand-off at Guangwu

summary.zh: 項羽東擊彭越時，命大司馬曹咎謹守成皋。漢軍屢次挑戰，楚軍不出，漢使人辱罵五六日，曹咎大怒，引兵渡汜水；楚軍半渡，漢軍出擊，大破之，盡得楚國金玉財物，曹咎與長史司馬欣皆自刎於汜水上。此後楚漢久持不決，劉邦與項羽隔廣武澗對話，項羽伏弩射中劉邦胸口，劉邦捫足說「虜中吾指」以安軍心。
summary.en: When Xiang Yu went east against Peng Yue he told the Grand Marshal Cao Jiu to hold Chenggao and not to fight. Han challenged again and again; when Chu would not come out, Han had men insult it for five or six days until Cao Jiu lost his temper and crossed the Si River. With half his army across, Han attacked and crushed it, taking all of Chu's treasure, and Cao Jiu and Sima Xin cut their own throats on the bank. The stalemate dragged on; Liu Bang and Xiang Yu talked across the ravine at Guangwu, and a hidden Chu crossbow hit Liu Bang in the chest — he clutched his foot and said, "The barbarian has hit my toe!" to steady his men.

label.en: Chu: Cao Jiu and Sima Xin killed themselves (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 漢果數挑楚軍，楚軍不出，使人辱之五六日，大司馬怒，度兵汜水。士卒半渡，漢擊之，大破楚軍，盡得楚國金玉貨賂。大司馬咎、長史欣皆自剄汜水上。
passages.textEn: Han did challenge the Chu army again and again; it would not come out, so Han had men insult it for five or six days until the Grand Marshal lost his temper and took his army across the Si River. When half had crossed, Han attacked and crushed the Chu army, taking all of Chu's gold, jade and treasure. The Grand Marshal Jiu and the Chief Clerk Xin cut their own throats on the bank of the Si.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 漢王項羽相與臨廣武之閒而語。
passages.textEn: The King of Han and Xiang Yu faced each other across the ravine at Guangwu and talked.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 項羽大怒，伏弩射中漢王。漢王傷匈，乃捫足曰：「虜中吾指！」
passages.textEn: Xiang Yu, furious, had a hidden crossbow shoot the King of Han, who was hit in the chest but clutched his foot and said, "The barbarian has hit my toe!"

names.name: 濰水之戰（韓信破齊、斬龍且）
Battle of the Wei River (Han Xin takes Qi and kills Long Ju)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 漢王已派酈食其說降齊，韓信仍聽蒯通之計渡河，乘齊不備，襲破齊歷下軍，直抵臨菑。齊王田廣以為酈生出賣自己，將其烹殺，逃往高密，向楚求救。韓信東追至高密西，楚派龍且率號稱二十萬之眾救齊。兩軍夾濰水列陣，韓信連夜以萬餘囊盛沙堵塞上游，引軍半渡，攻龍且後佯敗退回；龍且以為韓信怯戰，率軍渡水追擊。韓信決開沙囊，大水驟至，龍且大半軍隊無法渡河，韓信急擊，斬龍且，水東楚軍潰散，田廣逃走。韓信追至城陽，盡俘楚卒；漢四年，齊地全部平定。
summary.en: The King of Han had already sent Li Yiji to talk Qi into submission, but on Kuai Tong's advice Han Xin crossed the Yellow River anyway, fell on the unready Qi army at Lixia and went straight on to Linzi. Tian Guang, King of Qi, thinking Li Yiji had betrayed him, boiled him alive, fled to Gaomi and sent to Chu for help. Han Xin pursued him to the west of Gaomi, and Chu sent Long Ju with an army called two hundred thousand. They drew up on either side of the Wei River. Han Xin had over ten thousand bags filled with sand overnight to dam the river upstream, led half his army across, attacked Long Ju and pretended to be beaten; Long Ju, sure Han Xin was a coward, followed him across. Han Xin had the dam broken, the flood came down, most of Long Ju's army could not cross, and Han Xin attacked at once and killed him; the Chu troops east of the river scattered and Tian Guang fled. Han Xin pursued to Chengyang and captured all the Chu soldiers, and in 203 BCE all Qi was pacified.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷九十二 淮陰侯列傳
passages.textZh: 信因襲齊歷下軍，遂至臨菑。齊王田廣以酈生賣己，乃亨之，而走髙密，使使之楚請救。韓信已定臨菑，遂東追廣至髙密西。楚亦使龍且將，號稱二十萬，救齊。
passages.textEn: Xin then fell on the Qi army at Lixia and went on to Linzi. Tian Guang, King of Qi, thinking Li Yiji had betrayed him, boiled him alive, fled to Gaomi and sent to Chu for help. With Linzi secured, Han Xin pursued Guang east to the west of Gaomi. Chu sent Long Ju with an army called two hundred thousand to save Qi.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷九十二 淮陰侯列傳
passages.textZh: 遂戰，與信夾濰水陳。韓信乃夜令人爲萬餘囊，滿盛沙，壅水上流，引軍半渡，擊龍且，詳不勝，還走。龍且果喜曰：『固知信怯也。』遂追信渡水。信使人決壅囊，水大至。龍且軍大半不得渡，即急擊，殺龍且。龍且水東軍散走，齊王廣亡去。信遂追北至城陽，皆虜楚卒。
passages.textEn: So they fought, drawn up on either side of the Wei River. Han Xin had over ten thousand bags filled with sand by night to dam the river upstream, led half his army across, attacked Long Ju, pretended to be beaten and fell back. Long Ju was delighted: "I always knew Xin was a coward." He followed Xin across. Xin had the dam of bags broken and the water came down in flood; most of Long Ju's army could not cross, and Xin attacked at once and killed Long Ju. Long Ju's men east of the river scattered, Tian Guang fled, and Xin pursued the beaten army to Chengyang, capturing all the Chu soldiers.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷九十二 淮陰侯列傳
passages.textZh: 漢四年，遂皆降平齊。
passages.textEn: In the fourth year of Han all of Qi surrendered and was pacified.

label.zh: 東追廣至髙密西；夾濰水陳
楚使龍且將，號稱二十萬，救齊
label.en: Long Ju comes to save Qi

label.zh: 信遂追北至城陽，皆虜楚卒

confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 鴻溝議和後項羽東歸，劉邦用張良、陳平之計背約追擊，約韓信、彭越會師擊楚。至固陵，韓信、彭越未至，楚軍回擊，大破漢軍，漢王退入營壘，深溝固守。其後用張良之計許以封地，韓信、彭越方率兵前來，終會戰於垓下。
summary.en: After the peace of the Hong Canal Xiang Yu went home east; on Zhang Liang's and Chen Ping's advice Liu Bang broke the treaty and pursued him, arranging to meet Han Xin and Peng Yue against Chu. At Guling they did not come; Chu turned and crushed the Han army, and the king went back behind his walls and deep ditches. Only when Zhang Liang's plan promised them land did Han Xin and Peng Yue come, and the armies met at last at Gaixia.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八 高祖本紀
passages.textZh: 至固陵，不會。楚擊漢軍，大破之。漢王復入壁，深塹而守之。
passages.textEn: At Guling they did not join him. Chu attacked the Han army and crushed it; the King of Han went back behind his walls and held them with deep ditches.

label.zh: 進兵追項羽，至陽夏南止軍…至固陵

names.name: 高闕之戰（衛青夜襲右賢王）
Gaoque (Wei Qing's night attack on the Worthy King of the Right)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 元朔五年春，車騎將軍衛青率三萬騎出高闕，蘇建、李沮、公孫賀、李蔡等將皆屬衛青，出朔方。匈奴右賢王以為漢軍不能至此，飲酒大醉；漢軍夜至，包圍右賢王，右賢王驚醒，只帶一名愛妾和數百壯騎突圍北逃。漢軍輕騎校尉郭成等追擊數百里未及，俘右賢王裨王十餘人、男女一萬五千餘人、牲畜數百萬。軍還至塞，武帝即在軍中拜衛青為大將軍，諸將皆歸其統屬。右賢王庭所在，史未明記。
summary.en: In the spring of 124 BCE Wei Qing, General of Chariots and Cavalry, led thirty thousand horse out through Gaoque, with Su Jian, Li Ju, Gongsun He, Li Cai and others under him out from Shuofang. The Worthy King of the Right, thinking the Han army could not reach him, was drunk; the Han army arrived by night and surrounded him, and he fled north with one concubine and a few hundred horsemen. Han's light cavalry chased him several hundred li without catching him but took over ten of his lesser kings, fifteen thousand men and women and livestock in the millions. At the frontier the emperor made Wei Qing Grand General there in the camp, with all the generals under him. The sources do not say where the king's camp was.

label.zh: 匈奴右賢王，潰圍北去（敗）
label.en: Xiongnu: the Worthy King of the Right, fled north (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十一 衛將軍驃騎列傳
passages.textZh: 其明年，元朔之五年春，漢令車騎將軍青將三萬騎，出高闕；
passages.textEn: The next year, in the spring of the fifth year of Yuanshuo, Han sent Wei Qing, General of Chariots and Cavalry, with thirty thousand horse out through Gaoque;

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十一 衛將軍驃騎列傳
passages.textZh: 匈奴右賢王當衛青等兵，以為漢兵不能至此，飲醉。漢兵夜至，圍右賢王，右賢王驚，夜逃，獨與其愛妾一人壯騎數百馳，潰圍北去。漢輕騎校尉郭成等逐數百里，不及，得右賢裨王十餘人，眾男女萬五千餘人，畜數千百萬，於是引兵而還。
passages.textEn: The Worthy King of the Right of the Xiongnu, facing Wei Qing and the others, thought the Han army could not reach him and was drunk. The Han army arrived by night and surrounded him; startled, he fled in the night with only a favourite concubine and a few hundred strong horsemen, broke through and rode north. Han's light cavalry colonel Guo Cheng and others chased him several hundred li without catching him, but took over ten of his lesser kings, more than fifteen thousand men and women and livestock in the millions, and the army came home.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十一 衛將軍驃騎列傳
passages.textZh: 至塞，天子使使者持大將軍印，即軍中拜車騎將軍青為大將軍，諸將皆以兵屬大將軍，大將軍立號而歸。
passages.textEn: At the frontier the emperor sent an envoy with the seal of Grand General and made Wei Qing Grand General there in the camp; all the generals put their troops under him, and he came home with the title.

label.zh: 車騎將軍青將三萬騎，出高闕
漢兵夜至，圍右賢王（所在未詳）

names.name: The campaigns south of the desert (Huo Qubing's first battle)

summary.zh: 元朔六年春，大將軍衛青率公孫敖、公孫賀、趙信、蘇建、李廣、李沮等出定襄，斬首數千級而還；月餘再出定襄，斬首虜萬餘人。右將軍蘇建、前將軍趙信合軍三千餘騎單獨遭遇單于主力，苦戰一日餘，漢兵幾盡；趙信本是匈奴人，率餘騎八百投降單于，蘇建全軍覆沒，隻身逃回。同年，衛青外甥、十八歲的霍去病任剽姚校尉，率輕勇騎八百脫離大軍數百里直趨敵處，斬首虜二千零二十八級，斬單于祖父輩的籍若侯產，生擒單于叔父羅姑比，以功封冠軍侯。戰地史未明記。
summary.en: In the spring of 123 BCE the Grand General Wei Qing went out from Dingxiang with Gongsun Ao, Gongsun He, Zhao Xin, Su Jian, Li Guang and Li Ju, took several thousand heads and came back; a month later they went out again and took over ten thousand heads and captives. Su Jian and Zhao Xin, with three thousand horse between them, ran into the chanyu's main army alone and fought for over a day until their men were nearly all gone; Zhao Xin, a Xiongnu by birth, went over to the chanyu with his last eight hundred, and Su Jian escaped alone. That year Wei Qing's eighteen-year-old nephew Huo Qubing, as Colonel of Swift Cavalry, left the main army with eight hundred light horsemen and rode several hundred li straight at the enemy, taking 2,028 heads and captives, beheading the chanyu's grand-uncle and capturing his uncle; he was made Marquis Guanjun. The sources do not say where the battles were fought.

label.zh: 漢：斬獲甚眾，然失二將軍
label.en: Han: many killed and taken, but two generals' armies lost
Colonel of Swift Cavalry, first battle (victor)

label.zh: 匈奴：單于擊滅蘇建、趙信軍
label.en: Xiongnu: the chanyu destroyed Su Jian's and Zhao Xin's army

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十一 衛將軍驃騎列傳
passages.textZh: 其明年春，大將軍青出定襄，合騎侯敖為中將軍，太僕賀為左將軍，翕侯趙信為前將軍，衛尉蘇建為右將軍，郎中令李廣為後將軍，右內史李沮為彊弩將軍，咸屬大將軍，斬首數千級而還。月餘，悉復出定襄擊匈奴，斬首虜萬餘人。
passages.textEn: The next spring the Grand General Wei Qing went out from Dingxiang with Gongsun Ao, Gongsun He, Zhao Xin, Su Jian, Li Guang and Li Ju all under him, took several thousand heads and came back. A month later they all went out from Dingxiang again against the Xiongnu and took over ten thousand heads and captives.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十一 衛將軍驃騎列傳
passages.textZh: 右將軍建、前將軍信并軍三千餘騎，獨逢單于兵，與戰一日餘，漢兵且盡。前將軍故胡人，降為翕侯，見急，匈奴誘之，遂將其餘騎可八百，奔降單于。右將軍蘇建盡亡其軍，獨以身得亡去，自歸大將軍。
passages.textEn: Su Jian, General of the Right, and Zhao Xin, General of the Van, with their combined three thousand horse, met the chanyu's army alone and fought it for more than a day until the Han troops were nearly all gone. Zhao Xin, a Hu by birth who had surrendered and been made Marquis of Xi, was tempted by the Xiongnu in his straits and went over to the chanyu with his remaining eight hundred horse. Su Jian lost his whole army and escaped alone back to the Grand General.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十一 衛將軍驃騎列傳
passages.textZh: 是歲也，大將軍姊子霍去病年十八，幸，為天子侍中。善騎射，再從大將軍，受詔與壯士，為剽姚校尉，與輕勇騎八百直棄大軍數百里赴利，斬捕首虜過當。
passages.textEn: That year the Grand General's nephew Huo Qubing, aged eighteen, a favourite and Palace Attendant to the emperor, a fine horseman and archer, went out twice with the Grand General. Given a band of strong men and made Colonel of Swift Cavalry, he left the main army with eight hundred light, bold horsemen, rode several hundred li straight at the enemy, and took more heads and captives than he lost.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十一 衛將軍驃騎列傳
passages.textZh: 剽姚校尉去病斬首虜二千二十八級，及相國、當戶，斬單于大父行籍若侯產，生捕季父羅姑比，再冠軍，以千六百戶封去病為冠軍侯。
passages.textEn: "The Colonel of Swift Cavalry Qubing took two thousand and twenty-eight heads and captives, including a chancellor and a danghu, beheaded the chanyu's grand-uncle, the Marquis Ji Ruo, and took alive his uncle Luo Gubi; twice first in the army, he is made Marquis Guanjun with sixteen hundred households."

names.name: 渾邪王降漢（霍去病渡河受降）
The Hunye King goes over to Han

summary.zh: 元狩二年秋，單于怒渾邪王在西方屢被霍去病所破、損失數萬人，欲召而誅之。渾邪王與休屠王等謀降漢，先遣人至邊塞約降。武帝恐其詐降襲邊，命霍去病領兵往迎。霍去病渡過黃河，與渾邪王部眾相望，渾邪王部下裨將多不願降而逃散；霍去病馳入渾邪王營中相見，斬欲逃者八千人，遣渾邪王先赴行在，盡率其眾渡河，降者數萬，號稱十萬。河西自此歸漢。
summary.en: In the autumn of 121 BCE the chanyu, angry that the Hunye King in the west had been beaten again and again by Huo Qubing and had lost tens of thousands of men, meant to summon and execute him. The Hunye King and the Xiutu King plotted to go over to Han and sent word to the frontier. Fearing a trick, the emperor sent Huo Qubing with an army to receive them. Across the Yellow River, in sight of the Hunye King's people, many of his commanders began to slip away; Huo Qubing rode into the camp to meet the king, beheaded eight thousand who tried to flee, sent the king ahead to the emperor, and brought all his people across the river, several tens of thousands, called a hundred thousand. The Hexi corridor passed to Han.

label.zh: 匈奴：渾邪王、休屠王部降漢（敗）
label.en: Xiongnu: the Hunye and Xiutu kings' people went over to Han (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十一 衛將軍驃騎列傳
passages.textZh: 其秋，單于怒渾邪王居西方數為漢所破，亡數萬人，以驃騎之兵也。單于怒，欲召誅渾邪王。渾邪王與休屠王等謀欲降漢，使人先要邊。
passages.textEn: That autumn the chanyu was angry that the Hunye King in the west had been beaten again and again by Han and had lost tens of thousands of men, all to the General of Swift Cavalry, and meant to summon and execute him. The Hunye King plotted with the Xiutu King and others to go over to Han and sent word ahead to the frontier.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十一 衛將軍驃騎列傳
passages.textZh: 驃騎既渡河，與渾邪王眾相望。渾邪王裨將見漢軍而多欲不降者，頗遁去。驃騎乃馳入與渾邪王相見，斬其欲亡者八千人，遂獨遣渾邪王乘傳先詣行在所，盡將其眾渡河，降者數萬，號稱十萬。
passages.textEn: The General of Swift Cavalry crossed the Yellow River and came in sight of the Hunye King's people. Many of the king's lesser commanders, seeing the Han army, did not want to surrender and began to slip away. Huo Qubing rode in to meet the king, beheaded eight thousand who were trying to flee, sent the king ahead alone by post to the emperor, and brought all his people across the river: several tens of thousands surrendered, called a hundred thousand.

summary.zh: 漢太尉，平定吳楚七國之亂。會兵滎陽後東北屯昌邑，深壁不救梁，遣輕騎斷吳楚糧道；吳軍飢疲夜襲，被擊退後大破之，前後三月而吳楚平。
summary.en: Grand Commandant of Han who put down the rising of the Seven States. From Xingyang he went north-east to Changyi and dug in, refusing to relieve Liang, while light cavalry cut the Wu and Chu supply line; when the starving Wu army attacked by night he beat it off and then crushed it, ending the rising in three months.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷五十七 絳侯周勃世家
passages.textZh: 太尉既會兵滎陽，吳方攻梁，梁急，請救。太尉引兵東北走昌邑，深壁而守。
passages.textEn: The Grand Commandant had gathered his troops at Xingyang when Wu was attacking Liang; Liang, hard pressed, asked for help, but he led his army north-east to Changyi and dug in behind high walls.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷五十七 絳侯周勃世家
passages.textZh: 太尉不奉詔，堅壁不出，而使輕騎兵弓高侯等絕吳楚兵後食道。
passages.textEn: The Grand Commandant would not obey the order but kept behind his walls, and sent light cavalry under the Marquis of Gonggao to cut the Wu and Chu armies' supply line behind them.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷五十七 絳侯周勃世家
passages.textZh: 凡相攻守三月，而吳楚破平。
passages.textEn: In all the fighting lasted three months before Wu and Chu were broken and pacified.

summary.zh: 吳王，七國之亂首謀。渡淮西進，破梁軍於棘壁，因梁堅守轉攻周亞夫，於下邑大敗，率數千人渡江走丹徒投東越，被東越所殺。
summary.en: King of Wu and leader of the rising of the Seven States. He crossed the Huai and beat the Liang army at Jibi, then turned on Zhou Yafu when Liang held out; crushed at Xiayi, he fled across the Yangzi to Dantu and the Dong Yue, who killed him.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百六 吳王濞列傳
passages.textZh: 初，吳王之度淮，與楚王遂西敗棘壁，乘勝前，銳甚。梁孝王恐，遣六將軍擊吳，又敗梁兩將，士卒皆還走梁。
passages.textEn: At first, when the King of Wu crossed the Huai, he and the King of Chu went west and won at Jibi; pressing on with their victory, they were very strong. King Xiao of Liang, alarmed, sent six generals against Wu, but Wu beat two of them and their men all fled back to Liang.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百六 吳王濞列傳
passages.textZh: 吳兵欲西，梁城守堅，不敢西，即走條侯軍，會下邑。欲戰，條侯壁，不肯戰。吳糧絕，卒饑，數挑戰，遂夜奔條侯壁，驚東南。條侯使備西北，果從西北入。吳大敗，士卒多饑死，乃畔散。於是吳王乃與其麾下壯士數千人夜亡去，度江走丹徒，保東越。
passages.textEn: Wu wanted to go west, but Liang held its walls so firmly that Wu dared not, and turned on the Marquis of Tiao's army instead, meeting it at Xiayi. Wu wanted battle, but the Marquis stayed behind his walls. Wu's food ran out and its men starved; after many challenges it rushed the Marquis's walls by night, feinting at the south-east corner. The Marquis had the north-west guarded, and that is where they came in. Wu was crushed; many of its men died of hunger and the rest scattered. The King of Wu fled by night with a few thousand of his guard, crossed the Yangzi to Dantu and took refuge with Dong Yue.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百六 吳王濞列傳
passages.textZh: 漢使人以利啗東越，東越即紿吳王，吳王出勞軍，即使人鏦殺吳王，盛其頭，馳傳以聞。
passages.textEn: Han bribed Dong Yue, which tricked the King of Wu: when he came out to review its troops, they speared him to death and sent his head by post to the emperor.

summary.zh: 趙佗所建之國，都番禺。漢分數路來伐，樓船將軍楊僕、伏波將軍路博德會攻番禺，城降，呂嘉、建德逃海被擒；南越平，分為九郡。
summary.en: The kingdom founded by Zhao Tuo, with its capital at Panyu. Han attacked by several routes; Yang Pu and Lu Bode took Panyu together, Lü Jia and Jiande fled by sea and were caught, and Nanyue was divided into nine commanderies.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十三 南越列傳
passages.textZh: 元鼎五年秋，衛尉路博德為伏波將軍，出桂陽，下匯水；主爵都尉楊仆為樓船將軍，出豫章，下橫浦；故歸義越侯二人為戈船、下厲將軍，出零陵，或下離水，或柢蒼梧；使馳義侯因巴蜀罪人，發夜郎兵，下牂柯江：咸會番禺。
passages.textEn: In the autumn of the fifth year of Yuanding Lu Bode, Commandant of the Guard, was made General Who Calms the Waves and sent out from Guiyang down the Hui River; Yang Pu was made General of the Towered Ships and sent out from Yuzhang down by Hengpu; two Yue marquises who had come over to Han were made generals and sent out from Lingling, one down the Li River and one towards Cangwu; and the Marquis of Chiyi raised convicts of Ba and Shu and the troops of Yelang to come down the Zangke River. All were to meet at Panyu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十三 南越列傳
passages.textZh: 犁旦，城中皆降伏波。呂嘉、建德已夜與其屬數百人亡入海，以船西去。
passages.textEn: At dawn the whole city surrendered to Lu Bode. Lü Jia and Jiande had fled by night with a few hundred followers to the sea and sailed west.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十三 南越列傳
passages.textZh: 戈船、下厲將軍兵及馳義侯所發夜郎兵未下，南越已平矣。遂為九郡。
passages.textEn: Before the two Yue generals' troops or the Yelang troops raised by the Marquis of Chiyi had come down, Nanyue was already pacified. It was made into nine commanderies.

summary.zh: 衛滿所建之國，都王險。漢遣楊僕自齊浮海、荀彘出遼東來伐，右渠據城堅守數月；元封三年尼谿相參殺右渠降漢。
summary.en: The kingdom founded by Wiman, with its capital at Wanggeom. Han sent Yang Pu by sea from Qi and Xun Zhi out of Liaodong; Ugeo held the city for months until in 108 BCE the chancellor Sam had him killed and went over to Han.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十五 朝鮮列傳
passages.textZh: 天子募罪人擊朝鮮。其秋，遣樓船將軍楊仆從齊浮渤海；兵五萬人，左將軍荀彘出遼東：討右渠。
passages.textEn: The emperor raised convicts to attack Joseon. That autumn he sent Yang Pu, General of the Towered Ships, across the Bohai from Qi, and Xun Zhi, General of the Left, with fifty thousand men out from Liaodong, against Ugeo.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十五 朝鮮列傳
passages.textZh: 左將軍破浿水上軍，乃前，至城下，圍其西北。樓船亦往會，居城南。右渠遂堅守城，數月未能下。
passages.textEn: The General of the Left broke the army on the Pae River and came up to the city, besieging its north-west side; the General of the Towered Ships joined him on the south. Ugeo held the city firmly, and it did not fall for months.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十五 朝鮮列傳
passages.textZh: 元封三年夏，尼谿相參乃使人殺朝鮮王右渠來降。
passages.textEn: In the summer of the third year of Yuanfeng the chancellor of Nigye, Sam, had Ugeo, King of Joseon, killed and came over.

summary.zh: 後燕主慕容垂之子。率軍寇五原，燒船夜遁，於參合陂被北魏大破；即位後北魏大舉來伐，并州失守，栢肆夜襲魏營大敗，棄中山北走。
summary.en: Son of Murong Chui of Later Yan. He raided Wuyuan, burned his boats and fled by night, and was crushed by Northern Wei at Canhe Bei; after he came to the throne Wei invaded in force, Bing was lost, his night attack at Baisi failed, and he abandoned Zhongshan and fled north.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 秋七月，慕容垂遣其子寶來寇五原，造舟收穀。
passages.textEn: In the seventh month, in autumn, Murong Chui sent his son Bao to raid Wuyuan, where he built boats and gathered the grain.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 冬十月辛未，寶燒船夜遁。
passages.textEn: On xinwei of the tenth month, in winter, Bao burned his boats and slipped away by night.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 丁丑，軍于鉅鹿之栢肆塢，臨呼沱水。其夜，寶悉眾犯營，燎及行宮，兵人駭散。帝驚起，不及衣冠，跣出擊鼓。俄而左右及中軍將士，稍稍來集。帝設奇陳，列烽營外，縱騎衝之，寶眾大敗，斬首萬餘級，擒其將軍高長等四千餘人。
passages.textEn: On dingchou he camped at the Baisi stockade in Julu by the Hutuo River. That night Bao threw his whole army at the camp; the fires reached the emperor's own tent and his men scattered in fright. The emperor sprang up and, without dressing, ran out barefoot to beat the drum. Soon his guards and the central army came together; he formed a surprise array, lit beacons outside the camp and loosed his cavalry, and Bao's army was crushed, over ten thousand beheaded and his general Gao Chang and more than four thousand captured.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 寶見賀麟走，恐先據和龍，壬子夜，遂將其妻子及兄弟宗族數千騎北遁。
passages.textEn: Seeing Helin go, Bao feared he would seize Helong first, and on the night of renzi fled north with his wife and children and several thousand horsemen of his clan.

summary.zh: 夏主。劉裕滅後秦東歸後，遣子赫連璝率騎南伐長安，斷青泥、屯潼關；劉義真東撤，長安百姓逐朱齡石，迎勃勃入城；夏軍追敗晉軍，於青泥俘傅弘之等。
summary.en: Ruler of Xia. When Liu Yu went home after destroying Later Qin, he sent his son Gui south against Chang'an, cutting the road at Qingni and holding the Tong Pass; as Liu Yizhen withdrew east, the people of Chang'an drove out Zhu Lingshi and welcomed Bobo in, and the Xia army routed the Jin army and captured Fu Hongzhi and others at Qingni.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百三十 赫連勃勃載記
passages.textZh: 勃勃善之，以子璝都督前鋒諸軍事，領撫軍大將軍，率騎二萬南伐長安，前將軍赫連昌屯兵潼關，以買德為撫軍右長史，南斷青泥，勃勃率大軍繼發。
passages.textEn: Bobo approved, and sent his son Gui as commander of the vanguard with twenty thousand horse south against Chang'an, with Helian Chang camped at the Tong Pass and Wang Maide sent south to cut the road at Qingni, while Bobo followed with the main army.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百三十 赫連勃勃載記
passages.textZh: 劉裕聞之，大懼，乃召義真東鎮洛陽，以硃齡石為雍州刺史，守長安。義真大掠而東，至於灞上，百姓遂逐齡石，而迎勃勃入于長安。璝率眾三萬追擊義真，王師敗績，義真單馬而遁。
passages.textEn: Hearing of it, Liu Yu took fright, recalled Yizhen to Luoyang and made Zhu Lingshi governor of Yong to hold Chang'an. Yizhen plundered as he went east; when he reached Bashang the people drove Zhu Lingshi out and welcomed Bobo into Chang'an. Gui pursued Yizhen with thirty thousand; the royal army was routed, and Yizhen escaped alone on his horse.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百三十 赫連勃勃載記
passages.textZh: 買德獲晉甯朔將軍傅弘之、輔國將軍蒯恩、義真司馬毛脩之於青泥，積人頭以為京觀。
passages.textEn: At Qingni Wang Maide captured the Jin generals Fu Hongzhi and Kuai En and Yizhen's adjutant Mao Xiuzhi, and piled up the heads into a mound.

summary.zh: 爾朱榮從子。與天光、度律、仲遠合兵號二十萬會於鄴，於韓陵為高歡所大敗，奔幷州。
summary.en: Nephew of Erzhu Rong. With Tianguang, Dulü and Zhongyuan he gathered an army called two hundred thousand at Ye, was routed by Gao Huan at Hanling, and fled to Bing.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Northern Qi (Li Baiyao, 636)
passages.locator: 卷一 神武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 閏三月，尒朱天光自長安、兆自幷州、度律自洛陽、仲遠自東郡同會鄴，衆號二十萬，挾洹水而軍，節閔以長孫承業為大行臺總督焉。神武令封隆之守鄴，自出頓紫陌。時馬不滿二千，步兵不至三萬，衆寡不敵。乃於韓陵為圓陣，連牛驢以塞歸道，於是將士皆有死志，四面赴擊之。
passages.textEn: In the intercalary third month Erzhu Tianguang came from Chang'an, Zhao from Bing, Dulü from Luoyang and Zhongyuan from Dong commandery to meet at Ye, an army called two hundred thousand, encamped on both banks of the Huan River. Shenwu left Feng Longzhi to hold Ye and camped himself at Zimo. He had fewer than two thousand horse and under thirty thousand foot, far outnumbered. At Hanling he formed a circular array and chained oxen and donkeys across the way back, so that every man was ready to die, and they attacked on all sides.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Northern Qi (Li Baiyao, 636)
passages.locator: 卷一 神武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 四月，斛斯椿執天光、度律送洛陽。長孫承業遣都督賈顯智、張歡入洛陽，執世隆、彥伯斬之。兆奔幷州。仲遠奔梁州，遂死焉。
passages.textEn: In the fourth month Husi Chun seized Tianguang and Dulü and sent them to Luoyang; Zhangsun Chengye sent Jia Xianzhi and Zhang Huan into Luoyang to seize Shilong and Yanbo and behead them. Zhao fled to Bing, and Zhongyuan fled to Liang Province, where he died.

summary.zh: 梁元帝，即位於江陵。西魏遣于謹、宇文護、楊忠等率步騎五萬來伐，攻克江陵，元帝被擒殺，百官士民被虜為奴婢十餘萬。
summary.en: Emperor Yuan of Liang, who reigned at Jiangling. Western Wei sent Yu Jin, Yuwen Hu, Yang Zhong and others with fifty thousand men; they took Jiangling, captured and killed him, and carried off over a hundred thousand of his officials and people as slaves.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Zhou (Linghu Defen et al., 636)
passages.locator: 卷二 文帝紀下
passages.textZh: 冬十月壬戌，遣柱國于謹、中山公護、大將軍楊忠、韋孝寬等步騎五萬討之。
passages.textEn: On renxu of the tenth month, in winter, he sent Yu Jin, Yuwen Hu, Yang Zhong, Wei Xiaokuan and others with fifty thousand foot and horse against him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Zhou (Linghu Defen et al., 636)
passages.locator: 卷二 文帝紀下
passages.textZh: 十一月癸未，師濟於漢。中山公護與楊忠率銳騎先屯其城下，據江津以備其逸。丙申，謹至江陵，列營圍守。辛亥，進攻城，其日克之。擒梁元帝，殺之，并虜其百官及士民以歸。沒為奴婢者十餘萬，其免者二百餘家。立蕭詧為梁主，居江陵，為魏附庸。
passages.textEn: On guiwei of the eleventh month the army crossed the Han. Yuwen Hu and Yang Zhong went ahead with picked horse to camp below the city and hold the river crossings against escape. On bingshen Yu Jin reached Jiangling and ringed it with camps. On xinhai he stormed it and took it the same day, captured Emperor Yuan of Liang and killed him, and carried off his officials, gentry and people; over a hundred thousand were made slaves and only some two hundred families spared. Xiao Cha was made ruler of Liang at Jiangling, a dependency of Wei.

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 雁門馬邑豪強聶翁壹詐降匈奴，謊稱可斬馬邑令丞獻城，並以死囚之頭懸於城上取信；單于率十餘萬騎入武州塞。漢軍伏兵於馬邑旁山谷，以韓安國為護軍將軍統領諸將，約單于入城後縱兵。單于距馬邑百餘里，見牲畜遍野而無人放牧，起疑，攻下烽燧，擒得武州尉史，得知漢軍埋伏，引兵退出塞外。漢軍追之不及；王恢所部三萬人本應截擊輜重，見單于退兵而不敢出擊。此後匈奴斷絕和親，屢屢入塞侵擾。（伏兵人數與王恢之死，二傳記載不同。）
summary.en: Nie Wengyi, a strongman of Mayi, pretended to go over to the Xiongnu, promising to kill the officials of Mayi and hand over the city, and hung a condemned man's head on the wall as proof; the chanyu came in by the Wuzhou wall with over a hundred thousand horse. Han lay in wait in the valleys around Mayi under Han Anguo, to strike once the chanyu was inside. Still over a hundred li away, the chanyu saw herds everywhere and no herdsmen, grew suspicious, took a beacon post and its clerk, learned of the ambush and withdrew. Han pursued too late, and Wang Hui's thirty thousand, meant to fall on the baggage, dared not attack. From then on the Xiongnu broke off the marriage peace and raided the frontier again and again. (The two biographies differ on the size of the ambush and on how Wang Hui died.)

label.en: Han: the ambush came to nothing (defeated)
Xiongnu chanyu: saw through it and withdrew

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百八 韓長孺列傳
passages.textZh: 聶翁壹乃還，詐斬死罪囚，縣其頭馬邑城，示單于使者爲信。曰：「馬邑長吏已死，可急來。」於是單于穿塞將十餘萬騎，入武州塞。
passages.textEn: Nie Wengyi came back, beheaded a condemned prisoner as a fake and hung the head on the wall of Mayi to show the chanyu's envoy, saying, "The officials of Mayi are dead; come quickly." The chanyu then broke through the frontier with over a hundred thousand horse and came in by the Wuzhou wall.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百八 韓長孺列傳
passages.textZh: 當是時，漢伏兵車騎材官二十餘萬，匿馬邑旁谷中。
passages.textEn: At this time Han had over two hundred thousand chariots, cavalry and infantry hidden in the valleys around Mayi.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百八 韓長孺列傳
passages.textZh: 未至馬邑百餘里，行掠鹵，徒見畜牧於野，不見一人。單于怪之，攻烽燧，得武州尉史。欲刺問尉史。尉史曰：「漢兵數十萬伏馬邑下。」單于顧謂左右曰：「幾爲漢所賣！」乃引兵還。
passages.textEn: Still over a hundred li from Mayi, plundering as he went, he saw only herds in the fields and not a single person. Suspicious, he attacked a beacon post and took a frontier clerk of Wuzhou, and was about to stab him to question him when the clerk said, "Several hundred thousand Han troops are lying in wait at Mayi." The chanyu turned to his men and said, "Han nearly sold us!" and led his army back.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十 匈奴列傳
passages.textZh: 漢伏兵三十餘萬馬邑旁，御史大夫韓安國爲護軍，護四將軍以伏單于。
passages.textEn: Han lay in wait near Mayi with over three hundred thousand troops, with the Imperial Counsellor Han Anguo as Protector of the Army over four generals, to ambush the chanyu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十 匈奴列傳
passages.textZh: 漢以恢本造兵謀而不進，斬恢。自是之後，匈奴絕和親，攻當路塞，往往入盜於漢邊，不可勝數。
passages.textEn: Because Wang Hui had devised the plan and then not advanced, Han beheaded him. From then on the Xiongnu broke off the marriage peace, attacked the frontier posts on the roads, and raided the Han border more times than can be counted.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百八 韓長孺列傳
passages.textZh: 於是恢聞之，乃自殺。
passages.textEn: When Wang Hui heard this he killed himself.

label.zh: 單于穿塞將十餘萬騎，入武州塞
label.en: The chanyu comes in by the Wuzhou wall

question.en: How large was the ambush at Mayi?

claim.zh: 二十餘萬。
claim.en: Over two hundred thousand.

source.en: 史記, 卷一百八 韓長孺列傳

accounts.quoteZh: 漢伏兵車騎材官二十餘萬

claim.zh: 三十餘萬。
claim.en: Over three hundred thousand.

source.en: 史記, 卷一百十 匈奴列傳

accounts.quoteZh: 漢伏兵三十餘萬馬邑旁

question.en: How did Wang Hui die?

claim.zh: 下廷尉，聞武帝不赦，自殺。
claim.en: Sent to the Commandant of Justice; told the emperor would not spare him, he killed himself.

source.en: 史記, 卷一百八 韓長孺列傳

accounts.quoteZh: 於是恢聞之，乃自殺。

claim.zh: 漢以其造謀不進而斬之。
claim.en: Han beheaded him for devising the plan and not advancing.

source.en: 史記, 卷一百十 匈奴列傳

accounts.quoteZh: 漢以恢本造兵謀而不進，斬恢。

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 登國十年七月，後燕主慕容垂遣太子慕容寶來寇五原，造船收穀。九月北魏道武帝進兵，臨河築臺，旌旗沿河東西千餘里，並分遣元虔、元儀、元遵斷其歸路。十月慕容寶燒船夜遁；十一月道武帝渡河急追，乙酉夜至參合陂，丙戌大破燕軍，生擒陳留王慕容紹等王公以下文武將吏數千人，繳獲器甲輜重十餘萬計。
summary.en: In the seventh month of 395 Murong Chui of Later Yan sent his heir Murong Bao to raid Wuyuan, where he built boats and gathered the grain. In the ninth month Emperor Daowu of Northern Wei came up, built a platform by the Yellow River and lined its bank with banners for a thousand li, sending Yuan Qian, Yuan Yi and Yuan Zun to cut off the way home. In the tenth month Bao burned his boats and slipped away; in the eleventh Daowu crossed the river after him, reached Canhe Bei on the evening of yiyou and on bingxu crushed the Yan army, taking alive the Prince of Chenliu and thousands of princes, officers and officials, with arms, armour and stores counted in the hundreds of thousands.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 秋七月，慕容垂遣其子寶來寇五原，造舟收穀。
passages.textEn: In the seventh month, in autumn, Murong Chui sent his son Bao to raid Wuyuan, where he built boats and gathered the grain.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 九月，進師，臨河築臺告津，連旌沿河東西千里有餘。
passages.textEn: In the ninth month the army advanced, built a platform by the Yellow River to mark the crossing, and its banners stretched over a thousand li along the river from east to west.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 冬十月辛未，寶燒船夜遁。
passages.textEn: On xinwei of the tenth month, in winter, Bao burned his boats and slipped away by night.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 十一月己卯，帝進軍濟河。乙酉夕，至參合陂。丙戌，大破之。
passages.textEn: On jimao of the eleventh month the emperor crossed the Yellow River. On the evening of yiyou he reached Canhe Bei, and on bingxu crushed the enemy.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 生擒其陳留王紹、魯陽王倭奴、桂林王道成、濟陰公尹國、北地王世子鍾葵、安定王世子羊兒以下文武將吏數千人，器甲輜重、軍資雜財十餘萬計。
passages.textEn: He took alive Shao, Prince of Chenliu, Wonu, Prince of Luyang, Daocheng, Prince of Guilin, Yin Guo, Duke of Jiyin, the heirs of the Princes of Beidi and Anding, and thousands of officers and officials, with arms, armour, baggage and stores counted in the hundreds of thousands.

label.en: Murong Bao burns his boats and flees

label.zh: 帝進軍濟河。乙酉夕，至參合陂
label.en: Daowu crosses the river to Canhe Bei

names.name: 北魏取并州、中山、鄴（栢肆之戰）
Northern Wei takes Bing, Zhongshan and Ye (Baisi)

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 皇始元年八月，道武帝親率六軍四十餘萬，南出馬邑，越句注，旌旗綿延二千餘里。九月兵臨晉陽，後燕并州牧慕容農棄城東逃，并州平。十月出井陘，十一月至真定，常山以東守宰或棄城或歸降，唯中山、鄴、信都不下。次年二月魏軍屯栢肆塢，慕容寶傾眾夜襲，火及行宮，道武帝赤足擊鼓收兵，設奇陣反擊，燕軍大敗，斬首萬餘級。三月慕容寶棄中山北逃；十月魏軍於義臺塢大破慕容麟，中山平。天興元年正月慕容德走保滑臺，元儀攻克鄴城。
summary.en: In the eighth month of 396 Daowu led the six armies himself, over four hundred thousand, south out of Mayi and over Gouzhu, his banners strung out for two thousand li. In the ninth month he came to Jinyang, and the Yan governor Murong Nong abandoned it and fled east. In the tenth he went out through Jingxing and in the eleventh reached Zhending; east of Changshan the governors fled or submitted, and only Zhongshan, Ye and Xindu held out. In the second month of 397, camped at the Baisi stockade, he was attacked at night by Murong Bao's whole army; with the fires at his own tent he ran out barefoot to beat the drum, rallied his men, formed a surprise array and crushed the Yan army, taking over ten thousand heads. In the third month Bao abandoned Zhongshan and fled north; in the tenth Wei crushed Murong Helin at the Yitai stockade and Zhongshan was pacified. In the first month of 398 Murong De fled to Huatai and Yuan Yi took Ye.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 己亥，大舉討慕容寶，帝親勒六軍四十餘萬，南出馬邑，踰于句注，旌旗駱驛二千餘里，鼓行而前，民屋皆震。
passages.textEn: On jihai he launched the great campaign against Murong Bao, leading the six armies himself, over four hundred thousand, south out of Mayi and over Gouzhu, his banners strung out for two thousand li, drums beating as they went, so that the houses shook.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 九月戊午，次陽曲，乘西山，臨觀晉陽，命諸將引騎圍脅，已而罷還。寶并州牧遼西王農大懼，將妻子棄城夜出，東遁，并州平。
passages.textEn: On wuwu of the ninth month he camped at Yangqu, climbed the western hills to look down on Jinyang and had his generals ride round it to threaten it, then withdrew. Bao's governor of Bing, Nong, Prince of Liaoxi, took fright, left the city by night with his wife and children and fled east, and Bing Province was pacified.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 冬十月乙酉，車駕出井陘，使冠軍將軍王建、左軍將軍李栗五萬騎先驅啟行。
passages.textEn: On yiyou of the tenth month, in winter, the emperor went out through Jingxing, with Wang Jian and Li Li leading fifty thousand horse ahead.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 十有一月庚子朔，帝至真定。自常山以東，守宰或捐城奔竄，或稽顙軍門，唯中山、鄴、信都三城不下。
passages.textEn: On gengzi, the first of the eleventh month, the emperor reached Zhending. East of Changshan the governors either abandoned their cities and fled or came to his camp to submit; only Zhongshan, Ye and Xindu held out.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 丁丑，軍于鉅鹿之栢肆塢，臨呼沱水。其夜，寶悉眾犯營，燎及行宮，兵人駭散。帝驚起，不及衣冠，跣出擊鼓。俄而左右及中軍將士，稍稍來集。帝設奇陳，列烽營外，縱騎衝之，寶眾大敗，斬首萬餘級，擒其將軍高長等四千餘人。
passages.textEn: On dingchou he camped at the Baisi stockade in Julu by the Hutuo River. That night Bao threw his whole army at the camp; the fires reached the emperor's own tent and his men scattered in fright. The emperor sprang up and, without dressing, ran out barefoot to beat the drum. Soon his guards and the central army came together; he formed a surprise array, lit beacons outside the camp and loosed his cavalry, and Bao's army was crushed, over ten thousand beheaded and his general Gao Chang and more than four thousand captured.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 寶見賀麟走，恐先據和龍，壬子夜，遂將其妻子及兄弟宗族數千騎北遁。
passages.textEn: Seeing Helin go, Bao feared he would seize Helong first, and on the night of renzi fled north with his wife and children and several thousand horsemen of his clan.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 甲戌，帝臨其營，戰於義臺塢，大破之，斬首九千餘級。賀麟單馬走西山，遂奔鄴，慕容德殺之。
passages.textEn: On jiaxu the emperor came to his camp and crushed him at the Yitai stockade, taking over nine thousand heads. Helin fled alone to the western hills and on to Ye, where Murong De killed him.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 天興元年春正月，慕容德走保滑臺，儀克鄴，收其倉庫。
passages.textEn: In the first month of the first year of Tianxing, in spring, Murong De fled to hold Huatai, and Yi took Ye and seized its stores.

label.zh: 次陽曲，臨觀晉陽；并州平

summary.zh: 天興五年五月，後秦主姚興遣其弟姚平率眾四萬來侵，攻陷平陽乾壁。北魏道武帝七月西征，八月至柴壁，姚平固守，魏軍圍之；姚興傾全國之兵來救。甲子，道武帝渡蒙坑迎擊，大破秦軍。十月姚平投水而死，餘眾三萬餘人被俘。
summary.en: In the fifth month of 402 Yao Xing of Later Qin sent his brother Yao Ping with forty thousand men to invade, and Ping took the Qianbi stronghold in Pingyang. Daowu marched west in the seventh month and reached Chaibi in the eighth; Ping held it and was besieged, and Yao Xing came to his relief with his whole army. On jiazi Daowu crossed the Mengkeng and met him head on, crushing the Qin army. In the tenth month Ping threw himself into the water, and over thirty thousand of his men were captured.

label.en: Later Qin: Yao Xing, Yao Ping (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 五月，姚興遣其弟安北將軍、義陽公平率眾四萬來侵，平陽乾壁為平所陷。
passages.textEn: In the fifth month Yao Xing sent his brother Ping with forty thousand men to invade, and Ping took the Qianbi stronghold in Pingyang.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 八月乙巳，至於柴壁，平固守，進軍圍之，姚興悉舉其眾來救。甲子，帝渡蒙坑，逆擊興軍，大破之。
passages.textEn: On yisi of the eighth month he reached Chaibi, which Ping held firmly; he besieged it, and Yao Xing came to its relief with his whole army. On jiazi the emperor crossed the Mengkeng and met Xing's army head on, crushing it.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Wei (Wei Shou, 554)
passages.locator: 卷二 太祖紀
passages.textZh: 冬十月，平赴水而死，俘其餘眾三萬餘人。
passages.textEn: In the tenth month, in winter, Ping threw himself into the water and died, and over thirty thousand of his men were captured.

label.en: Yao Xing comes to the rescue

names.name: 赫連勃勃取長安（青泥之戰）

confidenceNote.zh: 路線據史文所記地名示意，非實際行軍路線。
confidenceNote.en: The routes join the places the sources name; they are not the actual line of march.

summary.zh: 劉裕滅後秦後東歸，留其子劉義真鎮長安。赫連勃勃用王買德之策，以子赫連璝率騎二萬南伐長安，赫連昌屯兵潼關，王買德南斷青泥，勃勃率大軍繼發。劉裕大懼，召義真東鎮洛陽，以朱齡石守長安。義真大掠而東，至灞上，長安百姓驅逐朱齡石，迎勃勃入城。赫連璝率三萬人追擊義真，晉軍大敗，義真單騎逃脫；王買德在青泥俘獲傅弘之、蒯恩、毛脩之，積人頭為京觀。
summary.en: Liu Yu went home after destroying Later Qin, leaving his son Liu Yizhen at Chang'an. On Wang Maide's plan Helian Bobo sent his son Gui with twenty thousand horse south against Chang'an, Helian Chang to hold the Tong Pass and Wang Maide to cut the road at Qingni, and followed with the main army. Liu Yu, alarmed, recalled Yizhen to Luoyang and left Zhu Lingshi to hold Chang'an. Yizhen plundered as he went east; when he reached Bashang the people of Chang'an drove out Zhu Lingshi and welcomed Bobo in. Gui pursued Yizhen with thirty thousand; the Jin army was routed and Yizhen escaped alone, and at Qingni Wang Maide captured Fu Hongzhi, Kuai En and Mao Xiuzhi and piled the heads into a mound.

label.en: Eastern Jin: Liu Yizhen, Zhu Lingshi (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百三十 赫連勃勃載記
passages.textZh: 勃勃善之，以子璝都督前鋒諸軍事，領撫軍大將軍，率騎二萬南伐長安，前將軍赫連昌屯兵潼關，以買德為撫軍右長史，南斷青泥，勃勃率大軍繼發。
passages.textEn: Bobo approved, and sent his son Gui as commander of the vanguard with twenty thousand horse south against Chang'an, with Helian Chang camped at the Tong Pass and Wang Maide sent south to cut the road at Qingni, while Bobo followed with the main army.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百三十 赫連勃勃載記
passages.textZh: 劉裕聞之，大懼，乃召義真東鎮洛陽，以硃齡石為雍州刺史，守長安。義真大掠而東，至於灞上，百姓遂逐齡石，而迎勃勃入于長安。璝率眾三萬追擊義真，王師敗績，義真單馬而遁。
passages.textEn: Hearing of it, Liu Yu took fright, recalled Yizhen to Luoyang and made Zhu Lingshi governor of Yong to hold Chang'an. Yizhen plundered as he went east; when he reached Bashang the people drove Zhu Lingshi out and welcomed Bobo into Chang'an. Gui pursued Yizhen with thirty thousand; the royal army was routed, and Yizhen escaped alone on his horse.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷一百三十 赫連勃勃載記
passages.textZh: 買德獲晉甯朔將軍傅弘之、輔國將軍蒯恩、義真司馬毛脩之於青泥，積人頭以為京觀。
passages.textEn: At Qingni Wang Maide captured the Jin generals Fu Hongzhi and Kuai En and Yizhen's adjutant Mao Xiuzhi, and piled up the heads into a mound.

label.zh: 百姓逐齡石，迎勃勃入于長安
義真大掠而東，至於灞上
璝追擊義真，王師敗績；獲傅弘之等於青泥

summary.zh: 高歡起兵信都討爾朱氏，攻拔鄴城。永熙元年閏三月，爾朱天光自長安、爾朱兆自并州、爾朱度律自洛陽、爾朱仲遠自東郡會於鄴，號稱二十萬，夾洹水而軍。高歡命封隆之守鄴，自出屯紫陌；時馬不滿二千、步兵不到三萬，眾寡懸殊，乃於韓陵結圓陣，以牛驢連繫堵塞退路，將士皆抱必死之志，四面奮擊，大敗爾朱軍。四月斛斯椿執天光、度律送洛陽，爾朱世隆、彥伯被斬，兆奔并州，仲遠奔梁州而死，爾朱氏勢力瓦解。
summary.en: Gao Huan rose against the Erzhu at Xindu and took Ye. In the intercalary third month of 532 Erzhu Tianguang from Chang'an, Erzhu Zhao from Bing, Erzhu Dulü from Luoyang and Erzhu Zhongyuan from Dong commandery met at Ye with an army called two hundred thousand, encamped on both banks of the Huan. Gao Huan left Feng Longzhi to hold Ye and camped at Zimo with fewer than two thousand horse and under thirty thousand foot. At Hanling he formed a circular array and chained oxen and donkeys across the way back, so that every man was ready to die, and they attacked on all sides and routed the Erzhu. In the fourth month Husi Chun seized Tianguang and Dulü for Luoyang, Shilong and Yanbo were beheaded, Zhao fled to Bing and Zhongyuan to Liang Province, where he died. The Erzhu were finished.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Northern Qi (Li Baiyao, 636)
passages.locator: 卷一 神武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 閏三月，尒朱天光自長安、兆自幷州、度律自洛陽、仲遠自東郡同會鄴，衆號二十萬，挾洹水而軍，節閔以長孫承業為大行臺總督焉。神武令封隆之守鄴，自出頓紫陌。時馬不滿二千，步兵不至三萬，衆寡不敵。乃於韓陵為圓陣，連牛驢以塞歸道，於是將士皆有死志，四面赴擊之。
passages.textEn: In the intercalary third month Erzhu Tianguang came from Chang'an, Zhao from Bing, Dulü from Luoyang and Zhongyuan from Dong commandery to meet at Ye, an army called two hundred thousand, encamped on both banks of the Huan River. Shenwu left Feng Longzhi to hold Ye and camped himself at Zimo. He had fewer than two thousand horse and under thirty thousand foot, far outnumbered. At Hanling he formed a circular array and chained oxen and donkeys across the way back, so that every man was ready to die, and they attacked on all sides.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Northern Qi (Li Baiyao, 636)
passages.locator: 卷一 神武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 乃合戰，大敗之。
passages.textEn: Then they joined battle, and he routed them.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Northern Qi (Li Baiyao, 636)
passages.locator: 卷一 神武帝紀上
passages.textZh: 四月，斛斯椿執天光、度律送洛陽。長孫承業遣都督賈顯智、張歡入洛陽，執世隆、彥伯斬之。兆奔幷州。仲遠奔梁州，遂死焉。
passages.textEn: In the fourth month Husi Chun seized Tianguang and Dulü and sent them to Luoyang; Zhangsun Chengye sent Jia Xianzhi and Zhang Huan into Luoyang to seize Shilong and Yanbo and behead them. Zhao fled to Bing, and Zhongyuan fled to Liang Province, where he died.

label.zh: 尒朱天光自長安…同會鄴

summary.zh: 大統四年七月，東魏遣侯景、厙狄干、高敖曹、韓軌、可朱渾元、莫多婁貸文等圍西魏獨孤信於洛陽，高歡繼其後。宇文泰率軍救援，八月至穀城，臨陣斬莫多婁貸文，盡俘其眾。侯景等夜解圍，宇文泰率輕騎追至黃河邊；侯景北據河橋、南連邙山列陣迎戰。宇文泰坐騎中流矢驚逸，軍中擾亂，都督李穆下馬讓騎，軍勢復振，大破東魏軍，斬高敖曹等，俘甲士一萬五千，溺河死者以萬計。然戰陣綿長，從早至午後數十戰，霧氣四塞，獨孤信、李遠、趙貴、怡峯等左右兩翼失利，不知主帥所在，棄軍先歸，西魏遂班師，洛陽失守。
summary.en: In the seventh month of 538 Eastern Wei sent Hou Jing, Kudi Gan, Gao Aocao, Han Gui, Kezhuhun Yuan and Moduolou Daiwen to besiege Dugu Xin of Western Wei in Luoyang, with Gao Huan following. Yuwen Tai came to relieve him; at Gucheng in the eighth month he beheaded Moduolou Daiwen on the field and captured his men. Hou Jing lifted the siege by night; Yuwen Tai pursued with light horse to the Yellow River, where Hou Jing drew up from the river bridge to Mount Mang. Yuwen Tai's horse was hit by an arrow and bolted, throwing his army into confusion until Li Mu gave him his own; the army rallied and crushed the Eastern Wei troops, beheading Gao Aocao and others, capturing fifteen thousand and drowning tens of thousands. But the lines were long and the fog thick, and after dozens of clashes from dawn to afternoon the Western Wei wings under Dugu Xin, Li Yuan, Zhao Gui and Yi Feng, not knowing where their commander was, left their men and went home; Western Wei withdrew and Luoyang was lost.

label.zh: 西魏統帥：先大捷，後兩翼潰退
label.en: Western Wei commander: won the centre, then the wings broke

label.zh: 東魏：高敖曹戰死，終得洛陽
label.en: Eastern Wei: Gao Aocao killed, but kept Luoyang

passages.sourceEn: Book of Zhou (Linghu Defen et al., 636)
passages.locator: 卷二 文帝紀下
passages.textZh: 七月，東魏遣其將侯景、厙狄干、高敖曹、〔韓〕軌、可朱渾元、莫多婁貸文等圍獨孤信於洛陽。齊神武繼其後。
passages.textEn: In the seventh month Eastern Wei sent Hou Jing, Kudi Gan, Gao Aocao, Han Gui, Kezhuhun Yuan, Moduolou Daiwen and others to besiege Dugu Xin in Luoyang, with Gao Huan following behind.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Zhou (Linghu Defen et al., 636)
passages.locator: 卷二 文帝紀下
passages.textZh: 八月庚寅，太祖至穀城，莫多婁貸文、可朱渾元來逆，臨陣斬貸文，元單騎遁免，悉虜其眾送弘農。
passages.textEn: On gengyin of the eighth month Taizu reached Gucheng; Moduolou Daiwen and Kezhuhun Yuan came against him, Daiwen was beheaded on the field and Yuan escaped alone, and all their men were captured and sent to Hongnong.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Zhou (Linghu Defen et al., 636)
passages.locator: 卷二 文帝紀下
passages.textZh: 及旦，太祖率輕騎追之，至於河上。景等北據河橋，南屬邙山為陣，與諸軍合戰。太祖馬中流矢，驚逸，遂失所之，因此軍中擾亂。都督李穆下馬授太祖，軍以復振。於是大捷，斬高敖曹及其儀同李猛、西兗州刺史宋顯等，虜其甲士一萬五千，赴河死者以萬數。
passages.textEn: At dawn Taizu pursued with light horse to the Yellow River. Hou Jing and the others drew up from the river bridge in the north to Mount Mang in the south and gave battle. Taizu's horse was hit by a stray arrow and bolted, and his whereabouts were lost, throwing the army into confusion; the commander Li Mu gave him his own horse and the army rallied. It was a great victory: Gao Aocao, Li Meng and Song Xian were beheaded, fifteen thousand armoured men captured, and tens of thousands drowned in the river.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Zhou (Linghu Defen et al., 636)
passages.locator: 卷二 文帝紀下
passages.textZh: 獨孤信、李遠居右，趙貴、怡峯居左，戰並不利，又未知魏帝及太祖所在，皆棄其卒先歸。開府李虎、念賢等為後軍，遇信等退，即與俱還。由是乃班師，洛陽亦失守。
passages.textEn: Dugu Xin and Li Yuan on the right and Zhao Gui and Yi Feng on the left both fared badly and, not knowing where the emperor and Taizu were, left their men and went home first; Li Hu and Nian Xian with the rear army met them retreating and went back with them. So the army withdrew, and Luoyang too was lost.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Northern Qi (Li Baiyao, 636)
passages.locator: 卷二 神武帝紀下
passages.textZh: 七月壬午，行台侯景、司徒高昂圍西魏將獨孤信於金墉，西魏帝及周文並來赴救。大都督厙狄干帥諸將前驅，神武總衆繼進。八月辛卯，戰於河陰，大破西魏軍，俘獲數萬。司徒高昂、大都督李猛、宋顯死之。西師之敗，獨孤信先入關，周文留其都督長孫子彥守金墉，遂燒營以遁。
passages.textEn: On renwu of the seventh month Hou Jing and Gao Ang besieged the Western Wei general Dugu Xin at Jinyong, and the Western Wei emperor and Yuwen Tai came to his relief. Kudi Gan led the van and Gao Huan followed with the main army. On xinmao of the eighth month they fought at Heyin and crushed the Western Wei army, taking tens of thousands of prisoners; Gao Ang, Li Meng and Song Xian died. In the Western defeat Dugu Xin fled into the passes first, and Yuwen Tai left Zhangsun Ziyan to hold Jinyong and burned his camp and fled.

label.zh: 太祖至穀城，臨陣斬貸文
景等北據河橋，南屬邙山為陣
label.en: Hou Jing draws up at the bridge

label.zh: 由是乃班師，洛陽亦失守

question.en: Who won at the river bridge?

claim.zh: 西魏先大捷，斬高敖曹；後兩翼失利，班師，洛陽失守。
claim.en: Western Wei won first, killing Gao Aocao; then its wings broke, it withdrew, and Luoyang was lost.

source.en: 周書, 卷二 文帝紀下

accounts.quoteZh: 於是大捷，斬高敖曹

claim.zh: 東魏大破西魏軍，俘獲數萬，西魏燒營而遁。
claim.en: Eastern Wei crushed the Western Wei army, taking tens of thousands, and Western Wei burned its camp and fled.

source.en: 北齊書, 卷二 神武帝紀下

accounts.quoteZh: 戰於河陰，大破西魏軍，俘獲數萬

summary.zh: 永嘉五年，執掌朝政的東海王司馬越死於項城，秘不發喪，由襄陽王司馬範統其眾護喪東歸。石勒追及其軍，將軍錢端出戰身死，晉軍崩潰。石勒焚司馬越靈柩，以騎兵包圍數十萬晉軍射殺，屍體相踏如山，太尉王衍等王公以下死者十餘萬人，西晉主力自此盡喪。戰場所在，〈東海王越傳〉作苦縣甯平城，〈孝懷帝紀〉作東郡。
summary.en: In 311 Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai, who ran the court, died at Xiang; his death was kept secret and Sima Fan led his army east to bury him. Shi Le caught up with it; General Qian Duan came out and was killed, and the Jin army broke. Shi Le burned Yue's coffin and had his horsemen surround and shoot down the several hundred thousand, who trampled one another into heaps; over a hundred thousand died, the Grand Commandant Wang Yan among them, and the last field army of Western Jin was gone. The biography of Sima Yue places the battle at the Ningping fortress in Ku county; the Annals say Dong commandery.

label.en: Jin: the army of Sima Yue (defeated)

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷五十九 東海孝獻王越傳
passages.textZh: 永嘉五年，薨于項。秘不發喪。以襄陽王范為大將軍，統其眾。還葬東海。石勒追及于苦縣甯平城，將軍錢端出兵距勒，戰死，軍潰。勒命焚越柩曰：「此人亂天下，吾為天下報之，故燒其骨以告天地。」於是數十萬眾，勒以騎圍而射之，相踐如山。王公士庶死者十餘萬。
passages.textEn: In the fifth year of Yongjia he died at Xiang. His death was kept secret; Sima Fan, Prince of Xiangyang, was made grand general in command of his army, which set off to bury him in Donghai. Shi Le caught up with it at the Ningping fortress in Ku county; General Qian Duan came out against him and was killed, and the army broke. Le had Yue's coffin burned, saying, "This man brought chaos to the realm; I avenge the realm on him, and burn his bones to tell Heaven and Earth." Then his horsemen surrounded the several hundred thousand and shot them down; they trampled one another into heaps, and over a hundred thousand princes, officials and common people died.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Jin (Fang Xuanling et al., 648)
passages.locator: 卷五 孝懷帝紀
passages.textZh: 四月戊子，石勒追東海王越喪，及於東郡，將軍錢端戰死，軍潰，太尉王衍、吏部尚書劉望、廷尉諸葛銓、尚書鄭豫、武陵王澹等皆遇害，王公已下死者十餘萬人。
passages.textEn: On wuzi of the fourth month Shi Le caught up with the funeral train of Yue, Prince of Donghai, in Dong commandery; General Qian Duan died fighting, the army broke, and the Grand Commandant Wang Yan, Liu Wang, Zhuge Quan, Zheng Yu, Sima Dan, Prince of Wuling, and others were all killed, with over a hundred thousand from the princes down.

label.zh: 石勒追及于苦縣甯平城
label.en: Shi Le catches it at Ningping

question.en: Where was the battle fought?

claim.zh: 苦縣甯平城。
claim.en: At the Ningping fortress in Ku county.

source.en: 晉書, 卷五十九 東海孝獻王越傳

accounts.quoteZh: 石勒追及于苦縣甯平城

claim.zh: 東郡。
claim.en: In Dong commandery.

source.en: 晉書, 卷五 孝懷帝紀

accounts.quoteZh: 石勒追東海王越喪，及於東郡
